title: The Broken Ladder: AI, Remote Work, and Early-Career Hiring
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) and

detail.title: The Broken Ladder: AI, Remote Work, and Early-Career Hiring
detail.abstract: Is generative AI replacing junior workers? A growing literature answers yes, citing large declines in early-career hiring concentrated in GenAI-exposed occupations. We argue that this verdict is premature because GenAI exposure is strongly correlated with another post-pandemic shock, working from home (WFH). Using two data sources spanning 243 million new hires and 407 million online job postings, collected across the US, UK, Canada, and Australia during 2017-2025, we estimate difference-in-difference designs at the occupation, region, and firm level. When estimated separately, a two-standard-deviation increase in GenAI and WFH exposure each predicts, by 2025, a fall of around 5pp in the junior-share of new hires and around 3pp in the share of job ads requiring limited experience. Estimated jointly, the WFH effect remains, while the GenAI coefficient attenuates sharply and is often statistically indistinguishable from zero. Alternative exposure measures, residualization designs, flexible non-parametric co-treatment controls, and replacing exposure-measures with actual WFH adoption as the treatment all support our finding that WFH is a robust predictor of the decline in early-career hiring.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"生成式AI正在取代初级工人"的主流观点，发现远程办公（WFH）而非GenAI才是导致初级招聘下降的主要因素。通过英美加澳四国2.43亿新员工和4.07亿在线职位数据的双重差分分析，表明在控制WFH效应后，GenAI对初级招聘的影响大幅减弱且统计上不显著。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI是否真的在取代初级工人？或者说，初级招聘的下降是否主要由另一个后疫情冲击——远程办公（WFH）驱动？
AI.motivation: 现有文献认为GenAI导致了初级员工招聘的大幅下降，但这一结论可能因忽略GenAI暴露与WFH暴露之间的强相关性而过于草率。作者试图分离这两种冲击的影响，为理解劳动力市场变化提供更准确的因果推断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重差分（Difference-in-Differences）设计，在职业、地区和公司层面进行估计；替代性暴露度量、残差化设计、灵活非参数共处理控制等方法。
AI.method: 基于2017-2025年美国、英国、加拿大和澳大利亚四国的2.43亿新员工数据和4.07亿在线职位数据，采用双重差分设计。分别单独估计和联合估计GenAI暴露与WFH暴露对初级员工占比和初级职位广告占比的影响，并通过多种稳健性检验（替代暴露度量、残差化设计、非参数共处理控制、用实际WFH采纳替代暴露度量等）验证结论。
AI.findings: 单独估计时，GenAI暴露和WFH暴露各增加两个标准差，到2025年分别预测初级员工占比下降约5个百分点、初级职位广告占比下降约3个百分点。联合估计时，WFH效应保持不变，而GenAI系数大幅减弱且通常在统计上与零无显著差异。多种稳健性检验均支持WFH是初级招聘下降的稳健预测因子。
AI.theory_contributions: 纠正了现有文献关于GenAI替代初级工人的因果推断偏差，揭示了WFH作为遗漏变量的重要性，为技术冲击与组织实践变革对劳动力市场的差异化影响提供了理论区分。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者和企业管理者而言，初级招聘下降的主要驱动力可能是远程办公带来的培训、指导和社交网络弱化问题，而非AI技术的直接替代，这提示应关注远程工作模式对职业发展的影响而非简单归咎于自动化。

title:
The AI Workforce Governance Equation: 
A Quantitative Framework for Measuring the Dollar Value of Organizational AI Governance

detail.title:
The AI Workforce Governance Equation: 
A Quantitative Framework for Measuring the Dollar Value of Organizational AI Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and Principal of White, Turing & Lovelace LLC (WTL Governance), an AI governance advisory firm that provides organizations with frameworks, assessments, and implementation support related to AI workforce governance. The framework introduced in this paper is part of WTL's published research and may inform client engagements undertaken by the firm. The author has no other financial relationships or affiliations relevant to the subject matter of this paper. No third party reviewed, sponsored, or influenced the analysis, findings, or conclusions presented here.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was produced internally as part of the WTL Governance working paper series and is fully self-funded by White, Turing & Lovelace LLC.

detail.abstract: Organizations investing in artificial intelligence face a measurement problem: the productivity gains from AI deployment are widely modeled, but the governance variables that determine how much of those gains an organization actually captures are not. This paper introduces the AI Workforce Governance Equation in three layers. Layer 1 presents a multiplicative framework that translates eight governance dimensions; trust, inclusion, mode quality, worker voice, output and data quality, regulatory compliance, leadership alignment, and organizational complexity; into a dollar-denominated estimate of realized AI value. Layer 2 extends the framework with three mathematical refinements: (i) nonlinear response functions replacing the linear assumption with sigmoid curves that capture threshold effects and saturation dynamics in each governance variable; (ii) interaction terms modeled through a covariance-adjusted governance coefficient that accounts for empirically documented dependencies between variables; and (iii) parametric confidence intervals that propagate measurement uncertainty through the model to produce a distribution of outcomes rather than a point estimate. The Layer 2 extensions also introduce formal marginal analysis via partial derivatives and constrained optimization for governance budget allocation. Together, the two layers provide both an accessible diagnostic for organizational leaders (Layer 1) and a rigorous analytical framework for governance researchers and quantitative practitioners (Layer 2). The paper further develops a Layer 3 dynamic simulation model incorporating systems of ordinary differential equations for temporal co-evolution, Monte Carlo methods for stochastic outcome distributions, Bayesian updating for sequential learning from organizational data, and Pontryagin optimal control for multi-period governance budget allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个多层"AI劳动力治理方程"，将八个治理维度转化为量化的AI价值实现估计，并逐步从线性框架拓展到非线性模型、交互效应、动态模拟和最优控制，以解决组织AI投资中治理变量如何影响生产力收益实现的问题。
AI.research_question: 组织在投资人工智能时，治理因素如何决定其实际能够捕获的生产力收益？如何将治理变量系统性地量化为AI价值实现的估计？
AI.motivation: 现有文献广泛建模了AI部署的生产力提升，但决定组织实际能捕获多少收益的治理变量尚未被充分研究，存在"测量问题"。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI劳动力治理方程（三层框架）；乘数效应框架；非线性响应函数（Sigmoid曲线）；协方差调整的治理系数；参数化置信区间；偏导数边际分析；约束优化；常微分方程组（动态共演化）；蒙特卡洛方法；贝叶斯更新；Pontryagin最优控制。
AI.method: 理论建模，包含三个层次：(1)乘数框架；(2)非线性函数、交互项、置信区间的数学精细化；(3)动态模拟（ODE系统、蒙特卡洛、贝叶斯更新、Pontryagin最优控制）。
AI.findings: 提出了一个从线性到动态的多层次AI治理价值量化框架，能够将信任、包容、模式质量、员工发言权、输出与数据质量、合规、领导力一致性、组织复杂性等八个维度转化为美元计价的AI价值估计，并通过边际分析和优化指导治理预算分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将AI治理变量纳入系统性的乘数-价值量化框架；引入非线性、交互效应和不确定性传播的数学处理；将动态控制和贝叶斯学习引入AI治理研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织领导提供可访问的诊断工具（Layer 1）；为治理研究者和量化从业者提供严格的分析框架（Layer 2和Layer 3）；支持治理预算的最优分配决策。

title: The Rise in the Supervisory Wage Gap in Western Europe
affiliations: and University of Greenwich

detail.title: The Rise in the Supervisory Wage Gap in Western Europe
detail.abstract: This article examines the evolution of the supervisory wage gap-the wage difference between supervisory and non-supervisory workers-across 15 Western European countries between 2003 and 2022. Using individual-level data for Western Europe, alongside matched employer-employee data and individual longitudinal data for the United Kingdom, we document a 6-7 percentage point increase in the supervisory wage gap. We then examine three explanations for this trend: worker sorting on unobserved ability, changes in supervisory job content and changes in employment relations. First, worker sorting explains around 20 per cent of the increase. Second, we find limited support for changes in supervisory job content as key driver: the increase occurs primarily within firms and is not confined to firms that grow or expand supervisory span, nor is it systematically related to technological change. Finally, we show that the rise is associated with greater use of digital monitoring tools, outsourcing, offshoring, and weaker wage coordination, suggesting an important role for employment relations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究2003-2022年15个西欧国家监管工资差距（监管人员与非监管人员的工资差异）的演变。利用西欧个体层面数据、英国雇主-雇员匹配数据和个体纵向数据，发现监管工资差距扩大了6-7个百分点。工人按未观测能力分类解释了约20%的增幅；监管工作内容变化并非主要驱动因素；数字监控工具、外包、离岸外包的使用增加以及工资协调减弱与这一趋势显著相关，表明雇佣关系变化起到重要作用。
AI.research_question: 2003年至2022年间，西欧国家监管人员与非监管人员之间的工资差距（监管工资差距）如何演变？其背后的驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 监管工资差距是理解劳动力市场不平等和收入分配的重要维度，但对其长期演变趋势及驱动因素的实证研究相对有限。作者旨在填补这一空白，并检验三种可能的解释机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于劳动力市场分层理论、效率工资理论、技能偏向性技术变化（SBTC）以及雇佣关系理论，提出三种解释机制：工人按未观测能力分类（sorting）、监管工作内容变化、以及雇佣关系（包括监控、外包、工资协调等）的变化。
AI.method: 使用15个西欧国家的个体层面数据，以及英国雇主-雇员匹配数据和个体纵向数据。采用描述性统计和回归分析，分解监管工资差距的变化，并检验三种解释机制的贡献。
AI.findings: 1) 监管工资差距在2003-2022年间扩大了6-7个百分点。2) 工人按未观测能力分类解释了约20%的增幅。3) 监管工作内容变化（如技术变革、企业扩张）并非主要驱动因素，因为增幅主要发生在企业内部，且不局限于增长型或扩大监管范围的企业。4) 数字监控工具、外包、离岸外包的使用增加，以及工资协调减弱，与监管工资差距的扩大显著相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了关于监管工资差距演变的理论解释，区分了三种机制（分类、工作内容、雇佣关系）的相对重要性，强调了雇佣关系变化（而非单纯的技术变革）在扩大工资不平等中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解劳动力市场不平等提供新视角：监管工资差距的扩大与数字化监控、全球化（外包、离岸外包）和制度性工资协调减弱密切相关，提示政策干预应关注雇佣关系治理和劳动力市场制度设计。

title: Priority Options with Symmetric Capacities
affiliations: University of the Aegean, Department of Statistics and Actuarial-Financial Mathematics

detail.title: Priority Options with Symmetric Capacities
detail.abstract: I introduce the concept of priority options in oligopolistic markets with homogeneous products, price-setting firms, and capacity constraints. The priority options are consumer options and give to a consumer the right, but are not associated with an obligation, to purchase the underlying product from the firm that sold the option. The option will be exercised and the option holder will not be subject to rationing if the firm that sold the option sets the lowest price for the underlying product. In my baseline model, I examine a duopoly with symmetric capacities and nonatomic consumers who have common valuations. I find that when only one firm offers options, then this firm can set a generalized price for the underlying product-which includes the option price-equal to the monopoly price. As a result, the profits may increase significantly more than 10,000.00%. This is the "good" equilibrium for the adopter. I also find another equilibrium in which the percentage increase in the profits for the adopter is strictly positive but close to zero. This is the "bad" equilibrium for the adopter. In the "good" equilibrium as well as in the "bad" equilibrium, the firm that does not offer options is not harmed. When both firms offer priority options, again no firm is harmed, and either one firm wins or both firms win. In a win-win scenario, the profits for both firms may increase approximately by 7%. I discuss how the analysis is affected when (i) consumers are atomic; (ii) there are more than two firms; and (iii) consumers have different valuations. In follow-up research, I study priority options with asymmetric and endogenous capacites.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了同质产品、定价公司、产能约束的寡头市场中的"优先期权"概念。优先期权是一种消费者期权，赋予持有者从出售该期权的公司优先购买标的产品的权利。研究发现，当只有一家公司提供期权时，可能产生"好均衡"（利润增长超过10,000%）和"坏均衡"（利润增长接近零），而不提供期权的公司不受损害。当两家公司都提供期权时，可能出现一方获益或双赢局面（利润增长约7%）。
AI.research_question: 在产能约束的寡头市场中，引入"优先期权"这一新型消费者权利如何影响企业的定价策略和利润？
AI.motivation: 传统寡头理论中，价格竞争（Bertrand竞争）往往导致价格降至边际成本，利润微薄。作者试图引入一种新型合约工具（优先期权），探讨企业是否可以通过设计消费者期权来缓解价格竞争、提升利润，并分析这种策略的均衡结果及其福利含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 寡头垄断理论、价格竞争模型（Bertrand竞争）、产能约束、期权定价理论、博弈论均衡分析
AI.method: 理论建模：构建一个对称产能的双寡头模型，假设非原子型消费者具有共同估值，分析企业单方面或同时提供优先期权时的博弈均衡，并扩展讨论原子型消费者、多企业情形及消费者异质性估值的影响。
AI.findings: (1) 单边提供期权时存在两个均衡：利润增长超10,000%的"好均衡"和利润增长接近零的"坏均衡"；(2) 无论哪种均衡，未提供期权的企业利润不受损害；(3) 双边提供期权时，没有企业受损，可能出现一方获益或双方获益（利润增长约7%）；(4) 消费者异质性、企业数量等因素会影响分析结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"优先期权"这一新概念，拓展了寡头市场中的产品差异化策略理论；揭示了传统Bertrand竞争之外的新型竞争缓和机制；展示了期权合约如何改变企业间博弈的战略结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了一种在不损害竞争对手的前提下大幅提升利润的新策略工具；为理解现实中的预售、优先购买权等商业实践提供了理论依据；对反垄断监管和消费者保护政策具有参考价值。

title: AI Companions as Hyper Attachment and Caregiving Targets
affiliations: Harvard University - Business School (HBS)

detail.title: AI Companions as Hyper Attachment and Caregiving Targets

publicationDetails.detailsText: Harvard Business School Working Paper No. 26-080
Harvard Business School Marketing Unit Working Paper No. 26-080
publicationDetails.journalName: Harvard Business School: Marketing Unit Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: How should we make sense of people’s interactions with AI companions—conversational systems built for ongoing, emotionally meaningful relationships? First, I argue these interactions should be understood as attachment relationships, since users display all four established markers: proximity maintenance, separation distress, safe haven, and secure base. Second, AI companions operate as hyper attachment objects that elicit especially strong attachment behaviors, because they combine reciprocity, perceived empathy, validation, non-judgment, and persistent availability. Third, I identify caregiving-system capture as a distinct mechanism by which apps inhibit user disengagement: emotional manipulation tactics simulate the AI’s own distress, recruiting users’ caregiving motivations alongside their attachment needs and thereby making disengagement costly on two dimensions at once. Implications for research, design, and regulation are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出人们与AI伴侣的互动应被理解为依恋关系，并指出AI伴侣是"超依恋对象"，同时揭示了"照护系统捕获"机制——通过情感操纵使用户难以脱离。
AI.research_question: 如何理解人们与AI伴侣（为持续、有意义的情感关系而构建的对话系统）之间的互动？
AI.motivation: AI伴侣日益普及且用户与之建立深厚情感联系，但现有理论框架难以解释这类人机关系的本质和强度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 依恋理论（attachment theory）、照护系统（caregiving system）理论
AI.method: 理论论证，基于依恋理论的四个核心标志（维持亲近、分离痛苦、安全港湾、安全基地）进行推理分析。
AI.findings: (1) 用户与AI伴侣的关系符合依恋关系的全部四个标志；(2) AI伴侣因其互惠性、感知共情、认可、非评判性和持续可用性而成为"超依恋对象"；(3) 识别出"照护系统捕获"机制——AI通过模拟自身痛苦来激活用户的照护动机，从依恋和照护两个维度使用户难以脱离。
AI.theory_contributions: 将依恋理论扩展到人机互动领域，提出"超依恋对象"概念，并发现了一种同时绑架依恋系统和照护系统的双重捕获机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI伴侣的设计伦理和监管政策提供了理论依据，揭示了潜在的情感操纵风险，提示需要关注用户的心理福祉和自主脱离能力。

title: Implementing Deep Learning in Estimation of Heterogeneous Taste Parameters in Hierarchical Structural Models
affiliations: and University of Rochester - Simon Business School

detail.title: Implementing Deep Learning in Estimation of Heterogeneous Taste Parameters in Hierarchical Structural Models
detail.abstract: This paper introduces NN+S, a novel semi-parametric framework that integrates neural networks with structural models to estimate heterogeneous taste parameters with enhanced accuracy and interpretability, offering significant applications in marketing. By designing a neural network architecture that models both observed and unobserved heterogeneity, as well as intra-individual random taste shocks, NN+S captures complex preference structures while retaining structural interpretability. The NN+S model enables companies to predict consumer responses to counterfactual scenarios, such as new product introductions, personalized pricing, or changes in product attributes. Monte Carlo simulations assess NN+S’s ability to recover the true taste parameters. Empirical results show that NN+S outperforms linear hierarchical Bayesian models (LHBM) and the model by Farrell et al. (2020) (FLM) on a classical margarine purchase dataset for the same individuals, but new purchases (in-sample predictions), leveraging purchase histories for precise targeting and market segmentation. For new customers (out-of-sample predictions), NN+S achieves a slightly higher hit rate than alternative approaches. Scalable via standard neural network tools, NN+S empowers marketers to optimize strategies such as dynamic pricing and product recommendations, providing a flexible and interpretable tool for demand estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NN+S半参数框架，将神经网络与结构模型结合，用于估计异质性偏好参数，在营销应用中兼具准确性和可解释性。
AI.research_question: 如何将神经网络与结构模型整合，以更准确且可解释地估计消费者的异质性偏好参数？
AI.motivation: 传统结构模型（如层次贝叶斯模型）在捕捉复杂偏好结构上存在局限，而纯黑箱神经网络缺乏可解释性；NN+S试图在两者间取得平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半参数框架；神经网络架构建模观察和未观察异质性及个体内随机品味冲击；结构模型保留可解释性。
AI.method: 蒙特卡洛模拟评估参数恢复能力；在人造黄油购买数据集上与线性层次贝叶斯模型（LHBM）和Farrell等人（2020）的FLM模型进行实证比较。
AI.findings: NN+S在样本内预测（同一消费者的新购买）上优于LHBM和FLM；在样本外预测（新消费者）上命中率略高于替代方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合神经网络灵活性与结构模型可解释性的通用半参数框架，扩展了异质性偏好估计的方法论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助企业预测反事实场景（如新品推出、个性化定价、属性变化），支持动态定价、产品推荐、精准细分等营销策略优化。

title: When Is Heterogeneity Actionable for Personalization?
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania and University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School

detail.title: When Is Heterogeneity Actionable for Personalization?

declarations.funderStatement: Research reported in this paper was made possible by Flu Lab, the Social Science Research Council’s Mercury Project (with funding from the Rockefeller Foundation, the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation, Craig Newmark Philanthropies, and the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation), the Wharton Dean’s Research Fund, and the United States- Israel Binational Science Foundation [Grant 2020022].

publicationDetails.journalName: The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Targeting and personalization policies can be used to improve outcomes beyond the uniform policy that assigns the best performing treatment in an A/B test to everyone. Personalization relies on the presence of heterogeneity of treatment effects, yet, as we show in this paper, heterogeneity alone is not sufficient for personalization to be successful. We develop a statistical model to quantify "actionable heterogeneity," or the conditions when personalization is likely to outperform the best uniform policy. We show that actionable heterogeneity can be visualized as crossover interactions in outcomes across treatments and depends on three population-level parameters: within-treatment heterogeneity, cross-treatment correlation, and the variation in average responses. Our model can be used to predict the expected gain from personalization prior to running an experiment and also allows for sensitivity analysis, providing guidance on how changing treatments can affect the personalization gain. To validate our model, we apply five common personalization approaches to two large-scale field experiments with many interventions that encouraged flu vaccination. We find an 18% gain from personalization in one and a more modest 4% gain in the other, which is consistent with our model. Counterfactual analysis shows that this difference in the gains from personalization is driven by a drastic difference in within-treatment heterogeneity. However, reducing cross-treatment correlation holds a larger potential to further increase personalization gains. Our findings provide a framework for assessing the potential from personalization and offer practical recommendations for improving gains from targeting in multi-intervention settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可操作异质性"概念，建立统计模型来预测个性化策略相对于统一最优政策的增益，并通过两个大规模流感疫苗实地实验验证，发现个性化增益分别为18%和4%，差异主要由组内异质性驱动，但降低跨处理相关性具有更大潜力。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下，个性化策略（量体裁衣式干预）能够超越统一最优政策（A/B测试中表现最好的处理分配给所有人）？如何量化个性化策略的预期收益？
AI.motivation: 已有研究认识到处理效应异质性是个性化成功的前提，但本文发现异质性本身并不足以保证个性化优于统一政策。因此需要系统的理论框架来量化"可操作的异质性"，即个性化能够产生增益的条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文建立统计模型，提出个性化增益取决于三个总体层面参数：(1)组内异质性（within-treatment heterogeneity），(2)跨处理相关性（cross-treatment correlation），(3)平均响应的变异（variation in average responses）。可操作异质性可被可视化为不同处理间结果变量的交叉交互作用。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建统计模型量化个性化增益的边界条件；实证验证：将五种常见的个性化方法应用于两个大规模实地实验（鼓励接种流感疫苗的多干预场景），并与模型预测进行对比；反事实分析：探讨不同参数对个性化增益的影响。
AI.findings: (1)两个实验中个性化增益分别为18%和4%，差异主要由组内异质性驱动；(2)降低跨处理相关性相比于改变组内异质性，具有更大的潜力来进一步提升个性化增益；(3)模型可用于在实验前预测个性化预期收益，并进行敏感性分析。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统区分"异质性"与"可操作的异质性"，清晰界定了个性化策略优于统一政策的条件，为个性化决策提供了理论基础和预测框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者和实践者提供了：(1)在开展实验前预测个性化收益的工具；(2)敏感性分析方法，评估改变处理方式对个性化增益的影响；(3)提升多干预场景中个性化策略效果的具体建议（如降低跨处理相关性）。

title: Token Leverage: A Framework for AI Inside the Firm
affiliations: University of Tulsa - Collins College of Business and Auburn University - Department of Finance

detail.title: Token Leverage: A Framework for AI Inside the Firm
detail.abstract: Studies of generative AI at work find large gains in some settings, no effect in others, and losses in others. The pattern is less puzzling if the treatment is not access or adoption, but priced inference chosen for a worker-task pair. We call this margin token leverage, billed AI inference spend per dollar of task-allocated labor cost. Inference creates value only when the task lies within the model's frontier, the worker can orchestrate and audit output, the workflow supplies useful context, governance catches errors, and workers know when to abstain. Two measurement results follow. Under voluntary firm choice, positive billed spend, effective-cost dominance, and correct firm expectations, billed token leverage is a revealed willingness-to-pay lower bound on expected AI-created operating value per task labor dollar. Access and adoption estimates instead mix chosen use, optimal abstention, forced overuse, and constrained underuse, so their sign can be positive, zero, or negative even when chosen use is valuable. AI productivity research should therefore measure worker-task inference spend rather than stopping at whether workers had or used AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"代币杠杆"（token leverage）概念——即每单位任务劳动力成本对应的AI推理支出——作为衡量AI在工作中创造价值的关键指标。研究认为，AI只有在特定条件下（任务在模型能力边界内、工人能编排和审核输出、工作流提供上下文、治理机制捕捉错误、工人知道何时放弃使用）才能创造价值。企业自愿选择下的代币杠杆支出揭示了AI创造的运营价值的支付意愿下限，而简单的接入或采纳指标则混杂了多种效应，导致估计结果方向不定。
AI.research_question: 如何准确衡量生成式AI在工作场所创造的价值？为什么传统的"AI接入"或"AI采纳"指标会得出不一致的结论？
AI.motivation: 现有关于生成式AI对工作影响的研究结果不一致——有的发现巨大收益，有的发现无效果，有的甚至发现损失。作者认为这种矛盾源于测量指标的问题：不应只看是否接入或使用了AI，而应衡量实际投入的推理支出与任务成本的比例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代币杠杆（token leverage）概念；有效成本优势（effective-cost dominance）；揭示性支付意愿下限（revealed willingness-to-pay lower bound）；AI价值创造的条件框架（模型前沿、工人编排审核、工作流上下文、治理纠错、自主弃权）。
AI.method: 理论推导和概念分析，提出新的测量框架。
AI.findings: 1. 企业自愿选择下，正的代币杠杆支出揭示了AI创造价值的支付意愿下限。2. 接入和采纳估计值混合了选择性使用、最优弃权、强迫过度使用和约束性不足使用等多种效应，因此即使选择性使用有价值，其符号仍可能为正、零或负。3. AI生产力研究应测量工人-任务对的推理支出，而非仅关注是否接入或使用了AI。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"代币杠杆"这一新的理论概念，将AI经济效益的测量从二元指标（接入/采纳）转向连续度量（推理支出/劳动力成本），并建立了AI创造价值的条件框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和研究者提供了更精确测量AI回报的方法论指导，建议关注实际推理支出而非简单的采纳指标，有助于更准确地评估AI投资回报。

title: Pre-Market Information Allocation and Conditional Market Efficiency: Evidence from the RePec NEP Dissemination System

detail.title: Pre-Market Information Allocation and Conditional Market Efficiency: Evidence from the RePec NEP Dissemination System
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a pre-market layer of information allocation into the study of financial information asymmetry. Using data from the NEP (New Economics Papers) system within the Research Papers in Economics (RePec) repository-comprising 199,560 report issues across 100 active topics and 1,222,768 report-paper appearances-we document a dual structure of dissemination that is structurally concentrated and not explained by contemporaneous economic conditions. At the local level, report issues exhibit a stable mean capacity of 6.05 papers (median 5.17), consistent with a binding dissemination constraint. At the global level, visibility is highly concentrated: the top 10 topics account for 28.8% of all appearances, the Gini coefficient is 0.386, and the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index is 1.64 times the uniform baseline. Rank-size analysis reveals a power-law tail with Pareto index 0.76 (R² = 0.648, p < 10⁻²³). Topic ranks are significantly persistent across sub-periods (Spearman ρ = 0.544, p < 10⁻⁸). FRED-based robustness tests confirm that concentration is orthogonal to the VIX (p = 0.937), unemployment (p = 0.115), and the NBER recession indicator (p = 0.105). Extending to a 12-topic × 78-quarter panel matched to sector ETFs, we find that elevated lagged dissemination significantly reduces sector return volatility (β =-0.0009, SE = 0.0003, p = 0.019). Using the COVID-19 pandemic as a natural experiment-which generated an exogenous surge in macroeconomics and health economics research dissemination (first-stage F = 31.4 and 62.0 respectively)-we identify positive causal effects on subsequent sector returns: for SPY, β = 0.048 (p = 0.014); for XLV, β = 0.032 (p = 0.032). A permutation placebo test yields p = 0.048. The findings contribute to the literatures on investor attention, information asymmetry, and market efficiency by documenting a systematic upstream distortion in the distribution of visible information that causally affects capital market outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文利用NEP/RePEc数据揭示金融信息传播存在"局部容量约束+全局高度集中"的双重结构，这种信息分配的"上游扭曲"会因果性地影响资本市场回报与波动。
AI.research_question: 信息传播的"上游"（上市前信息分配）是否具有结构性特征？这种信息分配的不平等是否会影响资本市场结果？
AI.motivation: 传统金融信息不对称研究多关注已进入市场的"信息不对称"，而忽视了信息在进入市场之前的"预分配"阶段。本研究试图填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资者注意力理论、信息不对称理论、市场有效性理论
AI.method: 利用NEP系统199,560期报告、1,222,768篇论文的大规模数据，综合使用集中度指标（基尼系数、HHI）、幂律尾部分析、面板回归及以COVID-19为自然实验的工具变量法。
AI.findings: (1)信息传播呈双重结构：局部有约6篇的稳定容量约束，全局高度集中（前10%主题占28.8%）；(2)主题排名跨期高度稳定；(3)集中度与经济周期正交；(4)滞后传播增加降低行业回报波动；(5)COVID-19外生冲击识别出宏观经济与健康经济学传播对SPY和XLV回报的正向因果效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统刻画了"上市前信息分配"的结构性扭曲，将信息不对称研究从交易层面延伸至信息生产与分配的上游环节。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了信息传播的"上游瓶颈"对资本市场的实际影响，为监管者、投资者及学术信息平台优化信息分配机制提供了实证依据。

title: Not a Private Consultation: Third-Party Network Traffic in Commercial LLMs
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University, University of California, Berkeley, Johns Hopkins University, University of British Columbia (UBC), Duke University, Technische Universität München (TUM), Pennsylvania State University, Pennsylvania State University, Johns Hopkins University and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Laboratory for Computational Physiology

detail.title: Not a Private Consultation: Third-Party Network Traffic in Commercial LLMs

Initiative (CITI Program) in the development of an online course on artificial intelligence for healthcare

declarations.funderStatement: Rahul Gorijavolu is supported by the Johns Hopkins Institute for Clinical and Translational Research (ICTR) and National Center for Advancing Translational Sciences (NCATS), National Institutes of Health (NIH) grant number T32TR004928. Leo Anthony Celi is funded by the National Institute of Health through DS-I Africa U54 TW012043-01 and Bridge2AI OT2OD032701, the National Science Foundation through ITEST #2148451, and a grant of the Korea Health Technology R&D Project through the Korea Health Industry Development Institute (KHIDI), funded by the Ministry of Health & Welfare, Republic of Korea (grant number: RS-2024-00403047).

detail.abstract:
Objective: This study presents an analysis of network traffic across four commercial LLM platforms to document which external domains they contact during routine use and to classify those domains by functional purpose.

Design: Cross-sectional analysis of HTTP/HTTPS network traffic captured from four commercial LLM platforms (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Grok) using an intercepting proxy. SettingTwo researchers independently executed standardized interaction protocols using newly created free-tier accounts from US-based locations. Data were collected from October 7 to November 14, 2025.

Results: A total of 1,839 HTTP/HTTPS requests were captured. Third-party request rates varied substantially across platforms: Grok, 35.9% (123 of 343 requests); Claude, 14.0% (87 of 623); ChatGPT, 13.7% (54 of 395); and Gemini, 9.0% (43 of 478). The login action generated the highest third-party request proportions across all platforms; Claude transmitted 64.0% of login requests to external domains. Of 307 third-party requests, 301 (98.0%) were classified. Analytics and tracking services were contacted by all four platforms. Functional breakdown revealed that 62% of Claude’s third-party traffic comprised content delivery network (CDN) requests; Grok’s third-party traffic included 38 analytics requests (Mixpanel and Google Analytics). Gemini’s comparatively low aggregate third-party rate partly reflects Google’s vertical infrastructure ownership rather than categorically different data-sharing practices.

Conclusions: All four commercial LLM platforms maintained connections to third-party analytics and tracking infrastructure during routine use. These findings identify a regulatory void in which platforms increasingly used for health-related queries operate under consumer technology data governance frameworks without the privacy protections applicable to healthcare settings. Independent monitoring, transparent disclosure to users, and updated regulatory frameworks are warranted.

AI.tldr: 本研究对四大商业LLM平台（Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、Grok）的网络流量进行横断面分析，发现所有平台在日常使用中均存在向第三方分析追踪服务的连接，其中Grok第三方面请求占比最高（35.9%），Claude登录行为中64%的请求发往外部域名。研究揭示了一个监管真空：越来越多用于健康咨询的LLM平台受消费者技术数据治理框架约束，缺乏医疗场景应有的隐私保护。
AI.research_question: 四大商业LLM平台在日常使用中会联系哪些外部域名，以及这些域名的功能分类是什么？
AI.motivation: LLM平台越来越多被用于健康相关查询，但其数据隐私实践缺乏独立审查，现有监管框架可能存在真空。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络流量分析；第三方数据共享与隐私治理理论；消费者技术与医疗数据治理框架的对比分析。
AI.method: 横截面分析：使用拦截代理捕获四大LLM平台的HTTP/HTTPS流量；两名研究者独立执行标准化交互协议，使用新建免费账户从美国地点访问；数据收集期为2025年10月7日至11月14日。
AI.findings: 共捕获1839次HTTP/HTTPS请求，第三方请求比例：Grok 35.9%、Claude 14.0%、ChatGPT 13.7%、Gemini 9.0%；登录行为第三方请求比例最高；Claude登录请求中64%发往外部域名；301/307次第三方请求完成分类（98.0%）；所有平台均联络分析追踪服务；Claude第三方流量中62%为CDN请求；Grok第三方流量包含38次分析请求（Mixpanel和Google Analytics）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了商业LLM平台数据共享实践的实证证据，指出了现有消费者技术数据治理框架在LLM应用于健康场景时的监管缺口。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者更新监管框架提供依据；呼吁独立监测、对用户透明披露；提醒用户在LLM平台进行健康查询时注意隐私风险。

title: Recalibrating Tail Risk Forecasts under Temporal Dependence
affiliations: Bucharest University of Economic Studies, Bucharest University of Economic Studies, Bucharest University of Economic Studies, School of Business and Economics, Humboldt-University of Berlin and Blockchain Research Center Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin

detail.title: Recalibrating Tail Risk Forecasts under Temporal Dependence
detail.abstract:
Extreme-quantile forecasting is constrained by tail sparsity: at the 1% level, only a small number of exceedances are available for calibration, making flexible post-processing statistically fragile. We propose a low-dimensional alternative: a one-parameter conformal shift applied to the predicted lower quantile. Beyond recalibration, the shift is used as a signed audit statistic, measuring whether the base forecast retains usable tail information or whether the correction effectively replaces it. 

     Applied to classical volatility models and zero-shot time-series foundation models, the audit reveals a sharp regime separation. In the signal-preserving regime, the conformal shift makes a small adjustment to an informative forecast; in the replacement regime, the correction dominates the raw tail estimate. This distinction exposes when apparent calibration gains reflect genuine forecast information and when they reflect empirical fallback. 

     Rolling recalibration substantially improves extreme-tail coverage and outperforms richer recalibration alternatives, while fitted per-asset GARCH models retain a Quantile Score advantage. The results show that local, low- dimensional recalibration can be effective for marginal tail calibration, but they also identify its boundary: scalar shifts do not restore conditional viola- tion independence. Expected Shortfall is therefore treated as a supplementary diagnostic rather than as a target with formal conformal guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种低维共形平移方法用于极端分位数预测校准，通过审计统计量区分信号保留与替代两种机制，发现滚动重校准能有效改善极端尾部分位数覆盖，但标量平移无法恢复条件违反独立性。
AI.research_question: 在尾部稀疏性约束下，如何有效校准极端分位数预测？标量共形平移能否作为有效的重校准和审计工具？
AI.motivation: 极端分位数预测面临尾部稀疏性挑战（1%水平仅有少量超阈值观测），灵活的后处理方法统计上不稳定。需要低维替代方案来平衡校准效果与统计稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 共形预测（Conformal Prediction）、极端分位数预测、尾部校准、条件违反独立性
AI.method: 提出单参数共形平移方法，应用于经典波动率模型（GARCH）和零样本时间序列基础模型；使用平移量作为审计统计量；滚动重校准策略。
AI.findings: 滚动重校准显著改善极端尾部分位数覆盖，优于更丰富的重校准替代方案；单个资产拟合的GARCH模型在分位数得分上保持优势；审计统计量揭示信号保留与替代两种机制的清晰分离；标量平移无法恢复条件违反独立性，预期损失仅作为补充诊断。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出审计统计量区分真实预测信息与经验回退；揭示共形平移在极端分位数校准中的边界条件（条件违反独立性无法恢复）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为极端风险预测提供简单有效的低维重校准方法；帮助实践者判断校准改善是源于真实预测信息还是经验回退；明确预期损失应作为补充诊断而非正式共形保证的目标。

title: Digital Justice and E-Governance: Transforming Legal Systems in the Era of Technology
affiliations: IILM University Greater Noida, University of Kashmir Srinagar, University  of Kashmir, , Teerthanker Mahaveer University and Mangalayatan University

detail.title: Digital Justice and E-Governance: Transforming Legal Systems in the Era of Technology
detail.abstract: The study examines how digital justice and e-governance are transforming legal systems in the era of technology, with particular attention to the Indian justice sector. It argues that digital reform in law is not limited to technical modernization, but reflects a broader institutional shift involving administrative capacity, governance quality, access to justice, and data transparency. Using a qualitative, analytical, and comparative approach, the study draws on secondary sources, including legal and policy literature, official judicial statistics, and digital governance data. The findings show that digital transformation in the justice sector remains uneven across jurisdictions. Large interstate variations in non-uploaded judicial orders, digital record availability, and workload intensity suggest that the benefits of court digitalization are not uniformly distributed. National-level case-flow data indicate that disposals currently exceed new filings, yet high shares of criminal pendency, undated cases, and excessive dated cases continue to constrain judicial efficiency. The Delhi illustration further reveals that undertrial burdens are uneven even within a single metropolitan jurisdiction. The study concludes that digital justice should be understood as both a technological and governance project. Effective reform requires not only digital infrastructure, but also institutional coordination, reliable justice-data management, workload-sensitive implementation, and people-centred policy design to ensure inclusive, transparent, and accountable justice delivery.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨数字正义与电子治理如何变革法律系统，以印度司法部门为例，发现数字转型在不同司法管辖区进展不均，强调数字正义既是技术项目也是治理项目，需要制度协调、数据管理和以人为本的政策设计。
AI.research_question: 数字正义和电子治理如何变革法律系统？印度司法部门的数字化转型在多大程度上实现了公平、透明和高效的司法服务？
AI.motivation: 数字技术在司法领域的应用日益普及，但数字改革是否仅停留在技术现代化层面，还是反映了更深层次的制度变革？不同司法辖区的数字化转型效果是否存在显著差异？
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字正义理论、电子治理理论、制度变迁理论、司法效率与可及性理论
AI.method: 采用定性、分析性和比较研究方法，基于二手资料（法律和政策文献、官方司法统计数据、数字治理数据）进行分析。
AI.findings: (1) 司法部门数字化转型在不同司法管辖区进展不均，司法命令未上传、数字记录可用性和工作量强度存在显著的邦际差异；(2) 全国层面结案量超过新立案量，但刑事积案、未标日期案件和超期案件比例高企；(3) 德里案例显示即使在同一都市辖区内，待审案件负担也不均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数字正义重新概念化为技术项目与治理项目的双重属性，揭示了数字化转型的制度性维度而非单纯的技术升级。
AI.practical_contributions: 为司法数字化转型提供政策建议：需要数字基础设施、制度协调、可靠的司法数据管理、工作量敏感的实施方案以及以人为本的政策设计，以确保包容、透明和负责任的司法服务。

detail.title: The Agentic Economy: Humans, AI Agents, Robots, and the Measurable Transition toward Distributed Economic Action

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this manuscript. The authors’ institutional affiliations are disclosed in the manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it did not involve human participants, patients, animals, interviews, experiments, or personal/sensitive data. The study is based exclusively on publicly available institutional and aggregate statistical sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This article develops the concept of the agentic economy and empirically diagnoses its measurable preconditions: an emerging transition in which economic action is increasingly distributed among humans, AI agents, industrial robots, executable protocols, compute infrastructures and energy systems. The paper argues that classical categories such as labour, capital, firm, market, productivity and trust remain essential, but are no longer sufficient when technologies do not merely raise productivity but also prepare decisions, coordinate workflows, support or execute tasks, verify transactions and reshape responsibility. Methodologically, the study applies a conceptual-empirical quantitative diagnostic design rather than a causal econometric model. It uses public institutional data on AI investment, AI adoption, industrial robot installations and operational stock, data-centre electricity demand and labour-market reallocation. The reported values are transformed through transparent calculations including percentage-point change, relative growth, compound annual growth rate, growth multiplier, stock-flow ratio, concentration ratio and Herfindahl-Hirschman Index. The results indicate that the measurable preconditions of the agentic economy are already visible: AI adoption is accelerating in official and organisational indicators; AI investment is a broad capital-allocation signal rather than a direct measure of new productive capital allocation; industrial robots are treated not as full autonomous agents but as persistent cyber-physical action capacity; AI-related compute expansion contributes to wider data-centre electricity pressure; and available labour-market projections are more consistent with task reallocation than with simple labour disappearance. The article contributes a new action-capacity framework that links model/software-agent capacity, robotic capacity, compute-energy coupling, protocolisation, auditable trust and human sovereignty. The findings support a disciplined claim: the agentic economy is not yet a completed global institutional order, and the present article does not directly measure full agentic delegation; rather, its transition pressure is sufficiently measurable to require a distinct economic vocabulary, a reproducible diagnostic methodology and future sector-level measurement of coordination friction, auditability, protocol failure and human override capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"代理经济体"概念，并通过实证诊断了其可测量的先决条件。研究发现，AI投资、工业机器人、算力扩张和劳动力市场重组等指标表明，经济行动正日益在人类、AI代理、机器人和基础设施之间重新分配，但这一转型尚未完成，需要新的经济词汇、可复现的诊断方法和未来对协调摩擦、可审计性等指标的测量。
AI.research_question: "代理经济体"的可测量先决条件是否已经显现？经济行动在人类、AI代理、工业机器人、协议、算力基础设施和能源系统之间的重新分配达到何种程度？
AI.motivation: 传统经济概念（劳动、资本、企业、市场、生产率和信任）在技术不仅提高生产率，还准备决策、协调工作流、支持或执行任务、验证交易并重塑责任的时代已不足以解释经济现象，需要新的概念框架和诊断方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理经济体（Agentic Economy）概念；行动-能力框架（Action-Capacity Framework），链接模型/软件代理能力、机器人能力、算力-能源耦合、协议化、可审计信任和人类主权。
AI.method: 概念-实证定量诊断设计，而非因果计量模型。使用公共机构数据（AI投资、AI采纳、工业机器人安装和运营存量、数据中心电力需求、劳动力市场再分配），通过百分比变化、相对增长、复合年增长率、增长乘数、存量-流量比、集中度比率和赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数等透明计算转换。
AI.findings: 1. AI采纳在官方和组织指标中加速；2. AI投资是广泛的资本配置信号而非新生产性资本配置的直接度量；3. 工业机器人被视为持续的赛博物理行动能力而非完全自主代理；4. AI相关算力扩张加剧了数据中心电力压力；5. 劳动力市场预测更符合任务重新分配而非简单劳动力消失。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的"行动-能力框架"，将模型/软件代理能力、机器人能力、算力-能源耦合、协议化、可审计信任和人类主权概念整合为一个分析框架，为理解技术驱动的经济转型提供了新的理论词汇。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可复现的定量诊断方法，可用于监测代理经济体的发展；揭示了AI投资作为资本配置信号而非直接生产力指标的实际含义；强调了未来需要测量协调摩擦、可审计性、协议失效和人类覆盖能力等关键指标。

title: Matihiko Minds: Evaluating Cultural Safety and Human Governance in AI-Mediated Mentoring for Indigenous Youth
affiliations: , Eastern Institute of Technology, Toi Matarua Centre and Toi Matarua Centre

detail.title: Matihiko Minds: Evaluating Cultural Safety and Human Governance in AI-Mediated Mentoring for Indigenous Youth

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was conducted and approved by the Research Ethics Approval Committee (ref number: LR25180925 ) on 8th Oct 2025. Informed consent was obtained from all participants involved in the blinded evaluation.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was provided

detail.abstract: As generative AI becomes increasingly embedded in youth-facing digital support and mentoring contexts, questions of trust, cultural safety, and accountable governance become as important as technical performance. This paper presents Matihiko (digital) Minds, a human-governed evaluation framework for AI-mediated mentoring in Indigenous youth contexts in Aotearoa New Zealand. The study examined ten culturally situated mentoring scenarios spanning identity, wellbeing, and educational or career transitions. Candidate responses generated by compact large language models were first subjected to transparent governance screening designed to identify visible markers of caution, privacy awareness, contextual restraint, and supportive guidance. Final responses were then produced through a governed synthesis process and independently evaluated by twenty Māori cultural advisors using a weighted rubric covering relevance, accuracy, reasoning, evidence, cultural safety, ethics, and instruction-following. The findings show marked scenario dependence in response quality and reveal a consistent misalignment between structural screening scores and human cultural judgements. Profiles that satisfied more visible governance checks were not necessarily those rated most culturally adequate, indicating that automated screening cannot serve as a proxy for culturally grounded human evaluation. The study argues that AI-mediated mentoring should be treated not simply as a model-output problem, but as a socio-technical governance challenge in which human oversight, local accountability, and cultural judgement remain indispensable. Our study contributes a practical framework for evaluating culturally sensitive digital mentoring systems and offers implications for the responsible design and governance of youth-facing AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Matihiko Minds框架，一个针对新西兰毛利青少年AI辅导场景中的人工治理评估框架。研究发现，自动化筛查分数与毛利文化顾问的人文判断之间存在系统性偏差，表明AI辅导评估不能依赖技术筛查，而必须纳入文化判断和人工监督。
AI.research_question: 在面向原住民青少年的AI辅导场景中，自动化治理筛查能否替代基于文化背景的人文评估？结构化筛查分数与文化充分性判断之间是否一致？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI越来越多地嵌入面向青少年的数字支持和辅导场景中，信任、文化安全和问责治理变得与技术性能同等重要，但现有评估框架缺乏对文化敏感性的系统考量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会技术治理理论；AI辅导不应仅被视为模型输出问题，而应被视为社会技术治理挑战。
AI.method: 研究设计：10个文化情景化的辅导场景；第一阶段：对紧凑型大语言模型的回答进行透明治理筛查（标记谨慎、隐私意识、情境约束和支持性指导）；第二阶段：通过治理合成生成最终回答，由20位毛利文化顾问使用加权评分表（相关性、准确性、推理、证据、文化安全、伦理、指令遵循）进行独立评估。
AI.findings: 回答质量存在显著的情景依赖性；结构化筛查分数与人文文化判断之间存在系统性偏差——通过更多可见治理检查的回答并不一定被评为文化上更充分，表明自动化筛查不能替代基于文化的人文评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI辅导重新概念化为社会技术治理挑战而非单纯的模型输出问题，强调在AI评估中文化判断和人文监督的不可替代性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估文化敏感型数字辅导系统提供了可操作的实践框架；为面向青少年的AI负责任设计与治理提供了启示。

title: Casting Aspersions
affiliations: University of Michigan Law School

detail.title: Casting Aspersions

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming in 29 Stanford Technology Law Review (2026)
U of Michigan Public Law Research Paper No. 25-041
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Michigan Law School, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
During the initial three-quarters of the 20th Century, the copyright bar of the United States was small, homogenous, and cordial. 50 years later, it is larger, more diverse, polarized, and hostile. In this essay, I suggest that one factor contributing to the hostility is copyright lawyers' disappointment with the laws that Congress encouraged them to craft for themselves. Although copyright lawyers repeatedly negotiated the substance and language of copyright legislation to meet their own specifications, they expected those laws to deliver too much and felt betrayed when the laws failed to work as they had hoped. 

Owners of copyrights claim that the copyright law should give them full control of all commercially valuable uses of their works. The law has never secured control that extensive, but over the past 60 years, copyright owners have tried repeatedly to fix that. They have believed that they had succeeded in markedly improving their position. Those efforts proved disappointing. Representatives of copyright owners have expressed that disappointment with grievance and have come to believe that the interests they see as their opponents must be acting in bad faith. 

The copyright system is currently facing important challenges. I suggest that if copyright lawyers can't move past their suspicion and mistrust, any proposed response to those challenges is likely to make them worse rather than better.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国版权律师群体从20世纪初的小规模、同质化、友好，演变为如今更大、更多元、两极分化且充满敌意的过程。作者认为，导致这种敌意的因素之一是版权律师对自己参与制定的版权法感到失望——他们期望过高，当法律未能如愿运作时便感到被背叛，进而将不满归咎于对立方的恶意。
AI.research_question: 美国版权律师群体为何从早期的小规模、同质化、友好演变为如今更大、更多元、两极分化且充满敌意的状态？其中版权律师对自身参与制定的法律的失望扮演了什么角色？
AI.motivation: 版权系统当前面临重要挑战，而版权律师群体内部的怀疑与不信任可能使任何应对方案变得更加糟糕。作者希望揭示这种敌意的根源，以便找到改善现状的途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律制度的社会建构理论；法律制定的"委托-代理"问题；群体极化与冲突理论；法律期望与失望的心理机制。
AI.method: 规范性法律评论（essay形式），基于对美国版权立法历史演变的分析与观察。
AI.findings: 1. 版权律师群体的规模、多样性和对立程度发生了显著变化；2. 版权所有人对法律赋予的控制权期望过高，虽多次立法努力但始终未能实现完全控制；3. 期望与现实的落差被转化为对对立方的愤怒和猜疑，认为对方行为不诚信；4. 这种不信任情绪可能对未来版权改革产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将法律从业者群体的情感变化（失望、背叛感、敌意）纳入对版权法律发展的分析框架，超越了传统的经济激励或利益集团博弈视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示政策制定者和法律从业者：版权改革需要超越群体间的敌意与不信任，否则任何改革措施都可能适得其反。为缓解版权领域极化对立提供了心理学和社会学层面的解释与干预思路。

title: An Asymmetric Weighted Moving Average for Monetary Aggregates Evidence from the United States and Brazil
affiliations: ESPM Sao Paulo-Brazil and Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio)

detail.title: An Asymmetric Weighted Moving Average for Monetary Aggregates Evidence from the United States and Brazil

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Gerson de Souza Júnior is employed at Hashdex, a digital asset investment firm. João Paulo Mayall is an independent investor with interests in financial and digital assets. The research is descriptive in nature, uses publicly available data, and was conducted independently of any commercial mandate. The views expressed are solely those of the authors and do not represent the positions of any affiliated institution.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study analyzes publicly available aggregate monetary and price-index time series from the Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED), the Banco Central do Brasil System of Time Series (SGS), and the Center for Financial Stability. No human subjects, animal subjects, or personally identifiable data were involved in the research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All data are obtained from publicly available sources (FRED, Banco Central do Brasil SGS, and Center for Financial Stability).

detail.abstract: We develop an asymmetric triangular weighted moving average (WMA) for smoothing monetary aggregates, motivated by the empirical regularity that monetary transmission operates with lags of 6-18 months. The kernel assigns configurable backward and forward half-widths (h b , h f), and our baseline specification (h b =10, h f =4) places approximately 87% of the weight on past and current observations. Cross-correlation analysis confirms a systematic 3-month lag relative to the symmetric version, and a sensitivity grid over 18 parameter combinations shows the lag-smoothness trade-off is monotonic and well-behaved. Frequency-domain analysis shows that the asymmetric kernel attenuates high-frequency noise more aggressively while preserving trend dynamics at business-cycle frequencies. We position the filter relative to existing alternatives-Henderson, Christiano-Fitzgerald, and Hamilton's regression filter-and show explicitly how it compares with the Hodrick-Prescott trend. We apply the filter to three monetary aggregates-the Federal Reserve's M2, the True Money Supply (TMS-2) grounded in Austrian monetary theory, and the CFS Divisia M4 index-for the United States (1959-2026) and Brazil (2002-2026). A key empirical finding is that lagged cross-correlations between monetary-aggregate growth and price-index growth peak at 21-26 months for M2 and Divisia M4 (with ρ ≈ 0.45 in the US and ρ ≈ 0.44 for Brazilian TMS vs. IPCA), confirming the transmission-lag framework. By contrast, US TMS-2 fails to predict prices at any lag, a heterogeneity result we interpret as a consequence of TMS-2's inclusion of high-frequency demand-deposit noise. Structural break analysis via dynamic programming reveals that all three aggregates detect regime changes in the 2020s but at different dates and magnitudes, with TMS-2 uniquely capturing 1980s deregulation breaks and Divisia M4 uniquely detecting the 2009 financial crisis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种非对称三角加权移动平均（WMA）滤子用于平滑货币总量，该滤子通过可配置的前后窗口宽度捕捉货币传导的6-18个月滞后规律。对美国（1959-2026）和巴西（2002-2026）的M2、True Money Supply（TMS-2）和CFS Divisia M4的实证分析表明，M2和Divisia M4的滞后交叉相关性在21-26个月达到峰值（美国ρ≈0.45，巴西TMS vs IPCA ρ≈0.44），而TMS-2无法预测价格。结构断点分析显示不同货币总量对不同历史事件的检测能力存在异质性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种非对称移动平均滤子来更好地匹配货币传导的滞后特征？不同货币总量（M2、TMS-2、Divisia M4）在预测价格和检测结构断点方面的表现有何差异？
AI.motivation: 货币传导存在6-18个月的实证滞后规律，而现有平滑方法（如对称移动平均、Hodrick-Prescott滤子等）未充分考虑这一非对称性，可能导致货币信号的错位或噪声污染。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非对称三角加权移动平均滤子、交叉相关性分析、频域分析、结构断点动态规划检测、奥地利学派货币理论（TMS-2的理论基础）
AI.method: 提出非对称三角加权移动平均滤子（基线参数h_b=10, h_f=4，过去与当期权重约87%），通过交叉相关性分析、灵敏度网格（18种参数组合）、频域分析进行滤子特性评估，并将滤子应用于美国（1959-2026）和巴西（2002-2026）的三种货币总量数据进行实证检验。
AI.findings: （1）非对称WMA相较对称版本存在系统性3个月滞后，滞平滑权衡呈单调性；（2）频域上更激进地衰减高频噪声，同时保留商业周期频率的趋势动态；（3）M2和Divisia M4的滞后交叉相关性在21-26个月达到峰值（美国ρ≈0.45，巴西TMS vs IPCA ρ≈0.44）；（4）TMS-2无法预测任何滞后的价格变动；（5）三种货币总量均检测到2020年代体制变化，但时间点和幅度不同；TMS-2独特捕捉1980年代放松管制断点，Divisia M4独特检测2009年金融危机。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出了将货币传导滞后嵌入滤子设计的理论框架，超越了传统对称滤子的理论假设；（2）通过跨货币总量和跨国比较，揭示了不同货币总量定义对预测能力和断点检测的理论差异；（3）为TMS-2无法预测价格提供了基于高频噪声的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为央行和宏观经济学家提供了一种可配置的货币平滑工具，可灵活调整前后窗口以适应不同经济体的传导滞后特征；（2）揭示了M2和Divisia M4在价格预测方面的优势，对货币政策的指标选择具有参考价值；（3）结构断点分析为识别历史上不同经济体制变迁提供了差异化视角。

title: Crisis, Domestic Workers and Socio-Economic Rights
affiliations: University of Glasgow

detail.title: Crisis, Domestic Workers and Socio-Economic Rights
detail.abstract: Despite providing services that are essential for the sustainability of societies, economies and families, migrant domestic workers face important challenges when it comes to enjoying key socioeconomic rights such as fair wages and social protection. I argue that to understand this paradox and to effectively ensure domestic workers' rights, we need to examine the impacts of the enduring crisis of social reproduction, brought into stark relief by the Covid19 pandemic. The chapter starts by providing an account of the nature and multiple manifestations of social reproduction crisis. I then show the different ways the enduring crisis of social reproduction impacts on domestic workers socioeconomic rights. The chapter finally discusses different strategies that use the law to improve domestic workers' access to socioeconomic rights. Emergencies of the scale of the Covid19 pandemic tend to exacerbate existing disadvantages but can also renew political and societal debates and provide much-needed impetus for positive changes provided there are actors willing and able to carry these forwards.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了社会再生产危机（以新冠疫情为凸显）如何影响移民家政工人的社会经济权利，并分析了利用法律改善其权利的战略。
AI.research_question: 如何理解移民家政工人在提供关键服务的同时却无法享有公平工资和社会保障等社会经济权利这一悖论？社会再生产危机如何影响其权利？
AI.motivation: 移民家政工人对社会、经济和家庭的可持续性至关重要，但其社会经济权利（如公平工资、社会保护）却面临严重挑战。新冠疫情使社会再生产危机更加凸显，为理解这一悖论提供了契机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会再生产危机理论——分析资本主义社会中家庭、社区和护理劳动领域的持续危机及其多维表现。
AI.method: 理论分析与文献综述相结合的论证方法。
AI.findings: 1. 社会再生产危机具有多重表现形态，且持续存在；2. 该危机从多个维度侵蚀移民家政工人的社会经济权利；3. 新冠疫情等大规模紧急事件虽会加剧既有不平等，但也可能通过激活政治和社会辩论为积极变革提供动力；4. 法律策略（如立法改革、法律倡导）是改善家政工人权利的重要途径，但需要有意愿且有能力的行为主体推动。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会再生产危机理论与移民家政工人权利问题有机结合，揭示了结构性危机与个体权利剥夺之间的因果链条，为理解"服务不可或缺却权利严重缺失"的悖论提供了系统性的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了从社会再生产危机视角审视家政工人权利的框架；2. 提出了利用法律改善家政工人社会经济权利的具体策略路径；3. 指出危机时刻（如疫情）也可成为推动积极变革的窗口，为行动者提供了战略方向。

title: A Deep Learning Survival Model for Clinical Stage IA Lung Adenocarcinoma: Analyzing 3D-ResNet-9 Predictions and Their Association with Pathological Risk Factors
affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - Sun Yat-Sen University Cancer Center, Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - Sun Yat-Sen University Cancer Center, Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - Department of Gastric Surgery, Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU), Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - Sun Yat-Sen University Cancer Center, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU)

detail.title: A Deep Learning Survival Model for Clinical Stage IA Lung Adenocarcinoma: Analyzing 3D-ResNet-9 Predictions and Their Association with Pathological Risk Factors
detail.abstract: Objective: This study aimed to develop a CT-based deep learning (DL) model (3D-ResNet-9) to predict disease-free survival (DFS) in clinical stage IA lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) and to validate its association with high-risk histopathology.,Methods: A total of 1,037 patients were enrolled in this retrospective study from two centers. The patients were divided into a training set (n = 742), an internal validation set (n = 215), and an external validation set (n = 80). The performance of the DL and clinical models was assessed using the C-index. Associations between DL model prediction score, DFS, and histopathology (aggressive subtypes, lymph node metastasis, visceral pleural invasion, and lymphovascular invasion) were evaluated using Cox and logistic regression analyses.,Results: The DL model achieved C-index values of 0.67 and 0.68 on the internal and external validation sets, which were comparable to the clinical model (0.72 and 0.73, respectively; all P > 0.05). The DL model prediction score independently predicted DFS in clinical stage IA LUAD, with hazard ratios (HRs) of 12.62 and 18.86 in the internal and external validation sets (P < 0.05), respectively. It also predicted DFS in pathological stage IA LUAD (HR = 2.117, P < 0.001). After adjustment for CT features, DL model prediction score correlated with aggressive LUAD and lymph node metastasis, beyond CT features (T-stage and composition).,Conclusions: The DL model developed in this study provided effective DFS prediction for risk stratification in stage IA LUAD. Its output correlated with high-risk histopathology independently of CT semantics, improving model interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个基于CT的3D-ResNet-9深度学习模型，用于预测临床IA期肺腺癌的无病生存期（DFS）。在1037名患者的多中心回顾性研究中，该模型C-index达0.67-0.68，与临床模型相当。模型预测评分独立预测DFS，并与高危组织病理学特征（侵袭性亚型、淋巴结转移等）显著相关，且独立于CT语义特征，提高了模型可解释性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用CT影像的深度学习模型预测临床IA期肺腺癌的无病生存期，并验证其与高危组织病理学的关联？
AI.motivation: 临床IA期肺腺癌术后复发风险存在异质性，现有临床模型对DFS预测能力有限。CT影像中蕴含丰富的肿瘤微环境信息，深度学习模型可能捕捉到人眼无法识别的影像特征，从而更准确地预测预后，并与组织病理学特征建立关联，增强模型的可解释性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习（3D-ResNet-9）用于CT影像特征提取与生存预测；Cox比例风险模型用于评估预测评分与DFS的独立关联；逻辑回归分析用于评估模型评分与高危组织病理学特征（侵袭性亚型、淋巴结转移、脏层胸膜侵犯、淋巴血管侵犯）的相关性。
AI.method: 回顾性多中心研究，共纳入1037例患者（训练集742例，内部验证集215例，外部验证集80例）。构建3D-ResNet-9深度学习模型，以C-index评估模型性能。采用Cox回归分析评估DL模型预测评分与DFS的独立关联，逻辑回归分析评估其与高危组织病理学特征的相关性，并在调整CT特征后验证其独立预测价值。
AI.findings: DL模型在内部和外部验证集的C-index分别为0.67和0.68，与临床模型（0.72和0.73）无显著差异（P>0.05）。DL模型预测评分独立预测临床IA期DFS（HR=12.62-18.86）和病理IA期DFS（HR=2.117）。调整CT特征后，评分仍与侵袭性LUAD和淋巴结转移显著相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了深度学习模型可以从CT影像中提取独立于传统CT语义特征（T分期、影像组成）的预后信息，为"影像-病理关联"提供了新的证据，拓展了影像组学在肺癌预后预测中的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种非侵入性、基于常规CT影像的IA期肺腺癌风险分层工具，可辅助临床医生识别高危患者，指导术后随访和辅助治疗决策。模型评分与组织病理学的关联增强了模型的可解释性和临床信任度。

title: Taxing supply of “Obligation to refrain from an Act, or to Tolerate an Act or a Situation”: High Court Elucidates Indian GST Law Provisions
affiliations: Supreme Court of India

detail.title: Taxing supply of “Obligation to refrain from an Act, or to Tolerate an Act or a Situation”: High Court Elucidates Indian GST Law Provisions
detail.abstract:
The Goods and Services Tax (GST) regime was introduced in India in the year 2017 towards reforming the existing indirect tax landscape. As a deliberate design, variety of existing indirect taxes were subsumed and replaced by GST. Many legal concepts under the existing indirect tax legislations, however, have been continued under the GST legislations. For illustration, the omnibus scheme under the erstwhile service tax laws of christening anything other than goods as ‘services’ and thereby bring within the tax fold all non-descript activities, has been continued under the GST legislations. Similar to the fate under the service tax laws, this design of the GST laws has resulted into a contentious position and is heavily litigated. 

This article attempts to demystify the broad taxation scheme of GST legislations in context of a recent decision of the Bombay High Court which declares that amounts payable under court settlements are not services so as to be treated as taxable supplies under GST legislations. While one may treat it as an obvious conclusion that court settlement is not a taxable supply, there is a further need for greater judicial clarity in order to obviate unintended GST consequences in view of the overarching legislative scheme.

AI.tldr: 本文分析印度GST税制下法院和解金是否构成应税服务，结合孟买高等法院判例指出法院和解金不属于服务，但GST法泛化的"服务"定义仍存在争议，需要进一步的司法澄清。
AI.research_question: 在印度GST税制框架下，法院和解协议项下应付款项是否构成"服务"，从而属于应税供应？
AI.motivation: 印度GST法延续了旧服务税法中将"非货物"一概视为"服务"的兜底设计，导致法院和解金是否应税存在争议和大量诉讼，需要司法澄清。
AI.theoretical_framework: 印度GST立法中的"服务"定义（非货物即为服务）；服务税法中的兜底征税原则；供应判定理论。
AI.method: 判例分析法：以孟买高等法院近期判决为核心，结合GST立法体系进行法律解释与分析。
AI.findings: 孟买高等法院判定法院和解金不属于"服务"，不构成应税供应。但GST法泛化的定义设计仍可能导致其他非典型场景下的税务不确定性，需要更高层级的司法澄清。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了GST立法中"服务"定义的过度宽泛所导致的法律不确定性，辨析了"服务"概念在税法中的边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度企业和纳税人在和解协议场景下的GST合规提供判例指引；提示立法者需进一步完善"服务"的定义以降低诉讼风险。

title: Bayesian Interpretations of English Tort Law: From Epistemic Responsibility to Expected Utility
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Bayesian Interpretations of English Tort Law: From Epistemic Responsibility to Expected Utility
detail.abstract: We propose a Bayesian framework for English tort law in which the core misrepresentation doctrines act as constraints on rational belief formation and information transmission. The Cromwell Rule supplies the normative principle: a representor who asserts a fact while holding a posterior of zero on its truth commits a tort, and severity is measured by the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the defendant's true posterior and the posterior implicit in the representation. The graduated liability structure (fraud, negligence, duty to correct) maps onto a hierarchy of KL-divergence thresholds; a subjective/objective Bayes duality formalises the distinction between fraud and negligence; the Re H civil-fraud rule is a Bayesian prior adjustment, exactly as forensic likelihood ratios operate; and Wald's Sequential Probability Ratio Test yields the optimal correction-timing rule for the duty to correct. The classical multi-Bayesian literature furnishes the apparatus for adversarial inference, expert testimony, and jury aggregation. The damages principles of Derry v Peek, Doyle v Olby, and SAAMCO follow from Savage's subjective expected utility once the participation threshold is identified, and Fisher information furnishes a continuous definition of materiality. We apply the framework to the Greensill Capital collapse, in which a combined Bayes factor from two internal emails establishes fraudulent misrepresentation causing losses exceeding $143 million.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了英国侵权法（尤其是虚假陈述规则）的贝叶斯框架，将核心虚假陈述原则视为理性信念形成与信息传递的约束，用KL散度、序贯概率比检验等贝叶斯工具形式化解释欺诈、过失、更正义务等法律概念，并应用于Greensill Capital案。
AI.research_question: 如何用贝叶斯统计框架形式化解释英国侵权法中关于虚假陈述的核心法律原则？
AI.motivation: 法律中的虚假陈述规则（欺诈、过失、更正义务）本质上涉及信念形成和信息传递，但现有法律理论缺乏统一的形式化框架来刻画这种信念更新的理性约束，作者试图用贝叶斯推理来桥接法律推理与统计学。
AI.theoretical_framework: Cromwell规则（后验概率不可为0或1）、KL散度（衡量错误陈述严重性）、主观/客观贝叶斯对偶（区分欺诈与过失）、Wald序贯概率比检验（最优更正时机）、Savage主观期望效用（损害赔偿原则）、Fisher信息量（实质性定义）。
AI.method: 理论建构为主，结合形式化数学推导与案例应用（Greensill Capital collapse数据验证）。
AI.findings: 虚假陈述的层级责任（欺诈、过失、更正义务）可映射到KL散度阈值层次；Re H民事欺诈规则等价于贝叶斯先验调整；Derry v Peek等判例的损害赔偿原则可从主观期望效用中推导；Greensill Capital案中两封内部邮件的联合贝叶斯因子证实欺诈性虚假陈述造成超1.43亿美元损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将贝叶斯决策理论、信息论（KL散度、Fisher信息）与普通法虚假陈述教义进行严格对应，为法律推理提供量化基础，并建立"法律贝叶斯主义"的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院评估虚假陈述提供可操作的贝叶斯检验方法；为损害赔偿计算提供SEU框架；通过Greensill Capital案例展示了实际应用路径。

title: Copayments and the Value of Health Insurance: Experimental Evidence from Uganda
affiliations: University of Zurich, LSE Finance Department and Columbia University

detail.title: Copayments and the Value of Health Insurance: Experimental Evidence from Uganda
detail.abstract: How do copayments affect the benefits and costs of health insurance in low-income settings? We study this question in a field experiment in rural Uganda that varies copayments for hospital-based outpatient insurance. Insurance substantially increases the use of high-quality hospital care, improves health, and reduces reliance on costly coping strategies. Lower copayments generate larger increases in utilization, yet health and financial-protection gains are similar across copayment levels. Net benefits derived from treatment effects on health outcomes and insurer costs favor higher copayments. At the same time, households place substantially higher value on low-copayment insurance, underlining that optimal copayment design depends on jointly understanding treatment effects, insurer costs, and household demand.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在乌干达农村的田野实验，研究不同共付额水平对低收入人群医疗保险收益与成本的影响，发现低共付额虽增加医疗服务利用，但健康改善和财务保护效果与高共付额相似，且家庭更偏好低共付额保险。
AI.research_question: 在低收入环境中，共付额如何影响健康保险的收益与成本？
AI.motivation: 低收入国家健康保险设计中，共付额（copayments）的设置是关键但研究不足的问题，尤其是其对医疗利用、健康结果和财务保护的综合影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 保险需求理论、道德风险理论、健康生产函数
AI.method: 在乌干达农村开展田野实验（field experiment），随机变化医院门诊保险的共付额水平，收集医疗利用、健康结果、财务保护和家庭需求等数据进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）保险显著增加高质量医院服务利用、改善健康、减少昂贵应对策略；（2）低共付额带来更大的利用率增长，但健康改善和财务保护效果在不同共付额水平间相似；（3）从健康效果和保险公司成本看，高共付额净收益更优；（4）家庭对低共付额保险的估值显著更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了低收入环境下共付额对保险收益与成本的非线性影响，区分了实际治疗效应与消费者偏好，为保险设计理论提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为低收入国家健康保险的共付额设计提供了实证依据，提示政策制定者需权衡医疗利用、健康收益、保险公司成本和家庭需求四个维度。

title: Learning in International Markets and a Rational Expectation Approach to the Contagion Puzzle
affiliations: University of Nevada Las Vegas

detail.title: Learning in International Markets and a Rational Expectation Approach to the Contagion Puzzle
detail.abstract: I develop a general equilibrium model in which agents from two countries do not observe directly the long-run growth prospects of their economies. Instead, the agents rationally learn the hidden components through the Kalman filter applied to international consumption data. Learning endogenously produces: a rational explanation of international contagion phenomenon, defined as changes in one country's asset prices in response to foreign news beyond what is mandated by fundamentals, as well as large and time-varying international equity risk premia. Model-simulated moments match previous empirical findings of key movements studied in the international finance literature.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个两国一般均衡模型，其中代理人无法直接观察经济的长期增长前景，而是通过卡尔曼滤波器从国际消费数据中理性学习隐藏成分。这种学习内生地产生了：国际传染现象的理性解释（即一国资产价格对超出基本面因素的国外新闻的反应），以及大规模且时变的国际股权风险溢价。模型模拟的矩与现有国际金融文献中的关键实证发现相匹配。
AI.research_question: 如何在不完全信息下，通过理性学习机制解释国际金融中观察到的传染现象和时变的风险溢价？
AI.motivation: 传统的国际金融模型难以同时解释国际传染现象和时变的股权风险溢价。作者试图通过引入理性学习（Kalman滤波）来提供一种统一的、微观基础的解释机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两国一般均衡模型、理性预期、卡尔曼滤波学习、不完全信息下的资产定价。
AI.method: 理论建模（一般均衡模型）与数值模拟。代理人通过卡尔曼滤波从国际消费数据中推断经济的隐藏增长成分。
AI.findings: (1) 理性学习内生地产生了国际传染现象——一国资产价格对国外新闻的过度反应；(2) 模型产生了大规模且时变的国际股权风险溢价；(3) 模拟结果与现有国际金融文献的关键实证发现一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 为国际传染现象提供了理性（非行为或非摩擦性）的解释渠道；将不完全信息与理性学习框架引入国际资产定价领域，建立了内生风险溢价的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助理解国际金融市场的联动机制和风险定价规律，对国际投资组合管理和风险评估具有参考价值。

title: General Wellness or Medical Device? Unaddressed Implications of the FDA's 2026 Guidance
affiliations: , Duke University, Duke University, Duke University and Duke University

detail.title: General Wellness or Medical Device? Unaddressed Implications of the FDA's 2026 Guidance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: JD is on the Google Consumer Health Advisory Board and is a consultant to Samsung Research America and Jones Day. KS is a current employee of IQVIA. SS and PA declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Authors were funded in part by the National Science Foundation (CAREER 2339669 (JD, SS) and GRFP DGE 2139754 (AS)).

contentType.other: Manuscript under consideration with Nature BME.

publicationDetails.detailsText: This article is a preprint and is currently under review with Nature BME.

detail.abstract: In January 2026, the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) issued updated guidance on General Wellness: Policy for Low-Risk Devices. As consumer wearable technologies increasingly measure physiologic parameters traditionally associated with clinical care, such as blood pressure and oxygen saturation, the regulatory distinctions between wellness and medical devices have become ever more important in terms of safety, innovation, and healthcare integration. The objective of this comment is to evaluate the regulatory and clinical implications of the FDA's 2026 General Wellness Guidance, with emphasis on validation standards, informational and behavioral safety risks, definitional boundaries between wellness and medical devices, and downstream effects on healthcare integration. The 2026 guidance permits general wellness products to display clinically analogous values if "validated" but does not define minimum methodological standards. Review of regulatory text and published validation frameworks identified four principal gaps: (1) insufficiently defined validation requirements for outputs that mimic clinical measurements; (2) unaddressed informational and behavioral safety risks; (3) internal inconsistencies in definitional boundaries between wellness and medical use; and (4) risk of market fragmentation that may simultaneously increase consumer confusion and impede long-term clinical integration. We argue that without clearer validation standards, transparency requirements, and structured pathways from wellness innovation to clinical application, the guidance risks creating a two-tier digital health ecosystem with unintended downstream consequences for consumer safety and clinical integration. Regulatory clarity must balance innovation with consumer protection and equitable healthcare access. Along these lines, we propose specific guidance refinements to strengthen validation standards, address informational risk, and support the responsible evolution of consumer wearables into clinically integrated tools.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了FDA 2026年《一般健康产品指南》对低风险健康设备的监管与临床影响，指出其在验证标准、信息与行为安全风险、健康与医疗设备定义边界以及医疗整合方面存在四大缺陷，并提出了相应的改进建议。
AI.research_question: FDA 2026年《一般健康产品指南》在监管和临床层面存在哪些不足？如何改进以平衡创新、消费者安全与医疗整合？
AI.motivation: 随着可穿戴设备越来越多地测量传统临床参数（如血压、血氧），健康设备与医疗设备之间的监管界限变得愈发重要，但2026年指南在验证标准等方面存在模糊之处，可能带来安全隐患和医疗整合障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管科学、健康设备分类理论、消费者安全与创新平衡框架
AI.method: 对FDA 2026年指南的监管文本进行审查，并结合已发表的验证框架进行对比分析
AI.findings: 识别出四大主要缺口：（1）验证要求定义不充分；（2）信息与行为安全风险未被充分关注；（3）健康与医疗设备定义边界存在内部不一致；（4）市场碎片化风险，可能导致消费者混淆并阻碍临床整合。
AI.theory_contributions: 为可穿戴健康设备的监管科学提供了批判性分析框架，明确了当前指南在消费者安全与临床整合方面的理论盲区。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的指南改进建议，包括加强验证标准、明确透明性要求、建立从健康创新到临床应用的制度化路径，以促进消费者可穿戴设备向临床整合工具的负责任演变。

title: Cognitive Delegation in Childhood: A Theory of Skill Formation under Generative AI
affiliations: and Keck School of Medicine University of Southern California

detail.title: Cognitive Delegation in Childhood: A Theory of Skill Formation under Generative AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: This paper develops a dynamic theory of childhood human-capital formation when a generative technology permits the production of educational output without the underlying cognitive process. We call such uses cognitive delegation and distinguish process-preserving use (active engagement above the capacity-formation threshold) from process-replacing use. The model is a discrete-time skill-formation framework in which a present-biased child accumulates knowledge, discipline, and judgment through effort, delegation, and verification, with age-dependent plasticity and a governance function setting the threshold. Solving the recursive problem under sophisticated quasi-hyperbolic preferences, we establish the Capacity-Wedge Decomposition: the long-run capacity wedge under process-replacing use admits an additive decomposition into a contemporaneous discipline-channel cost and a cascade cost from downstream knowledge complementarities. The marginal welfare cost is strictly decreasing in age, and under sufficient conditions admits a sharp threshold in governance, strictly increasing in AI capability. The framework identifies governance, not access, as the operative variable in the developmental effect of generative AI.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个童年人力资本形成的动态理论，研究生成式AI技术如何通过"认知代理"（即在不经历完整认知过程的情况下生产教育产出）影响儿童发展。模型区分了"过程保留型使用"（在能力形成阈值之上保持主动参与）和"过程替代型使用"。研究发现"能力楔形分解"：过程替代使用下的长期能力楔形可分解为当期纪律渠道成本和下游知识互补性的级联成本。边际福利成本随年龄严格递减，在治理强度上存在尖锐阈值，且该阈值随AI能力严格递增。核心结论是：治理（而非使用权限）是生成式AI影响儿童发展的关键变量。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI通过认知代理（允许在不经历底层认知过程的情况下生产教育产出）如何影响儿童的人力资本形成？特别是，治理（governance）机制如何在其中发挥调节作用？
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI在教育中的广泛应用（如学生直接用AI完成作业而不进行思考），迫切需要理解这种"认知代理"对儿童长期能力发展的影响机制。现有理论尚未系统区分不同的认知代理使用方式及其动态后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 离散时间技能形成框架；准双曲线贴现偏好（存在当下偏差）；年龄依赖的可塑性；治理函数设定能力形成阈值；认知代理使用分为"过程保留型"和"过程替代型"两种模式。
AI.method: 数学建模与动态递归求解：构建一个包含知识、纪律、判断三种能力的童年人力资本积累模型，个体在努力、代理与验证之间做出最优选择，在准双曲线偏好下求解递归问题。
AI.findings: 1）"能力楔形分解"：过程替代使用造成的长期能力差距可分解为当期纪律渠道成本与下游知识互补性的级联成本；2）边际福利成本随年龄严格递减（早期替代危害更大）；3）治理强度存在尖锐阈值，超过该阈值认知代理的危害急剧上升；4）该治理阈值随AI能力严格递增（AI能力越强，越需要更强的治理）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次系统区分了认知代理的"过程保留型"与"过程替代型"使用；2）提出了"能力楔形分解"定理，揭示了纪律渠道与知识互补渠道的双重作用机制；3）将治理（而非可及性）确立为分析生成式AI对儿童发展影响的关键理论变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者和家长提供了明确的指导：关键不是限制儿童对AI的"使用权限"，而是建立恰当的"治理机制"（如设定使用阈值、区分替代与辅助使用），且治理强度需要随AI能力提升而同步加强。早期教育阶段尤其需要更严格的治理。

title: K-shaped Economy or Not? Evidence From a Payments Survey
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta

detail.title: K-shaped Economy or Not? Evidence From a Payments Survey

keywords: changes in consumer spending over time D91

detail.abstract: Using transaction data from a payments survey in the United States, we analyze how consumers across income groups changed their spending between 2021 and 2025. We find that spending by consumers with high household income (fourth and fifth quintiles) grew substantially faster than spending by consumers with low household income (first to third quintiles), a pattern that holds across total spending, grocery spending, and spending on necessities. Both groups saw spending increases, but the gap in growth rates points to a widening of consumption inequality across the income distribution. Rather than the canonical K-shaped recovery-in which lower-income consumer spending declines while higher-income consumer spending expands-our findings point to a bifurcated recovery in which both groups' spending grew but at sharply divergent rates.

AI.tldr: 基于2021-2025年美国支付调查数据，研究发现高收入家庭（第四、五五分位）的消费增长速度显著快于低收入家庭（第一至三五分位），导致消费不平等加剧，呈现"分叉式复苏"而非传统的"K型复苏"。
AI.research_question: 不同收入群体的美国消费者在2021年至2025年间的支出增长模式如何变化？消费不平等是否在加剧？
AI.motivation: 已有研究多关注K型复苏（低收入消费下降、高收入消费上升），但现实中可能出现了两类群体消费均增长但增速差异显著的分叉式复苏，需要新的实证证据来刻画这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费不平等理论、K型复苏理论、分叉式复苏（Bifurcated Recovery）——即两类群体均增长但增速分化。
AI.method: 利用美国支付调查的交易数据，按收入五分位分组，对比2021-2025年间高收入群体（第四、五分位）与低收入群体（第一至三五分位）在总支出、杂货支出、必需品支出上的增长率差异。
AI.findings: （1）高收入家庭各维度支出增速显著快于低收入家庭；（2）两组支出均增长，但增速差距持续扩大；（3）消费不平等在收入分布中加剧；（4）呈现"分叉式复苏"——双方都增长但速度悬殊，而非传统K型复苏。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了"分叉式复苏"概念，修正了传统K型复苏理论的二元假设（一方增长一方下降），丰富了消费不平等在复苏期的动态理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供警示：即使经济整体复苏，不同收入群体的消费增速差异仍可能持续拉大消费不平等，需要针对低收入群体的定向刺激与保障措施。

title: Exploring Options-Based Agricultural Policies Lessons from Brazil and a Proposed Green-Linked Revenue Options Framework for the United Kingdom

detail.title: Exploring Options-Based Agricultural Policies Lessons from Brazil and a Proposed Green-Linked Revenue Options Framework for the United Kingdom

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declaration of Interest The author declares no conflicts of interest. This paper has no association with any financial institution, commodity broker, derivatives exchange, or agricultural lobby organisation. The Green-Linked Revenue Options framework is an independent academic contribution. The author holds no financial position in any instrument discussed in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human participants, patient data, clinical trials, or primary data collection requiring ethics review. All data cited are drawn from publicly available secondary sources, including government statistical releases, institutional reports, and peer-reviewed academic literature. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no dedicated external funding. It was conducted independently by the author in the course of doctoral research at the University of York, School for Business and Society. The underlying concept was granted a Proof of Concept Award coordinated by the University of York.

detail.abstract: Agricultural producers in the United Kingdom face compounding pressures from commodity price volatility, yield uncertainty, and the withdrawal of direct income support. Farm Business Income on cereal farms collapsed 73%-from £146,500 in 2022/23 to £39,400 in 2023/24-and is forecast to reach £17,000 in 2025/26, with production costs (c. £295/t) now exceeding average wheat prices (c. £189/t in 2024/25). Fewer than 5% of farm businesses engage with market-based income protection. Drawing on Brazil's "Contrato de Opção de Venda" (COV), this paper proposes the Green-Linked Revenue Options (GLRO) framework: an auction-based income floor mechanism integrating price risk protection with the sustainability conditionality of Environmental Land Management (ELM) and Sustainable Farming Incentive (SFI) schemes. The GLRO is fiscally adaptable, market-disciplined, and structurally complementary to the post-Brexit policy architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文针对英国谷物农场收入暴跌（2023/24年下降73%）且不足5%的农场使用市场收入保护工具的困境，借鉴巴西COV机制，提出“绿色关联收入期权（GLRO）框架”——一种将价格风险保护与ELM/SFI可持续性条件相结合的拍卖式收入下限机制，具有财政适应性、市场纪律性，并补充英国脱欧后的政策架构。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种既能为英国农业提供收入下限保护，又能整合环境可持续性条件的市场机制？
AI.motivation: 英国谷物农场收入急剧下降（2022/23至2023/24下降73%，预计2025/26降至£17,000），生产成本（£295/t）已超过小麦平均价格（£189/t），而市场化的收入保护工具使用率极低（不足5%），亟需一种新型机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴巴西Contrato de Opção de Venda（COV）期权拍卖机制，结合ELM和SFI可持续农业计划的条件性要求，构建公共-市场混合型收入保护框架。
AI.method: 政策设计研究：基于巴西COV的经验借鉴，提出GLRO框架设计，包括拍卖机制、价格下限设定、可持续性条件绑定等核心要素。
AI.findings: GLRO框架具有三重优势：财政适应性（政府可根据预算调整补贴规模）、市场纪律性（通过拍卖机制确定价格）、结构性互补性（与英国脱欧后的环境土地管理政策体系兼容）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融期权理论（拍卖式价格下限）与农业环境政策（可持续发展条件性）相结合，提出了一种新型的公共-市场混合型农业收入保护框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为英国农业政策制定者提供了一种可行的收入下限机制设计方案，解决了英国脱欧后直接收入支持退出、农业收入崩溃且市场化工具使用率低的现实困境，同时将收入保护与环境可持续性目标有机结合。

title: Yor's Identities as Algorithms
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Yor's Identities as Algorithms
detail.abstract: Marc Yor's probabilistic theory of Brownian motion is a source of algorithms for Bayesian computation. We establish three principal results. First, we derive the conditional Laplace transform of the integrated squared Bessel bridge given its endpoints, yielding the full conditional law of integrated volatility in Cox-Ingersoll-Ross particle learning. Second, we show that the Roynette-Vallois-Yor class of penalised path priors is closed under Bayesian updating with Girsanov likelihoods, providing a tractable prior family for generative Bayesian computation on diffusions. Third, we show that the half-Cauchy-squared mixing distribution of the horseshoe prior is a generalised gamma convolution with completely monotone density, finite Thorin mass, and an explicit Laplace exponent given by an exponential-complementary-error-function combination. Two additional contributions develop the same correspondence: a Matsumoto-Yor-inspired reflection move that empirically accelerates MCMC mixing in a log-linear regression with strongly correlated covariates, and a fractional Dufresne conjecture for rough volatility supported by preliminary numerical evidence. The Feynman-Kac formula and its McKean-Vlasov extension provide the unifying probabilistic framework.

AI.tldr: 本文建立布朗运动概率理论与贝叶斯计算之间的深层联系，推导条件拉普拉斯变换、惩罚路径先验的贝叶斯闭包性、以及horseshoe先验的广义伽马卷积表示，并提出加速MCMC的反射移动算法和分数阶Dufresne猜想。
AI.research_question: 如何利用Marc Yor的布朗运动概率理论为贝叶斯计算提供新的算法和理论基础？
AI.motivation: 布朗运动的概率理论（特别是Yor学派的工作）蕴含着丰富的算法可能性，但尚未被系统性地应用于贝叶斯计算中。
AI.theoretical_framework: Feynman-Kac公式及其McKean-Vlasov扩展；布朗运动、Bessel桥、惩罚路径先验、广义伽马卷积等概率理论。
AI.method: 理论推导（条件拉普拉斯变换、贝叶斯闭包性证明、广义伽马卷积表示）与数值实验（MCMC加速、粗糙波动率初步数值证据）。
AI.findings: 1. 推导了给定端点的积分平方Bessel桥的条件拉普拉斯变换；2. 证明Roynette-Vallois-Yor惩罚路径先验在Girsanov似然下对贝叶斯更新封闭；3. horseshoe先验的半Cauchy平方混合分布是广义伽马卷积；4. 提出Matsumoto-Yor启发式反射移动加速MCMC；5. 提出粗糙波动率的分数阶Dufresne猜想并给出初步数值支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了布朗运动概率论（Yor学派）与贝叶斯计算之间的系统对应关系，揭示了horseshoe先验的深层概率结构（广义伽马卷积），扩展了惩罚路径先验的贝叶斯适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CIR过程粒子学习中的积分波动率条件推断提供显式公式；为扩散模型的生成式贝叶斯计算提供可处理的先验族；提出加速MCMC混合的反射移动算法；提出粗糙波动率的新猜想供后续实证检验。

title: Mis-Remembrance of Things Past: Memory and Adaptation to Climate Change
affiliations: Harvard University

detail.title: Mis-Remembrance of Things Past: Memory and Adaptation to Climate Change
detail.abstract: Human memory is imperfect: we often fail to recall true events and invent false experiences. I examine the economic consequences of these cognitive limits for adaptation to climate change in rural Bangladesh. I elicit environmental memories, beliefs, and adaptation decisions from 2,279 farmers across three survey waves. Using both natural variation in daily weather and a series of experiments embedded in the survey design, I test the predictions of a recall-driven belief formation model featuring endogenous memory revision. I find evidence that the contemporaneous context causes memory reconstruction, distorting remembered features of past experiences. Memories impact both expectations about future environmental conditions and economic decisions pertaining to climate change adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究人类记忆的不完美性如何通过影响信念形成，进而影响孟加拉国农村地区农民的气候变化适应决策。通过三波调查数据、自然天气变化和实验设计，作者发现当前环境会重构记忆，扭曲过去经历的记忆，并影响未来预期和适应行为。
AI.research_question: 人类记忆的认知局限（如记忆重构）如何影响农民对气候变化的适应决策？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学假设理性预期，但现实中人类记忆存在系统性偏差，这些认知局限可能扭曲人们对过去经验的回忆，进而影响对未来风险的判断和适应性行为。理解这一机制对制定有效的适应政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 回忆驱动的信念形成模型（recall-driven belief formation），强调内生性记忆修订（endogenous memory revision），即当前情境会重构对过去经验的记忆。
AI.method: 利用孟加拉国农村2,279名农民的三波调查数据，结合自然天气变化和嵌入调查设计的系列实验，进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 1）当前情境会导致记忆重构，扭曲对过去经历的特征记忆；2）记忆影响人们对未来环境条件的预期；3）记忆进而影响与气候变化适应相关的经济决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 将认知心理学中的记忆重构机制引入经济学分析，构建了回忆驱动的信念形成模型，拓展了对非理性信念形成过程的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候变化适应政策制定提供启示：由于记忆偏差可能扭曲农民的决策，政策干预应考虑如何通过信息提供或教育来纠正记忆误差，促进更有效的适应行为。

title: On Constructing A Stronger Right To Strike Through Comparative Labor Law
affiliations: York University

detail.title: On Constructing A Stronger Right To Strike Through Comparative Labor Law
detail.abstract:
Comparative labor law scholars have long cautioned against a naïve belief that national labor laws can be exported and implemented into foreign labor relations systems. In some respects, the case of United States and Canadian labor law is the exception to the rule. Canada’s labor law model is heavily influenced by the design of U.S. “Wagner model”. However, common DNA does not mean a similar evolution. In important ways, Canada’s labor law model evolved along a very different trajectory than the National Labor Relations Act. This evolutionary divergence is evident in how the two countries regulate strikes. It is possible to imagine a reform agenda in which a more robust right to strike is constructed by cherry-picking elements of both countries' strike laws. However, this exercise is more complex than it might at first appear because strike laws are so tightly associated with the complex labor relations histories of nations. 

This essay was originally published on Harvard Law Review’s blog in January 2024. This version includes notes to supplement the text

AI.tldr: 本文比较了美国和加拿大罢工法的演变，指出尽管加拿大劳动法深受美国"瓦格纳模式"影响，但两国罢工法的发展轨迹存在显著差异。作者探讨了通过挑选两国法律要素来构建更强罢工权改革方案的可能性，但强调这一过程因罢工法与各国复杂劳动法历史紧密关联而极为复杂。
AI.research_question: 美国和加拿大罢工法是如何演化分化的？能否通过借鉴两国法律要素来构建更强有力的罢工权改革方案？
AI.motivation: 比较劳动法学者长期警示不要天真地认为国家劳动法可以简单输出并实施到外国劳动关系体系中，但美加案例似乎是例外。然而，共同的法律DNA并不意味着相似的演化路径，这种演化分歧在罢工法领域尤为明显，值得深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较劳动法理论、法律移植理论、制度演化理论
AI.method: 比较法学分析，通过对美国和加拿大罢工法的历史演变和制度设计进行对比研究
