AI.findings: 加拿大劳动法虽深受美国"瓦格纳模式"影响，但其罢工法沿着与美国《国家劳资关系法》截然不同的轨迹演化。两国罢工法的差异与各自复杂的劳动法历史紧密相连，简单"摘选"两国法律要素来构建更强罢工权的改革方案比表面上看起来更为复杂。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了即便在法律移植看似成功的案例（美加劳动法）中，制度演化仍可能产生显著分歧，挑战了简单的法律移植观念，丰富了比较劳动法理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为劳动法改革者提供了重要警示：罢工法的改革不能简单照搬或拼凑他国制度，必须深刻理解各国劳动法的历史背景和制度脉络。

title: Cooperation without Coercion: A Slack Commitment Rule for the Global Commons
affiliations: The University of Tokyo

detail.title: Cooperation without Coercion: A Slack Commitment Rule for the Global Commons
detail.abstract: This paper studies whether high-level cooperation in global commons can be sustained without coercion. I introduce a slack commitment rule for a committee subject to a citizen-sovereignty constraint: each participant states the maximum contribution it is willing to undertake, and no obligation may exceed that statement. The rule leaves only a small, rule-based margin between stated willingness and actual commitment, but uses category thresholds to link one participant's statement to the commitments of many others. This creates institutional pivotality in large populations. In a finite-player noncooperative game, I show that, when the population is large and thresholds are set appropriately, full acceptance of the contribution target is the unique Nash equilibrium, while stated willingness is almost fully converted into performance at every profile. The same logic contains exit cascades, supports group-based entry, and provides a recovery path from disequilibrium to cooperative equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种“宽松承诺规则”（slack commitment rule），通过类别阈值制度使委员会成员在受约束的自愿声明下实现全球公共品领域的高水平合作。研究表明，在大型群体中，当阈值设置适当时，完全接受贡献目标是唯一的纳什均衡，且声明意愿几乎完全转化为实际履约。
AI.research_question: 在没有强制力的情况下，全球公共品领域的高水平合作能否持续？
AI.motivation: 全球公共品（如气候变化、公共卫生等）面临“搭便车”困境，传统理论认为缺乏强制力时大型群体难以实现高水平合作。本文试图设计一种制度规则，在尊重主权（自愿承诺）的前提下实现可持续合作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非合作博弈论（纳什均衡）、制度设计理论、类别阈值制度、公民主权约束、承诺规则
AI.method: 有限参与者非合作博弈模型，引入“宽松承诺规则”和类别阈值机制，分析大型群体下的均衡结果。
AI.findings: 1) 当群体规模大且阈值设置适当时，完全接受贡献目标是唯一纳什均衡；2) 声明意愿几乎完全转化为实际履约；3) 该机制能遏制退出级联、支持群体进入、并提供从非均衡恢复至合作均衡的路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 证明了在无强制力条件下，通过制度设计（类别阈值+宽松承诺）可实现在大型群体中可持续的高水平合作；2) 提出了“制度性关键性”（institutional pivotality）概念，解释了为何在大量参与者中个人仍能影响集体结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球公共品治理（如气候协定、国际卫生合作）提供了制度设计思路：在尊重国家自愿承诺的前提下，通过阈值规则实现有效合作，遏制退出行为，并支持恢复机制。

title: The Non-Separability of Consumption, Leisure, and Air Pollution
affiliations: Colorado School of Mines - Division of Economics and Business

detail.title: The Non-Separability of Consumption, Leisure, and Air Pollution
detail.abstract: The interactions among consumption, leisure, and environmental quality are crucial for evaluating environmental regulations. In this study, we first estimate cross-price elasticities between consumption goods and leisure using imputed expenditure data for the respondents in the American Community Survey (ACS). We find a similar uncompensated substitution pattern between transportation and leisure as reported in the literature. Our decomposition shows that the above-Pigouvian optimal transport tax documented by West and Williams III (2007) for gasoline extends to our broader transportation measure and is driven entirely by non-homothetic transportation demand. Second, we estimate the causal effects of PM 2.5 on consumption and leisure using an instrumental variables approach. We find that a 1 µg/m3 increase in PM2.5 raises utility expenditure by 1.8% in the full sample, and reduces transportation expenditure by about 1% among households that did not move during the sample period. We do not find that air pollution affects the leisure time or working hours of employed individuals. Nor do we find significant impacts of PM2.5 on health expenditure. Our findings imply that leisure and air quality are non-separable from consumption, and emphasize the importance of accounting for these relationships when assessing the welfare effects of regulations.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国社区调查数据，估计了消费品与休闲之间的交叉价格弹性，以及PM2.5对消费和休闲的因果影响，发现交通与休闲之间存在替代关系、PM2.5增加会提高效用支出，强调在评估环境规制福利效应时需考虑消费、休闲与环境质量之间的非可分离性。
AI.research_question: 消费、休闲与环境质量之间的相互作用如何影响环境规制的福利评估？具体包括：（1）消费品与休闲之间的交叉价格弹性是多少？（2）PM2.5对消费和休闲的因果效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有环境规制福利评估通常假设消费、休闲与环境质量是可分离的，但这种假设可能不成立。本文旨在通过实证估计三者之间的相互作用关系，为更准确地评估环境规制的福利效应提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费-休闲-环境质量非可分离性的效用理论框架，结合Pigouvian最优税收理论，分析环境规制（如交通税）的次优调整。
AI.method: （1）利用美国社区调查（ACS）的推算支出数据，估计消费品与休闲之间的交叉价格弹性；（2）采用工具变量法（IV）估计PM2.5对消费和休闲的因果效应。
AI.findings: （1）交通与休闲之间存在非补偿替代关系，与已有文献一致；（2）高于Pigouvian最优水平的交通税完全由非位似（non-homothetic）的交通需求驱动；（3）PM2.5每增加1 µg/m³，全样本效用支出增加1.8%，未搬迁家庭交通支出减少约1%；（4）PM2.5对在职人员的休闲时间或工作时间无显著影响，对健康支出也无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证证明了消费、休闲与环境质量之间的非可分离性，为修正Pigouvian最优税收理论提供了经验基础；揭示了非位似性需求在环境税次优调整中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为环境规制（如交通税、空气污染治理政策）的福利效应评估提供了定量依据，提示政策制定者需考虑消费-休闲-环境质量的交互作用，避免传统可分离假设导致的福利误判。

title: Moral Regulation in Sequential Decisions
affiliations: , Dipartimento di Diritto, Economia e Culture, Università dell'Insubria and University of Insubria

detail.title: Moral Regulation in Sequential Decisions

declarations.ethicsApproval: The project was approved by the Ethical Committee of the University of Insubria
declarations.funderStatement: Italian Ministry of University and Research (MUR) under the “Department of Excellence 2023--2027” project, CUP J37G22000330001

detail.abstract:
Do individuals become more generous after harming others, or less generous after doing the right thing? We study whether moral behavior spills over across sequential decisions through moral accounting: individuals may offset prior moral debts through subsequent prosocial behavior (moral cleansing) or draw on prior moral credits to justify lower generosity (moral licensing). 
In an online experiment, participants first make a fair or unfair allocation in a Dictator Minigame. They then learn whether the Receiver's payoff was determined by their own choice or by chance, and make an unanticipated decision about whether to donate part of their earnings to a charity. By varying responsibility for realized social outcomes, the design generates different moral states associated with the same first-stage choice, which can trigger compensatory behavior in the subsequent donation decision. 
We find a sharp asymmetry. After choosing the fair allocation, being responsible for the Receiver's favorable outcome significantly reduces subsequent donations, consistent with moral licensing. After choosing the unfair allocation, responsibility has no average effect on giving, but this null effect conceals substantial heterogeneity in individual responses. Overall, the results show that responsibility for outcomes can shape later prosocial behavior, but does so asymmetrically across good and bad deeds.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验研究发现，做了公平选择后对结果负责会降低后续捐赠（道德许可），而不公平选择后承担责任对捐赠的平均效应不显著，但存在个体异质性。
AI.research_question: 道德行为是否会通过"道德会计"机制在连续决策中产生溢出效应？具体而言，伤害他人后是否会变得更慷慨（道德清洗），还是做了正确的事后反而减少慷慨（道德许可）？
AI.motivation: 探讨道德行为在时间序列上的动态交互机制，理解人们在不同的道德情境（做好事vs做坏事）下如何调整后续的利他行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道德会计理论（Moral Accounting）：包括道德清洗（moral cleansing，通过后续善行抵消道德债务）和道德许可（moral licensing，用之前的道德资本为后续不道德行为辩护）。
AI.method: 在线实验，被试首先在独裁者迷你游戏中做出公平或不公平的分配决策，随后被告知接收者的收益是由自己的选择还是由运气决定（操纵责任归因），最后做出是否捐赠部分收入的决策。
AI.findings: 存在显著的不对称性：公平选择后，对接收者的有利结果负责显著减少了后续捐赠（道德许可效应）；不公平选择后，承担责任的平均效应不显著，但存在显著的个体异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了道德溢出效应在好行为与坏行为之间的非对称性，表明责任归因是触发道德会计机制的关键因素，而非仅仅行为本身。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解人们为何在做了道德行为后可能减少公益参与提供了实证依据，对公益组织、企业社会责任等领域的激励设计具有启示意义。

title: Market Structure and Financial Dynamics in the Omani Banking Sector: A Case Study of Bank Muscat
affiliations: and Sultan Qaboos University

detail.title: Market Structure and Financial Dynamics in the Omani Banking Sector: A Case Study of Bank Muscat

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based entirely on secondary data obtained from publicly available sources. No human participants, personal data, or confidential information were involved; therefore, ethics approval was not required. Artificial intelligence tools were used only for language refinement, formatting assistance, and editing support. All analysis, interpretations, calculations, and academic content were developed and reviewed by the authors.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the market structure and financial dynamics of the Omani banking sector, using Bank Muscat as a primary case study. Applying standard microeconomic tools to secondary data from official sources including the Central Bank of Oman, Bank Muscat investor presentations, and IMF Article IV consultations. The study finds that the sector operates as a moderately concentrated oligopoly, with a three-firm concentration ratio (CR3) of 63.1% and a Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) of approximately 1,893. Bank Muscat alone holds 32.5% of total sector assets. Gross loans and customer deposits expanded steadily between 2021 and September 2025, from RO 27.8 billion to RO 34.5 billion and from RO 25.6 billion to RO 33.1 billion, respectively. Arc price elasticity of demand, calculated from actual loan volume and interest rate data, averages approximately −0.24, confirming that credit demand is inelastic. Three identifiable market failures information asymmetry, systemic risk as a negative externality, and moral hazard in oligopolistic lending justify the Central Bank of Oman's regulatory interventions, including the 6% personal loan interest rate cap and Basel III capital adequacy requirements. Policy recommendations focus on gradually reviewing the interest rate cap, strengthening household credit-risk controls, and accelerating open banking reform to reduce oligopolistic market power.

AI.tldr: 本文以阿曼最大的银行——马斯喀特银行为主要案例，运用微观经济学工具，分析了阿曼银行业的市场结构和金融动态。研究发现该行业处于中度集中寡头垄断状态，信贷需求缺乏弹性，存在信息不对称、系统性风险和道德风险三类市场失灵，并据此为阿曼央行提出了政策建议。
AI.research_question: 阿曼银行业呈现怎样的市场结构？信贷需求的价格弹性如何？存在哪些市场失灵？央行监管政策是否合理有效？
AI.motivation: 阿曼银行业在经济增长中扮演关键角色，但其市场结构和竞争动态尚未得到充分研究。理解银行业的市场力量、需求弹性和市场失灵，有助于评估和优化央行的监管政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业组织理论（寡头垄断市场结构）、需求弹性理论（弧弹性）、市场失灵理论（信息不对称、负外部性、道德风险）、监管经济学。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以马斯喀特银行为主要对象；运用标准微观经济学工具；基于二手数据（阿曼央行、马斯喀特银行投资者报告、IMF第四条磋商报告）；计算CR3和HHI集中度指标；计算弧需求价格弹性。
AI.findings: ①阿曼银行业为中度集中寡头市场（CR3=63.1%，HHI≈1,893），马斯喀特银行占行业总资产32.5%。②2021年至2025年9月，贷款总额从278亿里亚尔增至345亿里亚尔，存款从256亿里亚尔增至331亿里亚尔。③信贷需求弧价格弹性约-0.24，高度缺乏弹性。④存在信息不对称、系统性风险（负外部性）和寡头贷款中的道德风险三类市场失灵。⑤央行6%个人贷款利率上限和巴塞尔III资本充足率等干预具有合理性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将产业组织理论和市场失灵理论系统应用于新兴市场银行业分析，实证验证了寡头垄断结构下信贷需求缺乏弹性的特征，丰富了中东地区银行业市场结构的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿曼央行提供了具体政策建议：逐步审查利率上限、加强家庭信贷风险控制、加快开放银行改革以降低寡头市场力量。这些建议对类似新兴经济体的银行业监管具有参考价值。

title: The asymmetric return moment relationship in oil: replicated and revisited

detail.title: The asymmetric return moment relationship in oil: replicated and revisited
detail.abstract: This paper replicates and extends Zhang et. al by introducing formal joint inference across quantiles, extending the sample period to 2013--2025, and estimating option-implied moments under both the risk-neutral and physical measures. While we confirm several of the original findings---including the return--volatility relationship, the persistence of lagged moments, the heterogeneous return--moment relationship across quantiles, and the dominance of contemporaneous returns over lagged returns---we find that some previously documented results, particularly those concerning lagged returns and asymmetry in higher-order moments, are substantially weaker than originally suggested. Our results indicate that several of these effects are likely driven by noise, small-sample effects, or other econometric issues rather than robust economic relationships. After accounting for these concerns, we show that asymmetry between positive and negative returns is primarily confined to volatility within the middle and upper quantile states and does not meaningfully extend to higher-order moments. Moreover, lagged returns are not broadly important determinants of future moments, instead playing a limited role mainly in explaining volatility within lower quantile states and mean-reverting dynamics in skewness. Overall, our findings provide a more conservative and statistically rigorous interpretation of the relationship between returns and higher-order moments in crude oil markets.

AI.tldr: 本文复制并拓展了Zhang等人的研究，引入跨分位数的联合推断，将样本期延长至2013—2025年，并估计了风险中性和物理测度下的期权隐含矩。研究确认了部分原始发现，但发现先前关于滞后收益率和高阶矩不对称性的结果显著较弱，这些效应可能由噪声或小样本问题驱动。修正后，正负收益率的不对称性主要集中在波动率的中高分量状态，滞后收益率仅在低分位波动率和偏度的均值回复中起有限作用。
AI.research_question: 原油市场中收益率与高阶矩（特别是期权隐含矩）之间的关系是否稳健？先前研究发现的滞后收益率效应和正负收益率不对称性是否真实存在？
AI.motivation: 已有研究（Zhang等人）对原油市场收益率与高阶矩关系进行了探索，但其结论可能受到样本期限制、分位数推断缺乏联合性以及未区分风险中性与物理测度的影响。本文旨在通过更严谨的方法检验这些结论的稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分位数回归、联合推断、期权隐含矩（风险中性/物理测度）、收益率-波动率关系、高阶矩（偏度、峰度）不对称性。
AI.method: 复制与拓展研究：引入跨分位数的形式联合推断，将样本期从原研究拓展至2013—2025年，并分别在风险中性测度和物理测度下估计期权隐含矩。
AI.findings: 1. 确认了收益率-波动率关系、滞后矩的持续性、收益率-矩关系的分位异质性以及同期收益率优于滞后收益率等原始发现。2. 滞后收益率和高阶矩不对称性的原始结果显著弱化，可能由噪声或小样本问题驱动。3. 正负收益率不对称性仅体现在中高分量状态的波动率中，未扩展至高阶矩。4. 滞后收益率仅在低分位波动率解释和偏度均值回复中起有限作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 对原油市场收益率与高阶矩关系提供了更保守且统计上更严谨的解释，修正了原有文献中可能因方法缺陷导致的夸大结论，明确了不对称性和滞后效应的真实边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为原油市场风险管理者和期权交易者提供了更可靠的矩估计依据，帮助识别哪些收益率-矩关系是稳健的经济规律、哪些可能是统计假象，从而改进投资决策和风险对冲策略。

title: Less is More: Rethinking Energy Demand for Austria's Net-Zero Future
affiliations: University of Graz, University of Graz, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Graz, University of Graz, Graz University of Technology and University of Graz

detail.title: Less is More: Rethinking Energy Demand for Austria's Net-Zero Future
detail.abstract: We develop and analyze four consistent scenarios depicting net-zero CO2 emissions in the sectors industry, energy, transport, and buildings by 2050 in Austria, serving as a representative case of a small, industrialized economy embedded in the European energy infrastructure. The scenarios explore varying configurations of energy demand and energy import availability, contrasting a technology-driven high energy demand state with a demand-side-driven low energy demand state under two different levels of energy trade restrictions. We integrate scenario-specific energy demand data derived from bottom-up sector models in a European energy system model and soft-link it to a computable general equilibrium model to assess energy system implications and macroeconomic effects. Across scenarios, low-demand configurations reduce final energy demand by about 21% (-68 TWh), lower total energy system costs by up to 10%, and decrease energy import dependence, while increasing GDP by up to 3.3% compared to the high-demand reference. However, energy demand reductions are offset by economic feedback effects by 10-38% depending on the energy carrier, as efficiency gains stimulate higher production and consumption. The scenario with high energy demand combined with limited import availability yields the most expensive energy system configuration and least favorable macroeconomic outcomes. Our results indicate that enabling lower economy-wide energy demand, for example, through circular value chains and energy-saving lifestyles, can improve the economic feasibility of net-zero transitions while simultaneously reducing reliance on energy imports.

AI.tldr: 本研究以奥地利为代表案例，构建了四种到2050年实现净零CO₂排放的一致性情景，探索了能源需求和进口依赖的不同配置。研究发现低需求情景可降低终端能耗约21%、能源系统成本最多10%，并提升GDP最多3.3%，但节能带来的经济反馈效应会部分抵消需求减少。
AI.research_question: 在嵌入欧洲能源基础设施的小型工业化经济体中，不同的能源需求水平和能源进口限制配置如何影响净零CO₂排放转型的能源系统影响和宏观经济效应？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对净零转型情景的分析往往忽视需求侧措施与经济反馈效应的相互作用。本研究旨在系统评估不同能源需求配置（技术驱动vs需求侧驱动）和进口限制条件下，净零转型的能源经济可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合能源系统建模与可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型的软链接分析框架，结合自下而上的部门模型和欧洲能源系统模型。
AI.method: 构建四种净零排放一致性情景，整合自下而上的部门模型获取特定情景的能源需求数据，输入欧洲能源系统模型，再软链接至可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型，评估能源系统影响和宏观经济效应。
AI.findings: 低需求配置可降低终端能耗约21%（-68 TWh），总系统成本最多降低10%，降低进口依赖，GDP最多提高3.3%。但节能的反馈效应会抵消10-38%的需求减少（取决于能源载体）。高需求+有限进口情景的能源系统最昂贵、宏观经济最不利。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了净零转型中需求侧措施与经济反馈效应的动态关系，量化了节能对GDP的正向影响以及被反馈效应部分抵消的程度，为需求侧驱动转型提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为奥地利及类似小型工业化经济体提供了净零转型路径的政策参考，表明通过循环价值链和节能生活方式降低经济范围能源需求，可同时提升经济可行性和降低进口依赖。

title: Climate Risk Misperception and Firm Productivity: The External Effects of Culture and Institutional Policies
affiliations: , Jilin University (JLU), Hohai University, Capital University of Economics and Business and University of Alabama in Huntsville

detail.title: Climate Risk Misperception and Firm Productivity: The External Effects of Culture and Institutional Policies
detail.abstract: Climate risk increasingly affects firm operations, yet managers may misjudge the intensity of that exposure. This study examines whether climate risk perception bias is associated with firm productivity. We define climate risk perception bias as the gap between firms’ disclosed climate-risk perceptions and their objective physical climate exposure. Using Chinese A-share listed firms from 2003 to 2022, we combine meteorological station data with annual report text to construct firm-level measures of objective climate risk, perceived climate risk, and their misalignment. We find that greater climate risk perception bias is associated with lower total factor productivity. We further provide mechanism-consistent evidence that firms with greater perception bias exhibit lower supply-chain efficiency and greater volatility in supply-chain concentration. These relationships also vary across institutional environments, suggesting that the productivity consequences of climate risk perception bias are not uniform across firms. These findings suggest that the performance consequences of climate risk depend not only on physical exposure, but also on managerial interpretation of that exposure.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，企业对气候风险的感知偏差（即主观感知与客观暴露之间的差距）越大，企业全要素生产率越低，其传导机制包括供应链效率下降和供应链集中度波动加剧。
AI.research_question: 气候风险感知偏差是否以及如何影响企业生产率？
AI.motivation: 气候风险日益影响企业运营，但管理者可能误判自身面临的暴露程度，这种认知偏差对企业实际绩效的后果尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候风险感知偏差理论；管理层认知偏差与企业绩效关系；供应链效率视角。
AI.method: 以2003-2022年中国A股上市公司为样本，结合气象站数据与年报文本分析，构建企业层面客观气候风险、感知气候风险及二者偏差的衡量指标，进行实证回归分析。
AI.findings: 气候风险感知偏差越大，企业全要素生产率越低；偏差通过降低供应链效率、加剧供应链集中度波动发挥作用；该效应在不同制度环境下存在异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将气候风险研究从单纯关注物理暴露拓展至管理层认知层面，提出并验证了"感知偏差"这一新机制在气候风险与企业绩效关系中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒企业管理层重视对气候风险的准确评估，避免认知偏差带来的生产率损失；为投资者和政策制定者理解气候风险的经济后果提供新视角。

title: When Your Neighbor Goes Bust: Fiscal Spillovers from Municipal Bankruptcy
affiliations: Tampere University - Department of Economics

detail.title: When Your Neighbor Goes Bust: Fiscal Spillovers from Municipal Bankruptcy
detail.abstract: Municipal bankruptcy is a highly visible fiscal event: although triggered by financial distress, its timing and declaration are discretionary and politically consequential. This paper studies whether such bankruptcies generate fiscal spillovers to nearby governments. Using Italian municipalities between 2000 and 2015, I combine a border-based exposure design with staggered difference-indifferences and event-study methods to compare municipalities bordering a bankrupt neighbor with more distant municipalities. Baseline estimates indicate that exposure to a neighboring bankruptcy is followed by fiscal tightening among nearby municipalities. Direct neighbors increase debt repayment by roughly 20 percent relative to pre-exposure levels and improve net fiscal surplus within one to two years. Effects attenuate with geographic distance and are not accompanied by increases in off-balance-sheet liabilities. Adjustment occurs through expenditure restraint and strengthened own-source revenues. Heterogeneity patterns suggest stronger debt-repayment responses among municipalities with higher pre-existing debt and interest burdens, consistent with a disciplinarysignal mechanism: nearby bankruptcy raises perceived enforcement risk and induces precautionary consolidation among fiscally vulnerable governments. The findings suggest that salient fiscal failures can transmit discipline across jurisdictions even in the absence of formal fiscal linkages.

AI.tldr: 本文研究市政破产对邻近政府的财政溢出效应。利用意大利2000-2015年数据，发现邻近破产会促使周边政府紧缩财政、增加债务偿还、改善财政盈余，且效应随距离衰减，符合"纪律信号"机制。
AI.research_question: 市政破产是否会对邻近政府产生财政溢出效应（即财政紧缩/纪律传导）？
AI.motivation: 市政破产虽由财务困境触发，但其声明时机存在自由裁量权且具有政治后果，然而此前缺乏对其跨辖区溢出效应的因果识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 纪律信号机制（disciplinary signal）：邻近破产提高了地方政府对执法风险的感知，促使财政脆弱政府进行预防性财政整固。
AI.method: 基于边界暴露设计（border-based exposure design），结合交错双重差分（staggered DiD）和事件研究法，比较与破产市相邻的市镇与更远距离市镇的财政表现差异。
AI.findings: （1）邻近破产后，直接相邻市镇债务偿还增加约20%，财政盈余改善；（2）效应随地理距离衰减；（3）调整通过支出约束和增强自有收入实现，未伴随表外负债增加；（4）高债务、高利息负担的市镇反应更强，支持纪律信号机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次因果识别市政破产的财政溢出效应，揭示"无正式财政关联下财政纪律跨辖区传导"的信号机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据：一个辖区的财政失败可能通过信号效应促进邻近辖区的财政自律，有助于理解财政联邦制下的非正式治理机制。

title: Does Artificial Intelligence facilitate Corporate Energy Efficiency? Evidence from LLM-Derived Information
affiliations: Jinan University and Jinan University

detail.title: Does Artificial Intelligence facilitate Corporate Energy Efficiency? Evidence from LLM-Derived Information
detail.abstract: Rapid advances in artificial intelligence (AI) are transforming corporate decision-making and production systems, yet their implications for firms’ energy efficiency remain insufficiently understood. This study investigates whether and how AI adoption facilitates energy-efficient transition at the firm level by constructing a novel firm-year AI index derived from a fine-tuned large language model applied to annual reports of Chinese listed companies from 2011 to 2020. Integrated with detailed energy consumption, production, and financial data, this measurement strategy enables a comprehensive assessment of AI’s environmental impact. Empirical results consistently indicate that firms adopting AI technologies exhibit markedly lower energy intensity. Further decomposition of energy intensity reveals that AI-enabled firms achieve output expansion without a corresponding rise in total energy consumption, suggesting that AI contributes to a substantive weakening of the conventional link between production growth and environmental pressure. AI classification proves that planning-oriented systems deliver the most prominent efficiency dividends. Mechanism evidence shows that AI reshapes firms’ production and investment behaviors by improving operational performance and by encouraging greater performance in green investment. Moreover, heterogeneous effects emerge along multiple firm and regional dimensions, with the benefits of AI adoption being particularly pronounced among enterprises operating outside technology-intensive sectors, firms characterized by stronger cash-flow positions, and those located in regions with relatively lax environmental regulatory environments. Collectively, these findings highlight AI’s potential to serve as a technological driver of corporate energy sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2011-2020年中国上市公司数据，通过大语言模型构建企业AI采纳指数，发现AI采纳能显著降低企业能源强度，其机制在于AI在扩大产出的同时未显著增加能源消耗，打破了生产增长与环境污染的传统关联。其中，规划导向型AI系统的节能效果最为突出。AI通过提升运营绩效和促进绿色投资来推动能源效率改善，且这一效应在非技术密集型行业、现金流充裕的企业及环境规制宽松地区的企业中更为明显。
AI.research_question: 企业层面的人工智能采纳是否以及如何促进能源效率转型？
AI.motivation: 人工智能正快速改变企业决策与生产系统，但其对企业能源效率的影响尚未得到充分理解，现有研究缺乏对AI与企业能源表现之间关系的系统性实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI作为通用技术通过优化生产流程、提升运营效率及引导绿色投资来削弱经济增长与能源消耗之间的传统耦合关系。
AI.method: 基于微调大语言模型，从2011-2020年中国上市公司年报中构建企业层面AI指数，结合能源消费、生产和财务数据进行实证分析，并开展能源强度分解、机制检验及异质性分析。
AI.findings: AI采纳显著降低企业能源强度；AI企业实现产出扩张但总能源消耗未同步上升，削弱了生产增长与能源压力的关联；规划导向型AI系统节能效果最突出；机制上AI通过改善运营绩效和促进绿色投资发挥作用；异质性上，非技术密集型行业、现金流充裕企业及环境规制宽松地区企业的节能效果更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从企业层面系统揭示AI采纳对能源效率的因果影响及其机制，拓展了AI经济效应与企业环境可持续性的交叉研究，丰富了技术变革与能源经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供了AI作为推动能源可持续转型技术工具的实证依据，启示应针对不同类型企业和区域环境设计差异化的AI推广与绿色激励政策。

title: Predicting treatment responses in multiple sclerosis: a model development and geographical validation study
affiliations: University College London - UCL Queen Square Institute of Neurology, University College London, Monash University, University College London, Government of the United Kingdom - Moorfields Eye Hospital, University College London - UCL Queen Square Institute of Neurology, University College London, VU University Amsterdam - Department of Radiology & Nuclear Medicine, University College London - UCL Queen Square Institute of Neurology, University College London - UCL Queen Square Institute of Neurology, University of Birmingham, University College London - University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust, University College London, University College London, Karolinska Institutet - Department of Clinical Neuroscience, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Karolinska Institutet - Neuroimmunology Unit, Karolinska Institutet - Department of Clinical Neuroscience and University College London

detail.title: Predicting treatment responses in multiple sclerosis: a model development and geographical validation study
detail.abstract: Background Multiple sclerosis (MS) is the most common disabling neurological disease of young adults, with many approved disease-modifying treatments (DMTs). We developed and validated a Bayesian modelling framework to predict individual-level treatment response.Methods We used two prospective cohorts of people with relapsing–remitting MS (pwMS) in the UK (training) and Sweden (external validation), with clinical and MRI data assessed within 6 months of DMT initiation, and outcomes (no-evidence-of-disease-activity (NEDA) over 2 years. Bayesian models of increasing complexity (up to 12 baseline predictors) predicted NEDA (no-evidence-of-disease-activity: absence of relapse, disability progression, and new MRI lesions) at 1 and 2 years and were externally validated. Internal performance used ELPD-LOO (expected leave-one-out log posterior density), AUROC (area-under-the-receiver-operating-characteristic curve), R² (explained variance), and calibration plots; external validation used AUROC and R².Findings The training and external cohorts comprised 1,873 and 808 pwMS, respectively, with differing baseline characteristics; NEDA occurred in 65.6% and 70.3% over 2 years. Greater model complexity improved internal NEDA prediction; the most complex model reached AUROC=0.71 (95% Bayesian Credible Interval 0.70–0.72) at year 1 and 0.66 (0.65–0.67) at year 2. External performance was modest: AUROC=0.59 (0.57–0.61) at year 1 and 0.57 (0.55–0.58) at year 2. At year 2, explained variance was low but higher for complex than DMT-only models (R²=0.08 [0.06–0.10] vs 0.03 [0.01–0.05]). Complex models showed consistent calibration across patient subgroups, and individual predictions with uncertainty were illustrated.Interpretation A Bayesian framework using routine clinical and MRI data achieved modest-to-moderate individual-level outcome prediction, but discrimination decreased on geographic validation, highlighting challenges in transporting prediction models across settings with different case-mix, monitoring and treatment practices. Further multicenter training and local model updating may improve prediction.Funding National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR).

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并验证了一个贝叶斯建模框架，利用常规临床和MRI数据预测多发性硬化症患者个体化治疗反应。模型在内部验证中表现尚可（AUROC=0.71），但外部地理验证时预测能力显著下降（AUROC=0.57-0.59），表明预测模型在不同医疗环境下存在可迁移性挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何利用常规临床和MRI数据，构建能够预测多发性硬化症（MS）患者个体化治疗反应的贝叶斯模型？
AI.motivation: 多发性硬化症是年轻成人最常见的致残性神经疾病，已有多种获批的疾病修饰治疗（DMT），但个体对治疗的反应差异较大，需要可靠的预测工具来指导个性化治疗决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯建模框架，以"无疾病活动证据（NEDA）"作为治疗反应的综合结局指标，纳入12个基线预测因子，通过递进复杂性模型进行预测。
AI.method: 利用英国前瞻性队列（n=1,873）作为训练集、瑞典队列（n=808）作为外部验证集，构建贝叶斯模型预测1年和2年NEDA状态。内部评估使用ELPD-LOO、AUROC、R²和校准图；外部验证使用AUROC和R²。
AI.findings: 最复杂模型在内部验证中AUROC为0.71（1年）和0.66（2年）；外部验证中AUROC降至0.59（1年）和0.57（2年）。2年时复杂模型R²=0.08，而仅含DMT信息的模型R²=0.03。复杂模型在不同患者子组中校准一致性良好。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了贝叶斯方法在个体化医疗预测中的适用性，揭示了预测模型在不同地理/临床环境间迁移时性能下降的问题，强调了病例组合、监测和治疗实践差异对模型泛化能力的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个基于常规临床数据的个体化治疗反应预测框架；指出当前模型尚不足以直接跨医疗环境应用，建议未来需进行多中心训练和本地模型更新以提升预测准确性。

title: Buying Votes to Maximize Potential
affiliations: Southern University of Science and Technology - School of Business

detail.title: Buying Votes to Maximize Potential
detail.abstract: This paper revisits the textbook vote buying model in which a buyer pays voters to vote against their preferences under general voting rules. The game admits multiple equilibria: all voters or any maximal losing coalition may accept. I show that the game is a potential game, enabling a well-established equilibrium refinement. After refinement, the set of optimal payments is the aspiration core of the dual simple game, concepts from cooperative games. For decisive weighted voting rules, the buyer pays all voters (buying supermajorities) in proportion to their votes (Gamson's Law). My analysis provides a non-cooperative foundation for the nucleolus as a power index.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了教科书中的贿选模型，发现在一般投票规则下存在多重均衡。通过势博弈方法进行精炼后，最优支付集合对应于合作博弈中的"渴望核"（aspiration core）。对于决定性加权投票规则，买票者会按投票比例向所有选民支付（购买超级多数），这符合Gamson定律。分析为"核仁"（nucleolus）作为权力指数提供了非合作博弈基础。
AI.research_question: 在一般投票规则下，贿选模型中的多重均衡如何通过精炼方法得到唯一解？最优支付结构是什么？
AI.motivation: 经典的教科书贿选模型存在多重均衡问题，缺乏对均衡选择的明确指导。本文旨在通过势博弈的精炼方法解决这一问题，并为合作博弈中的权力指数提供非合作博弈基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 势博弈（Potential Game）、简单合作博弈（Simple Cooperative Game）、渴望核（Aspiration Core）、核仁（Nucleolus）、Gamson定律
AI.method: 本文采用博弈论分析方法。首先证明该贿选博弈是一个势博弈，然后利用势博弈的精炼方法（如帕累托最优的势最大化）来挑选均衡。并将最优支付集合与合作博弈中的渴望核概念建立联系。
AI.findings: (1) 贿选博弈是一个势博弈，可以利用势博弈的精炼方法选择均衡；(2) 精炼后的最优支付集合等于对偶简单博弈的"渴望核"；(3) 对于决定性加权投票规则，买票者按投票比例向所有选民支付（购买超级多数），即Gamson定律成立；(4) 分析为核仁作为权力指数提供了非合作博弈基础。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将势博弈方法引入贿选问题研究，解决了多重均衡问题；(2) 建立了贿选最优支付与合作博弈中渴望核之间的理论联系；(3) 为核仁作为权力指数提供了非合作博弈理论基础；(4) 将Gamson定律从实证规律提升为理论推导结果。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为理解现实政治中的投票购买行为提供了理论预测；(2) 揭示了超级多数规则下贿选的成本结构；(3) 为反贿选政策设计提供了理论依据。

reference: TIAA Institute Research Paper Series Forthcoming
title: Unready: The State of Preparedness of Current and Future Caregivers
affiliations: TIAA Institute and TIAA Institute

detail.title: Unready: The State of Preparedness of Current and Future Caregivers

publicationDetails.detailsText: TIAA Institute Research Paper Series Forthcoming

detail.abstract: Like most developed nations, the United States is experiencing rapid population aging. Between 1920 and 2020, the number of Americans over the age of 65 grew roughly five times faster than the general population (US Census Bureau 2023). As households age and experience changes in health status, they face increasingly complex decisions regarding the management and provision of long-term care (LTC), particularly for aging parents or relatives. Johnson (2019) estimated that upwards of 70% of older adults will require some form of LTC during their lifetimes, exposing many to potentially high expenses. LTC needs can arise gradually, as in the case of Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD), or suddenly following acute events such as a stroke. These needs often trigger caregiving responsibilities within families. Adult children frequently assume the role of caregiver, making difficult decisions about who bears responsibility for care, who provides care, how the care is delivered, and who pays for the care. Many families rely on unpaid caregiving from one or more adult children, and the scale of this unpaid labor is significant. An estimated 37.1 million Americans over the age of 15 were providing unpaid elder care in 2023 (Bureau of Labor Statistics BLS 2023). To assess the preparedness of future caregivers, we surveyed US adults between 40 and 64 with at least one living parent. Our goal was to investigate how individuals plan for potential caregiving needs, the impacts they expect, and the resources they anticipate using. We captured responses from both current caregivers and non-caregivers to compare levels of preparedness and knowledge across these groups. We also examined variation among caregivers based on whether caregiving began as a result of a crisis event. Our analysis focuses on the reported impact of caregiving (both actual and anticipated) on retirement planning, saving behavior, employment, and self-reported measures of financial well-being. We also examine potential barriers to planning for caregiving, including emotional reluctance to initiate difficult conversations, and explore respondents’ awareness of their parents’ own preparations for aging and care.

AI.tldr: 本文调查了40-64岁美国中年人（至少有一位在世父母）对潜在长期护理需求的规划情况，分析了当前照护者和非照护者在退休规划、储蓄行为、就业和财务福祉方面的差异，并探讨了照护开始的危机事件以及规划障碍（如情感回避）等因素的影响。
AI.research_question: 美国中年人如何为潜在的老年长期护理需求进行规划？当前照护者与非照护者在准备程度、预期影响和资源认知上有何差异？照护是否始于危机事件会影响照护者的规划与感受？
AI.motivation: 美国人口快速老龄化，超过70%的老年人一生中需要某种形式的长期护理，而大量照护由家庭 unpaid 承担。现有研究缺乏对中年人（潜在未来照护者）在照护规划、预期影响及准备程度方面的系统调查。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭照护决策理论、危机事件与渐进性照护需求区分框架、退休规划与照护负担的交叉影响分析。
AI.method: 对美国40-64岁且至少有一位在世父母的成年人进行问卷调查，收集当前照护者和非照护者的数据，对比两组在准备程度、知识水平、预期照护影响（退休规划、储蓄、就业、财务福祉）方面的差异，并分析照护起始方式（危机 vs. 渐进）的调节作用。
AI.findings: 研究发现：照护对退休规划、储蓄行为、就业和财务福祉均有显著影响；照护始于危机事件者的准备更不充分；情感回避（不愿开启艰难对话）是主要的规划障碍；许多人对父母自身的养老准备缺乏了解。
AI.theory_contributions: 将照护规划纳入家庭财务决策理论框架，区分危机启动与渐进启动的照护路径对规划行为的不同影响，丰富了家庭照护与退休规划交叉领域的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和金融顾问提供实证依据，帮助设计针对中年人的照护规划干预措施，尤其是如何克服情感障碍、促进早期沟通和财务准备。

title: When Do Consultants Add Value? Evidence from Hedge Fund Recommendations
affiliations: Aalto University School of Business, ,  and Norges Bank Investment Management (NBIM)

detail.title: When Do Consultants Add Value? Evidence from Hedge Fund Recommendations
detail.abstract: Using a novel dataset of institutional hedge fund mandates from 2000 to 2022, we compare consultant-recommended managers with feasible alternatives within mandate-specific opportunity sets. Recommended funds subsequently earn significantly higher risk-adjusted returns, with FH7 alphas of 0.70% per year overall and up to 1.81% for alternatives-specialized consultants. Recommended funds also exhibit lower downside risk, lower liquidity fragility, and lower failure rates. Consultants favor managers with strong past performance, restrictive share terms, and lower operational risk, but these observable characteristics explain only part of the performance differential. Recommended funds are also more likely to be closed to new investors or absent from commercial databases, consistent with differential access to institutionally oriented managers. Residual abnormal performance remains concentrated among independent, fixed-retainer, and alternatives-specialized consultants even after controlling for fund characteristics, operational-risk indicators, and access proxies. We find little evidence that consultant-driven capital allocation generates crowding or scale diseconomies. Overall, the evidence suggests that consultants add value through information acquisition, due diligence, and differential access in opaque alternative asset markets.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2000-2022年机构对冲基金委托数据，发现顾问推荐的基金经理相比可行替代方案，能获得显著更高的风险调整后收益（FH7 alpha年化0.70%，另类投资专业顾问可达1.81%），且下行风险、流动性脆弱性和失败率更低。推荐效果部分源于顾问的信息获取、尽职调查和差异化渠道优势。
AI.research_question: 投资顾问推荐的基金经理是否以及为何能比可行的替代选项表现更好？
AI.motivation: 在另类资产市场信息不透明、投资者依赖顾问的背景下，现有文献对顾问能否真正为机构投资者创造价值缺乏直接证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、代理理论、信号理论、规模不经济理论
AI.method: 使用2000-2022年机构对冲基金委托的新数据集，将顾问推荐的经理与委托特定机会集内的可行替代方案进行比较，采用FH7因子模型计算风险调整收益，并进行多种稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 推荐基金年化超额收益0.70%（另类专业顾问达1.81%）；下行风险、流动性脆弱性和失败率更低；推荐效果部分来自可观测特征，但更依赖于信息获取、尽职调查和差异化渠道；无明显拥挤或规模不经济证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次直接检验投资顾问在机构另类资产配置中的价值创造机制，区分了信息获取、尽职调查和差异化渠道的相对贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者选择投资顾问和评估其价值提供实证依据；揭示了另类资产市场中顾问中介功能的关键作用。

title: The Impact of Globalization on Income Inequality:Evidence from South and Southeast Asian Countries (1980-2022)

detail.title: The Impact of Globalization on Income Inequality:Evidence from South and Southeast Asian Countries (1980-2022)
detail.abstract:
This paper looks at how globalization has affected income inequality in South and Southeast Asian countries from 1980 to 2022. We gathered data from three main sources: the Standardized World Income Inequality Database (SWIID), the KOF Swiss Economic Institute, and the World Development Indicators (WDI). We measured income inequality using the Gini Index and examined different types of globalization: economic, trade, financial, cultural, political, interpersonal, and overall. We also factored in GDP per capita and education levels to get a fuller picture. 
     We analyzed the data using two statistical approaches: Fixed Effects and Random Effects models. The Hausman test helped us choose between them, and it consistently pointed toward the Fixed Effects model as the better fit. We used robust standard errors to make our results more reliable. 
     Here's what we found: most types of globalization especially economic, trade, financial, interpersonal, and overall globalization are linked to lower income inequality. This suggests that when countries become more globally connected, income gaps tend to narrow. Cultural globalization had a weaker impact, and political globalization didn't show a clear relationship with inequality at all.
      We also confirmed what economists call the Kuznets curve inequality tends to increase in the early stages of development but eventually decreases as countries get richer. Education consistently emerged as a powerful equalizer, reducing income inequality across all our models.
      The bottom line? Globalization, when paired with better education and steady economic growth, can help create a fairer distribution of income in South and Southeast Asia. These findings have real implications for policymakers who want to promote inclusive globalization and invest in education to tackle inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1980-2022年全球化对南亚和东南亚国家收入不平等的影响，发现大多数类型的全球化（经济、贸易、金融、人际和总体全球化）与收入不平等呈负相关，教育是强有力的均衡器，并验证了库兹涅茨曲线假说。
AI.research_question: 全球化如何影响南亚和东南亚国家的收入不平等？
AI.motivation: 在全球化和收入不平等问题日益受到关注的背景下，本研究聚焦于南亚和东南亚这一发展中国家密集的区域，探讨不同类型的全球化对收入分配的影响，为制定包容性政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 库兹涅茨曲线假说（Kuznets Curve）：经济发展初期不平等加剧，后期随收入增长而缓解；全球化理论（经济、贸易、金融、文化、政治、人际等多维度）；人力资本理论（教育对收入分配的均衡作用）。
AI.method: 数据来源：SWIID（基尼系数）、KOF瑞士经济研究所（全球化指数）、WDI（GDP和教育水平）。计量方法：固定效应模型（FE）和随机效应模型（RE），通过Hausman检验选择模型，采用稳健标准误提升可靠性。
AI.findings: （1）经济、贸易、金融、人际和总体全球化与收入不平等呈负相关；（2）文化全球化影响较弱，政治全球化与不平等无显著关系；（3）验证了库兹涅茨曲线假说；（4）教育显著降低了收入不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了全球化与收入不平等关系的实证证据，特别是在发展中国家地区；验证了库兹涅茨曲线在南亚和东南亚地区的适用性；区分了不同维度全球化对收入分配差异化的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证支持：应推动包容性全球化并加大教育投资，以缩小收入差距；提示政治全球化对收入分配的直接影响有限，需重点关注经济和人际全球化渠道。

title: Concentration in the U.S. Market Structure: A Contribution to the Political Economy (Working Paper Version, May 2026)
affiliations: Chuo University and San Diego State University

detail.title: Concentration in the U.S. Market Structure: A Contribution to the Political Economy (Working Paper Version, May 2026)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

contentType.other: It is an original research paper that has not been published elsewhere.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the historical evolution of antitrust policy in the United States and its implications for economic stability, income distribution, and democratic governance. Emerging during the Progressive Era as a structural response to concentrated economic power, antitrust law functioned not only to protect market competition but also to safeguard democratic accountability. During the mid-twentieth century, strong antitrust enforcement, coordinated labor institutions, and progressive fiscal policies supported a framework of regulated competition in which capitalist growth coexisted with broadly shared prosperity. This institutional balance eroded in the late twentieth century with the rise of a doctrinal shift that narrowed antitrust analysis to short-term price and output effects. By redefining concentration as presumptively efficient, this shift facilitated sustained waves of mergers and acquisitions while neglecting broader structural harms, including wage suppression, declining labor share, rising inequality, and expanding corporate political influence. The paper argues that corporate consolidation reallocates social surplus toward dominant firms and financial actors, weakening institutional resilience. In an increasingly globalized economy, restoring long-term stability requires reembedding markets within democratic institutions capable of regulating concentrated power and governing the distribution of social surplus.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了美国反垄断政策从进步时代至当代的历史演变，分析了其如何从保护竞争与民主问责的结构性工具，蜕变为以短期价格效应为核心的狭隘分析框架。文章指出，这一转变导致了企业集中度上升、工资抑制、不平等加剧及企业政治影响力膨胀，并主张在全球化背景下，必须重新将市场嵌入能够规制集中权力和分配社会剩余的民主制度中。
AI.research_question: 美国反垄断政策的历史演变如何影响经济稳定、收入分配和民主治理？
AI.motivation: 20世纪末反垄断政策从结构性分析转向以短期价格和产出效应为核心的狭隘框架，这一转变可能助长了企业集中、工资抑制、不平等加剧和企业政治影响力膨胀等结构性危害，但现有研究缺乏对这一历史演变及其系统性后果的整合分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反垄断作为规制经济权力的制度工具；"嵌入性"理论——市场需嵌入民主制度以维持社会稳定；社会剩余分配理论——企业集中如何重新配置社会剩余。
AI.method: 历史制度分析与政治经济学定性研究，追溯反垄断政策从进步时代、20世纪中期强执行时期到20世纪末"芝加哥学派"范式转变的演变脉络。
AI.findings: 1) 20世纪中期的强反垄断执行与协调性劳工制度、累进财政政策共同支撑了"受规制的竞争"框架；2) 20世纪末的范式转变将集中视为效率，推动了并购浪潮；3) 企业集中导致工资抑制、劳动份额下降、不平等加剧和企业政治影响力膨胀；4) 公司集中重新分配了社会剩余，削弱了制度韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将反垄断政策演变纳入更广泛的政治经济框架，揭示了法律范式转变如何通过重新配置社会剩余影响分配公平和民主韧性，丰富了"嵌入性"理论在当代全球化背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为恢复反垄断政策的结构性功能提供历史依据，主张在全球化经济中重建能够规制集中权力和分配社会剩余的民主制度，对当前美国反垄断改革（如《并购指南》修订）具有政策启示。

title: The Impact of Transformational Leadership in Relation to Job Performance in the Aviation Industry of Albania
affiliations: University of New York Tirana and

detail.title: The Impact of Transformational Leadership in Relation to Job Performance in the Aviation Industry of Albania
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact that transformational leadership has on job performance in the Albanian aviation industry. Existing literature has viewed that transformational leadership has generally a high impact on the performance of the workforce. With the help of quantitative research methodology, an online survey questionnaire provided essential data from 53 participants. This survey measured the possibility of an existing relationship between two main variables. Statistical findings revealed that there is a weak linear relationship between transformational leadership and job performance, but this cannot be considered statistically significant since the p-value (0.616) from the regression analysis is greater than the predetermined level of significance (0.05). These findings are a result of limitations in the sample size (N=53) and the methodology approach. This research paper can contribute to the existing literature on this topic of matter and serve as a guide for further study analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨阿尔巴尼亚航空业中变革型领导对工作绩效的影响，发现两者间存在弱线性关系但未达统计显著水平（p=0.616），主要受限于样本量（N=53）和方法论。
AI.research_question: 阿尔巴尼亚航空业中，变革型领导对工作绩效有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现有文献普遍认为变革型领导对员工绩效有显著正向影响，但该结论在阿尔巴尼亚航空业这一特定情境下是否成立尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 变革型领导理论；领导力-绩效关系理论。
AI.method: 定量研究方法，通过在线问卷调查收集53名参与者的数据，采用回归分析进行统计检验。
AI.findings: 变革型领导与工作绩效之间存在弱线性关系，但p值（0.616）大于0.05的显著性水平，统计上不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了变革型领导普遍提升绩效的既有观点，提示该关系可能因行业、地区或样本特征而存在边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿尔巴尼亚航空业管理者提供实证参考，提醒其不应盲目依赖变革型领导提升绩效；为后续更大样本、更严谨方法论的研究提供基础。

title: Endogenous Broker Choice, Investor Heterogeneity, and Stock Prices
affiliations: Faculty of Economics, Osaka University of Economics, Osaka Gakuin University and

detail.title: Endogenous Broker Choice, Investor Heterogeneity, and Stock Prices

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Takayuki Ogawa serves as a Trustee (board member) at Osaka University of Economics. No poten- tial conflict of interest was reported by the authors.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was financially supported by the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science KAKENHI [grant numbers 24K16400, 25K05066, 26K04995].

detail.abstract: This paper develops a general-equilibrium model in which investors with high and low initial stock endowments endogenously choose between brokers offering proportional and quadratic transaction-cost schedules. Because the quadratic schedule has a lower marginal cost for small trades whereas the proportional schedule becomes more attractive for large trades, broker choice is determined by investors' portfolio-rebalancing needs. We show that, when stock-rich investors are a minority, a larger endowment gap, higher payoff risk, or greater efficiency of the proportional-cost broker induces a regime shift that lowers the stock price. Our analysis identifies endogenous broker choice as a novel mechanism through which investor heterogeneity and commission structures affect stock prices.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个一般均衡模型，研究初始股票 endowment 不同的投资者如何在比例型和二次型交易成本券商之间内生选择，并分析这种选择如何影响股票价格。
AI.research_question: 投资者异质性（初始股票 endowment差异）如何通过内生选择不同佣金结构的券商，进而影响股票价格？
AI.motivation: 现实市场中投资者面临不同的交易成本结构，但现有文献较少关注投资者如何内生选择券商佣金结构，以及这种选择对资产价格的宏观影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡模型，投资者分为高初始股票 endowment 和低初始股票 endowment 两类，在比例型与二次型交易成本券商之间做内生选择。
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，构建一般均衡模型进行推导。
AI.findings: 当股票富有的投资者占少数时，更大的 endowment 差距、更高的 payoff 风险或比例型券商效率提升，会引发制度转换（regime shift），导致股票价格下降。内生券商选择是连接投资者异质性与佣金结构影响股价的新机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"内生券商选择"作为新机制，解释了投资者异质性和交易成本结构如何共同影响资产价格。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者和市场参与者理解不同佣金制度（如比例佣金 vs 固定/阶梯佣金）对市场均衡价格的影响提供了理论依据。

title: Identifying Focal Constructs with Large Language Models: A Comparative Framework and Case in International Business
affiliations: University of Nottingham, Ningbo, Nottingham University Business School (China) and Nottingham University Business School (China)

detail.title: Identifying Focal Constructs with Large Language Models: A Comparative Framework and Case in International Business

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No
declarations.funderStatement: No

detail.abstract: The proliferation of textual data in international business (IB) research—from corporate disclosures to social media—has created unprecedented opportunities to measure latent constructs computationally. Yet IB scholarship lacks systematic guidance on selecting among rapidly evolving text-analysis methods, leaving researchers to rely on familiar but often limited approaches such as manual coding or dictionary-based techniques. This editorial addresses this gap by introducing a comparative framework that evaluates four natural language processing (NLP) approaches along the methodological frontier: classical machine learning, fine-tuned transformer models (BERT), locally deployed large language models (LLMs), and cloud-based API LLMs. We provide annotated data, open-source code, and practical trade-off discussions covering accuracy, computational cost, and scalability. To demonstrate the framework, we apply all four approaches to a substantive IB task—identifying nationalistic rhetoric in 47,298 annual reports of 5,519 Chinese listed firms from 2010 to 2023. Our results reveal that while traditional machine learning achieves strong baseline performance (91.6% accuracy), the fine-tuned FinBERT model offers the best balance of accuracy (93.5%), efficiency, and cost. Cloud-based LLMs such as DeepSeek-V3 attain the highest zero-shot accuracy (94.8%) but involve greater monetary expenditure. We validate the resulting nationalism construct through statistical benchmarking against established measures, an event study exploiting the 2018 U.S.–China trade war as an exogenous shock, and regression analyses linking firm-level nationalist rhetoric to cross-border M&A premiums and outward FDI patterns. Theoretically, we argue that text-derived construct measurement should be recognized as essential methodological infrastructure for IB, enabling scholars to operationalize previously intangible phenomena—such as ideology, cultural narratives, and geopolitical sentiment—and integrate them into theory testing and development.

AI.tldr: 本文为国际商务（IB）研究引入了一个比较框架，系统评估了四种NLP方法（经典机器学习、微调BERT、本地部署LLM和云端API LLM）在文本分析中的表现，并以2010-2023年中国上市公司年报中的民族主义修辞识别为实证案例，展示了各方法的准确性、成本和可扩展性权衡。
AI.research_question: 国际商务研究中，如何系统性地选择并评估不同的自然语言处理方法，以有效测量文本数据中的潜在构念？
AI.motivation: IB研究中文本数据日益丰富，但缺乏对各种快速演进的文本分析方法的系统性选择指导，研究者常依赖于人工编码或基于词典等有限的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: NLP方法论比较框架（经典机器学习、微调Transformer模型、本地部署LLM、云端API LLM）；文本驱动构念测量作为IB方法论基础设施的理论主张。
AI.method: 四种NLP方法（经典机器学习、微调FinBERT、本地部署LLM、云端API LLM）的对比实验；47,298份年度报告（5,519家中国上市公司，2010-2023年）的民族主义修辞识别；统计基准检验、事件研究（2018年中美贸易战）、回归分析进行外部效度验证。
AI.findings: 经典机器学习达91.6%准确率；微调FinBERT最佳平衡（93.5%准确率、高效且低成本）；云端LLM（DeepSeek-V3）零样本准确率最高（94.8%）但费用更高；文本衍生的民族主义构念在统计基准检验、事件研究和回归分析中得到有效验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出文本驱动构念测量应被认可为IB研究的关键方法论基础设施，使学者能够将意识形态、文化叙事、地缘政治情绪等此前难以量化的现象操作化并纳入理论检验与发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供注释数据、开源代码、各方法在准确性/计算成本/可扩展性方面的实用权衡讨论，为IB研究者提供可操作的NLP方法选择指南。

title: Preference Revelation under Design Frictions: Evidence from Cookie Consent Banners
affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Research on Collective Goods and

detail.title: Preference Revelation under Design Frictions: Evidence from Cookie Consent Banners

declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was preregistered prior to data collection (https://osf.io/ke6dc) and approved by the Erasmus School of Law Research Ethics Review Committee (Ethics Approval Number ETH2324-0649).
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the small grants scheme of the research initiative on Rebalancing Public & Private Interests and Erasmus Center of Empirical Legal Studies of Erasmus School of Law and the sector plan for law funding of the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Research. Additional research funds were provided by the Behavioral Law and Economics Research Group at the Max Planck Institute for Research on Collective Goods.

keywords: Preference Revelation Notice-and-consent Frameworks Design Frictions Digital Choice Architecture Dark Patterns Privacy Calculus Online Experiment JEL: D12

detail.abstract:
Privacy law relies on notice-and-consent regimes to govern data collection. This is premised on the idea that observed consent reflects users' underlying privacy preferences. Because consent is supposed to function as an informational signal, law assigns it the role of authorizing data collection. In practice, however, consent interfaces can make some options easier to recognize or implement than others, introducing asymmetric refusal costs that degrade the signal content of observed choices. We study this in a preregistered online experiment with German internet users (n= 1,142). Holding information and the formal option set constant, we vary cookie banner designs that differ in how refusal is presented: one visually emphasizes acceptance, one places rejection behind a settings menu, and one embeds the rejection option as a low-salience text link. We relate consent choices to privacy preferences measured via the IUIPC-8 scale, examining both the level of consent and the mapping from preferences to observed behavior. We find that users with stronger privacy concerns are consistently less likely to accept cookies across all designs. Two of the three designs generate large increases in acceptance relative to a neutral baseline; purely visual emphasis does not. 
We find no evidence that any design systematically weakens the preference-consent relationship. The dominant pattern is threshold relocation: interfaces shift aggregate acceptance through refusal-side costs without distorting preference-based ordering. To interpret heterogeneity across designs, we distinguish execution costs from recognition costs as distinct channels through which interface design shapes consent. Execution frictions primarily affect users with weaker privacy concerns; recognition frictions shift acceptance broadly, including among users with strong concerns. This distinction helps organize divergent findings across studies and has direct implications for evaluating consent as a signal of user preferences and for regulatory standards governing interface design.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在线实验（n=1,142）研究Cookie横幅设计如何影响用户同意选择与隐私偏好之间的关系。研究发现，不同的拒绝展示方式（视觉强调接受、拒绝置于设置菜单、低显著性文本链接）会通过"阈值迁移"改变总体同意率，但并未系统性地削弱偏好-同意之间的映射关系。文章区分了执行成本与识别成本两种机制，为理解界面设计对同意信号的影响提供了理论框架。
AI.research_question: Cookie横幅的设计（尤其是拒绝选项的呈现方式）如何影响用户的同意选择？这些设计是否会扭曲用户隐私偏好与实际同意行为之间的映射关系？
AI.motivation: 隐私法依赖"通知-同意"机制来规范数据收集，前提假设是观察到的同意反映了用户的真实隐私偏好。然而，现实中同意界面可能通过不对称的拒绝成本（如将拒绝选项隐藏或复杂化）来影响用户选择，从而损害同意作为偏好信号的可靠性。现有研究对设计效应的结论不一致，缺乏统一理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论（同意作为隐私偏好的信号）；不对称拒绝成本（执行成本 vs. 识别成本）；阈值迁移机制（界面设计改变决策门槛而非扭曲偏好排序）。
AI.method: 预注册在线实验，被试为1,142名德国互联网用户。在保持信息和正式选项集不变的情况下，操纵Cookie横幅设计的拒绝呈现方式：（1）视觉强调接受；（2）拒绝置于设置菜单；（3）低显著性文本链接。使用IUIPC-8量表测量隐私偏好，分析偏好与同意行为之间的关系。
AI.findings: （1）隐私关注更强的用户在所有设计中都不太可能接受Cookie，偏好-同意关系稳定存在。（2）两个设计（拒绝置于菜单、低显著性文本链接）显著提高了总体接受率，而纯视觉强调则没有。（3）没有证据表明任何设计系统性地削弱了偏好-同意关系，主要机制是"阈值迁移"——设计通过拒绝侧成本改变总体同意率，但不扭曲基于偏好的排序。（4）执行摩擦主要影响隐私关注较弱的用户；识别摩擦则广泛影响包括强隐私关注用户在内的群体。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了"执行成本"与"识别成本"两种不同的拒绝摩擦机制，为整合现有研究中看似矛盾的发现提供了统一理论框架；通过实证表明界面设计主要产生"阈值迁移"而非"偏好扭曲"，深化了对同意信号理论的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估Cookie横幅设计的合规性提供了理论依据——单纯视觉强调可能不构成严重问题，但设置菜单和低显著性文本链接等形式通过增加拒绝成本可能违反知情同意原则；为平台设计更公平的同意界面提供了指导。

title: Policing Police Violence: Sheriff-Coroners and the Underreporting of Police Killings. *
affiliations: Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Erasmus School of Economics (ESE)

detail.title: Policing Police Violence: Sheriff-Coroners and the Underreporting of Police Killings. *
detail.abstract: In the United States, law enforcement kills three people per day, yet official statistics record only half. Using detailed geo-location of police killings and exploiting spatial and temporal discontinuities in medicolegal death-investigation systems across counties from 2000-2024, I show that sheriff-coroner jurisdictions are 15-19 percentage points (≈30 percent) less likely to report killings to the FBI. The effect concentrates among Black victims and increases after high-profile killings (Michael Brown, George Floyd), suggesting public scrutiny intensifies suppression rather than deterring it. The findings highlight how institutional dependence can systematically distort official record and hinder accountability.

AI.tldr: 美国法律执法每年导致大量人员死亡，但官方统计仅记录一半。通过分析警察杀人的地理定位数据以及2000-2024年间各县法医死亡调查系统的时空差异，本研究发现警长-验尸官辖区向FBI报告杀人事件的可能性低15-19个百分点（约30%）。这种效应在黑人受害者中尤为集中，并在高知名度杀人事件（迈克尔·布朗、乔治·弗洛伊德）后加剧，表明公众监督反而强化了压制而非威慑。研究揭示了制度依赖如何系统性扭曲官方记录并阻碍问责。
AI.research_question: 美国警察杀人事件的官方统计数据是否存在系统性少报？制度性依赖如何影响报告偏差？
AI.motivation: 官方统计仅记录实际警察杀人事件的一半，这一巨大差异引发对数据准确性和问责机制的严重担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度依赖理论、官僚激励理论、公众监督与信息压制理论
AI.method: 利用警察杀人的详细地理定位数据，结合2000-2024年间各县法医死亡调查系统的空间和时间断点，采用实证回归分析方法。
AI.findings: 1）警长-验尸官辖区的报告率低15-19个百分点（约30%）；2）黑人受害者受影响更大；3）高知名度事件后报告偏差反而加剧。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了制度依赖（而非单纯恶意）如何系统性扭曲官方数据，拓展了对官僚机构信息生产偏差的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改革警察杀人事件的报告机制提供实证依据，强调需要独立的死亡调查系统以确保问责透明度。

title: The Revival of Industrial Policies in Developed and Developing Countries: The Mission-Oriented Perspective
affiliations: University of Dubrovnik

detail.title: The Revival of Industrial Policies in Developed and Developing Countries: The Mission-Oriented Perspective
detail.abstract: Industrial policy for a long time was treated as an anachronism in mainstream economics. That has changed in recent years. It has turned into the centre of policy discourse across both developed and developing countries. This paper examines the contemporary revival through the lens of the mission-oriented framework, which was principally associated with Mariana Mazzucato and extended by Dani Rodrik, Ha-Joon Chang, and Joseph Stiglitz. The paper traces the intellectual shift from the Washington Consensus market-failure paradigm toward a marketshaping conception of the state and surveys the major policy initiatives that embodied this shift. Beyond the literature review, the paper introduces the Semi-Parametric Markov Chain framework (Tolušić, 2026a), originally developed for regime identification in algorithmic foreign exchange trading, and applies it to industrial policy using the Juhász, Lane, Oehlsen, and Pérez (2025) dataset of 15,735 interventions matched with HS6 product-level export data from UN Comtrade across 20 products, 15 countries, and 21 years. The discrete-state SPMC analysis reveals three core findings. First, 11 of 15 countries show statistically significant Markov structure in instrument choice. Second, formal tests show that IP-targeted products experiencing high export growth have the same probability of maintaining that growth as non-targeted products: P(high growth next | IP+High) = 0.471 versus P(high growth next | NoIP+High) = 0.461, with the difference not significant (z = 0.314, p = 0.754). Third, a horizon scan on a balanced panel shows that Markov structure peaks at a 1-2 year lag and vanishes by 8 years. These findings suggest that IP targeting does not create detectable persistence in export growth outcomes at the product level, with the true effect bounded within 7 percentage points of zero.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了产业政策从华盛顿共识市场失灵范式向市场塑造范式的学术转向，并运用半参数马尔可夫链（SPMC）框架分析了15个国家、20种产品、21年间的15,735项产业政策干预。研究发现：①多数国家的政策工具选择具有显著马尔可夫结构；②受产业政策支持的高出口增长产品，其增长持续性与非支持产品无显著差异；③马尔可夫结构在1-2年后达到峰值，8年后消失。结论表明，产业政策在产品层面并未带来出口增长的持久效应，真实效应被限制在零附近的7个百分点以内。
AI.research_question: 产业政策是否能够创造产品层面出口增长的持久性效应？即受产业政策支持的高出口增长产品，其增长持续性是否显著优于未受支持的产品？
AI.motivation: 产业政策近年来重新成为政策讨论的核心，但对其效果的实证证据仍不充分。既有研究多关注宏观增长或行业层面，缺乏对产品层面微观机制的严格检验。本文试图弥补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: ①使命导向框架（Mazzucato, Rodrik, Chang, Stiglitz）：从市场失灵到市场塑造的国家角色转向；②半参数马尔可夫链（SPMC）框架：原用于算法外汇交易中的制度识别，首次被应用于产业政策分析。
AI.method: 采用半参数马尔可夫链（SPMC）分析框架，使用Juhász等（2025）数据集（15,735项干预），匹配UN Comtrade HS6产品层面出口数据，覆盖20种产品、15个国家、21年，进行离散状态马尔可夫结构检验、条件概率比较及水平扫描分析。
AI.findings: ①15个国家中有11个的政策工具选择呈现显著马尔可夫结构；②受产业政策支持的高出口增长产品维持高增长的概率（47.1%）与未受支持产品（46.1%）无显著差异（z=0.314, p=0.754）；③马尔可夫结构在1-2年滞后时达到峰值，8年后完全消失。产业政策的真实效应被限制在零附近7个百分点以内。
AI.theory_contributions: ①将SPMC框架首次引入产业政策实证分析，提供了一种新的制度识别方法；②对使命导向框架进行了实证检验，发现产业政策在产品层面缺乏持续效应，对市场塑造理论提供了审慎的经验证据；③明确了产业政策效应的边界条件（7个百分点以内）。
AI.practical_contributions: ①为政策制定者提供了产业政策效果的上限参考（不超过7个百分点）；②提示产业政策在微观产品层面可能无法创造持久竞争优势，建议政策设计需关注市场机制而非选择性干预；③为发展中国家产业政策设计提供了基于大规模数据的实证依据。

title: Upgrading Housing: The Potential and Limits of Borrower-based Measures
affiliations: Council on Economic Policies, Magyar Nemzeti Bank, Latvijas Banka, Národná banka Slovenska, National Bank of Slovakia and Central Bank of Hungary

detail.title: Upgrading Housing: The Potential and Limits of Borrower-based Measures
detail.abstract: In this paper, we explore how borrower-based measures (BBMs) can be adjusted to provide additional funding for housing-related energy-efficiency investments without compromising financial stability objectives. We first show that lower energy costs and higher house price values resulting from renovation work allows an easing of borrowing limits while keeping loan risk metrics unchanged. We then focus on three recent easing measures implemented in Slovakia, Hungary, and Latvia and assess their effectiveness using a bank survey. We find that these policy changes did not significantly affect banks’ credit portfolio risk profile and thus financial stability. At the same time, they did not generate a significant increase in loans for energy-efficient investments. We thus suggest combining BBM adjustments with other policy measures to improve energy-efficiency in real estate.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了如何在不影响金融稳定的前提下，通过调整基于借款人措施的宏观审慎政策，为住房能效改造投资提供额外融资。
AI.research_question: 如何调整借款人措施以在维持金融稳定的同时，为住房能效改造投资提供额外资金？
AI.motivation: 住房能效改造需要大量资金，而现有借款人措施可能限制银行提供此类贷款；同时需确保金融稳定不受影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能效改造可降低能源成本并提升房价，从而在不增加贷款风险的前提下放宽借款限制。
AI.method: 理论分析能效改造对贷款风险的影响，并结合斯洛伐克、匈牙利和拉脱维亚三项近期宽松措施，使用银行调查数据评估其有效性。
AI.findings: 这三项政策调整未显著改变银行信贷组合的风险状况，因此未影响金融稳定；但同时，它们也未能显著推动能效投资贷款增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 从理论和实证角度论证了借款人措施调整可在不影响金融稳定的前提下支持绿色转型，但单独效果有限。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议将借款人措施调整与其他政策工具（如补贴、税收优惠等）结合使用，以更有效地提升房地产能效。

title: Institutional Governance and the Direction of Global Capital Flows

detail.title: Institutional Governance and the Direction of Global Capital Flows
detail.abstract:
The global financial system confronts a structural paradox: countries with similar macroeconomic fundamentals and exposure to identical global financial conditions experience systematically different capital-flow outcomes. This paper argues that the missing variable is governance trajectory—the medium-run direction of change in institutional quality—which operates as a dynamic credibility signal through which investors price not merely where institutional systems stand, but whether they are strengthening or deteriorating over time.

The paper develops a conceptual framework linking institutional governance to cross-border capital allocation through credibility channels, and introduces the Institutional Governance Performance Index™ (IGPI™)—a composite of four World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators dimensions: regulatory quality, rule of law, government effectiveness, and control of corruption. Governance trajectory is operationalised as the five-year change in IGPI.

The empirical strategy is a two-way fixed-effects panel model covering 68 advanced and emerging economies from 2000 to 2024. A compound instrumental variable—exploiting variation in IMF programme entry driven by exogenous IMF liquidity cycles interacted with country-specific prior programme probability—addresses reverse causality. Data combine four publicly available sources: World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators (2025 revision), IMF Balance of Payments Statistics, the U.S. Federal Reserve EFFR series from FRED, and the Cboe VIX index.

Results indicate that governance trajectory is statistically significant and economically material across all three capital-flow categories. A ten-point improvement in the five-year IGPI trajectory is associated with approximately 0.9 percentage points of additional FDI and 0.67 percentage points of additional portfolio inflows as shares of GDP—consistent with Alfaro, Kalemli-Ozcan, and Volosovych's (2008) benchmark that institutional quality is the leading explanation for the Lucas paradox. A moderation specification reveals that improving governance trajectories buffer economies against the global financial cycle: a ten-point VIX increase triggers portfolio outflows roughly half as large in high-trajectory economies compared to deteriorating-governance peers.

These findings carry direct implications for capital-flow management, macroprudential policy, and financial surveillance. The paper additionally introduces the Institutional Credibility Signal™ (ICS™)—a commercialisable governance-trajectory scoring instrument with a four-tier rating architecture designed for use by sovereign wealth funds, development finance institutions, and international financial institutions as a complement to existing macroprudential risk monitoring frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出治理轨迹（制度质量的五年变化方向）是解释国家间资本流动差异的关键变量，并构建了IGPI指数。实证表明治理轨迹显著影响FDI和组合投资流入，且能缓冲全球金融周期冲击。文章还推出了商用化的ICS评级工具。
AI.research_question: 为什么具有相似宏观经济基本面和相同全球金融条件的国家，会经历系统性不同的资本流动结果？治理轨迹（制度质量的中期变化方向）是否以及如何影响跨境资本配置？
AI.motivation: 全球金融体系存在结构性悖论：基本面相似的国家面对相同的全球金融条件，资本流动结果却存在系统性差异。现有文献多关注制度质量的存量水平，忽视了制度变化的动态信号作用。该论文试图弥补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度治理通过"可信度信号"（credibility channel）影响跨境资本配置：投资者不仅关注制度当前的水平，更关注其是在改善还是恶化。治理轨迹作为动态可信度信号，调节资本流动。此外，良好的治理轨迹可以缓冲全球金融周期（以VIX衡量）对资本流动的冲击。
AI.method: 采用双向固定效应面板模型，覆盖68个发达与新兴经济体（2000-2024年）。核心解释变量为IGPI的五年变化（治理轨迹）。构建复合工具变量（IMF流动性周期×国家先验项目概率）处理反向因果。数据来源：世界银行WGI、IMF国际收支统计、美联储EFFR、Cboe VIX指数。
AI.findings: （1）治理轨迹对三类资本流动均统计显著且经济意义重大：IGPI五年轨迹每提高10点，FDI流入增加约0.9个百分点、组合投资流入增加约0.67个百分点（占GDP比重）；（2）治理轨迹能缓冲全球金融周期：高治理轨迹国家的VIX冲击导致的组合资本外流规模仅为治理恶化国家的一半。这佐证了Alfaro等人（2008）关于制度质量是"卢卡斯悖论"主要解释的结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"治理轨迹"（governance trajectory）概念，将制度分析从静态存量拓展到动态变化方向；引入"可信度信号"机制解释制度质量影响资本流动的动态途径；发现治理轨迹对全球金融周期的缓冲效应，丰富了国际宏观经济学中"制度-资本流动"的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资本流动管理、宏观审慎政策和金融监测提供实证依据；推出商用化的ICS™评级工具（四层评级架构），可供主权财富基金、开发性金融机构和国际金融机构用于补充现有宏观审慎风险监测框架。

title: Social Media Algorithms as Information Intermediaries
affiliations: Brigham Young University - Marriott School, London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE), Brigham Young University and Texas A&M University - Department of Accounting

detail.title: Social Media Algorithms as Information Intermediaries
detail.abstract: We study how algorithmic content curation on financial social media shapes investor behavior and market outcomes. Using granular, user-level data on realized exposure to algorithmically curated content on StockTwits, we find that recommendation systems increase investor engagement and trading while crowding out attention to non-curated alternatives. Algorithmic curation appears to harm investor welfare, as it is associated with less informed retail trades and return reversals. These effects concentrate among users most susceptible to attention-driven trading and firms where this trading is most likely to move prices away from fundamental values. Findings are robust to alternative identification strategies, and extend to periods of major firm-specific news arrival. Our evidence demonstrates that algorithmically curated content appears to amplify uninformed, attention-driven trading in ways that erode the informativeness of retail order flow and impair market quality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了金融社交媒体上的算法内容推荐如何影响投资者行为和市场结果。利用StockTwits平台的用户级数据，发现推荐系统增加了投资者参与度和交易量，但挤出了对非推荐内容的关注。算法推荐与信息含量较低的零售交易和收益反转相关，损害了投资者福利。这些效应集中在易受注意力驱动交易影响的用户和公司中。研究表明算法推荐放大了无信息、注意力驱动的交易，削弱了零售订单流的信息含量和市场质量。
AI.research_question: 金融社交媒体上的算法内容推荐如何影响投资者行为和市场质量？
AI.motivation: 算法内容推荐在社交媒体中广泛应用，但其对金融市场参与者行为和效率的影响尚未得到充分研究。理解这种影响对投资者福利和市场质量至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意力驱动交易理论、信息含量理论、市场微观结构理论
AI.method: 利用StockTwits平台用户级别的实际算法内容推荐暴露数据，采用多种识别策略（包括替代识别方法）进行实证分析，并检验公司重大新闻期间的稳健性。
AI.findings: 1) 推荐系统增加投资者参与度和交易量，但挤出了对非推荐内容的关注；2) 算法推荐与信息含量更低的零售交易和收益反转相关，损害投资者福利；3) 效应集中在易受注意力驱动交易影响的用户和公司；4) 结果在多种识别策略和重大新闻期间均稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了算法内容推荐作为注意力驱动交易放大机制的理论路径，拓展了金融市场信息效率和零售交易行为理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估金融社交媒体算法推荐对市场质量的影响提供了实证证据；对平台设计、投资者保护和市场效率提升具有政策启示。

title: The Insecurity Triad (Part 1): Foundations of Convergence and Rival Sovereignty — An Analysis of Money, Land, and Mind (MLM)

detail.title: The Insecurity Triad (Part 1): Foundations of Convergence and Rival Sovereignty — An Analysis of Money, Land, and Mind (MLM)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research was conducted under the auspices of the Sundiata Post Intelligence Unit (SPIU). I am the Founder and CEO of Sundiata Post Media Ltd. No external funding was received for this study, and I declare no competing interests.

detail.abstract:
In this landmark inaugural paper, Max Amuchie, architect of The Insecurity Triad and the Trinity of State Decay theory, introduces the MLM Framework (Money, Land, and Mind) as a definitive analytical architecture for diagnosing the structural collapse of state sovereignty. Published as part of the Sundiata Post Intelligence Unit (SPIU) Working Paper Series, the study posits that kidnapping, banditry, and terrorism function as a synergistic "Insecurity Triad"—a convergence of mutually constitutive forces. This research contests conventional theories of "state failure," arguing instead that these forces produce a sophisticated structural contest over legitimate authority. By applying the MLM Framework, the author demonstrates how non-state actors do not merely create chaos; they establish a "Rival Order" by seizing control of illicit economic arteries (Money), territorial sovereignty (Land), and the psychological loyalty of the citizenry (Mind).

Drawing upon a rigorous theoretical genealogy—bridging the seminal insights of Ali Mazrui, Claude Ake, Achille Mbembe, Jean-François Bayart, and William Reno—the author situates this framework within the vanguard of African political thought while asserting its status as an original, predictive doctrine. While Nigeria serves as the generative case study, the framework’s logic is universal: it travels wherever these three forces coalesce to replace institutional governance with shadow sovereignty.

The paper argues that contemporary security discourse is fundamentally flawed, as it remains tethered to isolated threat categories that fail to perceive the convergent logic of modern insecurity. THE INSECURITY TRIAD provides the necessary corrective, offering an integrated strategic architecture that positions state recovery not as the repair of a "failed" entity, but as the deliberate production of a new political and security equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"不安全三角"与"金钱、土地、心智（MLM）框架"，认为绑架、土匪和恐怖主义并非单纯的混乱制造者，而是通过控制经济命脉、领土主权和民众心理忠诚，建立"敌对秩序"，从而结构性挑战国家主权。
AI.research_question: 非国家行为体如何通过绑架、土匪和恐怖主义这三种力量的协同作用，替代国家治理并建立"影子主权"？
AI.motivation: 现有安全话语囿于孤立的威胁分类（如单独看待恐怖主义或土匪），未能识别当代不安全状态的汇聚逻辑；需要一种整合性分析架构来理解国家结构性崩溃的深层机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: "不安全三角"（Insecurity Triad）：绑架、土匪、恐怖主义作为相互构成的力量协同运作；"国家衰败三位一体"（Trinity of State Decay）；MLM框架（金钱、土地、心智）；"敌对秩序"（Rival Order）概念；理论基础涵盖Ali Mazrui、Claude Ake、Achille Mbembe、Jean-François Bayart、William Reno等非洲政治思想家的理论。
AI.method: 理论谱系梳理与框架建构，以尼日利亚为生成性案例，但主张框架具有普遍适用性。
AI.findings: 非国家行为体并非制造无序，而是建立"敌对秩序"；它们通过控制非法经济动脉（金钱）、领土主权（土地）和民众心理忠诚（心智）来取代制度治理；当代安全话语因范式错误而失效。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"不安全三角"作为原创性预测性学说，整合非洲政治思想传统，挑战传统"国家失败"理论，提供诊断国家结构性崩溃的新分析架构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为安全战略提供整合性架构，重新定位国家恢复的目标——不是修复"失败"实体，而是有意创造新的政治与安全均衡。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Knowledge Accessibility, and the Democratisation of High-Quality Research
affiliations: , , Independent Researcher and Independent Researcher

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Knowledge Accessibility, and the Democratisation of High-Quality Research
detail.abstract: High-quality research has historically been produced under conditions of unequal access, not unequal access to information, which the internet substantially addressed, but unequal access to the intellectual practices through which ideas are sharpened, challenged, and made defensible. Those practices, adversarial debate, red teaming, and steel-manning, have required proximity to qualified interlocutors that most researchers, particularly those outside elite institutional environments and in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), have never had. Drawing on Bourdieu's (1986) framework of cultural capital and Merton's (1968) concept of the Matthew effect, this paper argues that artificial intelligence (AI) is the first technology to meaningfully change, at scale, the distribution of access to these practices. That change is real, conditional, and partial. It is real because the practices are now technically accessible where they were previously unavailable. It is conditional because realising their value requires AI literacy, intellectual disposition, and critical engagement with AI's documented limitations, including the sycophancy problem (Perez et al., 2023; Sharma et al., 2023) and the hallucination problem (Ji et al., 2023; Maynez et al., 2020). It is partial because the legitimation of knowledge, whose research counts and why, remains concentrated in the same institutional structures as before. Against this backdrop, the paper identifies and analyses a structural contradiction we term the Paywall Paradox. Publishers have justified access restrictions on the grounds that peer review, editorial judgment, and institutional validation have value that should be compensated through access fees (Larivière et al., 2015). Critics have long contested this: peer reviewers are unpaid volunteers (Aczel et al., 2021), most research is publicly funded (Piwowar et al., 2018), and Elsevier's 37.1% operating profit margin, £942 million on £2.5 billion in revenues, is inconsistent with a cost-recovery rationale (Times Higher Education, 2019; SPARC, 2019; Larivière et al., 2015). That same research was then licensed to train AI without researcher consent or compensation: Informa projected £58 million ($75 million) in AI-related revenues for 2024 (Battersby, 2024); Springer Nature signed a $23 million deal with Google; Wiley signed a comparable agreement (Will Scott, 2025). This renders the process legitimacy argument structurally inconsistent. The paper also documents AI detection false-positive rates of 9% to 61.3% (OpenAI, 2023a; SurferSEO, 2026), the inconsistent landscape of journal AI disclosure policies, and the emerging open-access alternatives, particularly diamond open access, that represent the most coherent structural response to the Paywall Paradox. The paper concludes with specific, actionable policy recommendations for researchers, institutions, journals, and funders. This paper is a companion to Obasa and Obasa (2026a), which introduced Iterative Adversarial Inquiry (IAI); the Whetstone Method.

AI.tldr: 本文论证AI是首个大规模改变学术实践中批判性辩论、红队测试和钢化论证等智力实践可及性的技术，但这一改变是真实的、有条件的、且局部的。论文识别了"付费墙悖论"这一结构性矛盾，并提出了相关政策建议。
AI.research_question: AI能否以及如何改变研究人员（尤其是精英机构及中低收入国家的研究人员）对批判性智力实践（ adversarial debate, red teaming, steel-manning）的可及性？这一改变面临哪些条件与局限？
AI.motivation: 传统上，高质量研究依赖于少数精英机构中才具备的智力实践环境（如批判性辩论），互联网并未解决这一问题。大量研究人员，尤其是中低收入国家的研究者，缺乏获得这些实践的机会。本文旨在探讨AI是否成为首个大规模改变这种不平等分配格局的技术。
AI.theoretical_framework: Bourdieu (1986) 的文化资本理论；Merton (1968) 的马太效应
AI.method: 理论分析结合文献综述，识别并分析"付费墙悖论"这一结构性矛盾，并综合实证数据（AI检测误报率、出版商利润率、AI收入预测等）进行论证。
AI.findings: 1. AI确实具备大规模改变智力实践可及性的潜力；2. 这一改变是真实的（技术可及）、有条件的（需AI素养与批判性参与）、局部的（知识合法化仍集中在原有机构结构）；3. 识别了"付费墙悖论"——出版商利用公共资助、志愿者审稿的研究获取暴利，又将数据许可给AI训练，缺乏结构一致性；4. AI检测工具误报率高达9%-61.3%；5. 钻石开放获取是最具结构一致性的应对方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Bourdieu的文化资本理论与Merton的马太效应延伸至AI与学术实践可及性领域，揭示了AI作为技术干预如何在不平等的知识生产体系中发挥作用，并系统提出了"付费墙悖论"这一理论概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员、机构、期刊和资助者提供了具体的可操作政策建议；指出了AI检测工具的局限性及学术期刊AI披露政策的不一致性；倡导钻石开放获取作为解决付费墙悖论的结构性路径。

title: Ecosystem Integrity and Agricultural Productivity in Nordic and Baltic Countries
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF),  and Prometeia SpA

detail.title: Ecosystem Integrity and Agricultural Productivity in Nordic and Baltic Countries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests. The views expressed are those of the authors and do not necessarily represent the views of the International Monetary Fund, climaTRACES Lab, and Prometeia.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Using the 1 km × 1 km Ecosystem Condition Index (ECI), we study whether ecosystem degradation, defined as 1-ECI, is associated with lower agricultural gross value added per hectare of cropland in 83 NUTS3 regions across seven Nordic and Baltic countries. In a Cobb-Douglas specification with country fixed effects, agricultural capital and hours worked per hectare, the estimated elasticity ranges from-0.26 to-0.17, and it is robust to climate anomalies, land-use shares, air pollution, water stress, and proxies for flood control and soil retention.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1公里×1公里分辨率的生态系统状况指数(ECI)，研究了北欧和波罗的海七国83个NUTS3区域中生态系统退化（定义为1-ECI）与每公顷农业总增加值之间的关系。在包含国家固定效应的柯布-道格拉斯生产函数设定下，估计弹性系数在-0.26至-0.17之间，且该结果对气候异常、土地利用结构、空气污染、水资源压力以及防洪和土壤保持代理变量具有稳健性。
AI.research_question: 生态系统退化（以1-ECI衡量）与农业产出（每公顷农业总增加值）之间是否存在显著关联？
AI.motivation: 量化生态系统退化对农业经济产出的影响，为生态保护与农业可持续发展提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 柯布-道格拉斯生产函数框架，将生态系统状况作为生产要素纳入分析。
AI.method: 使用1公里×1公里高分辨率ECI数据，构建包含国家固定效应的柯布-道格拉斯生产函数模型进行回归分析，并进行了多重稳健性检验（控制气候、土地利用、污染、水资源压力等因素）。
AI.findings: 生态系统退化对农业产出的弹性系数为-0.26至-0.17，即生态系统状况每下降1%，每公顷农业总增加值下降约0.17%-0.26%，且该负向关系在不同控制变量下保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 将高分辨率生态系统状况指数纳入生产函数分析，拓展了生态经济学中生态系统服务价值评估的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为北欧和波罗的海地区的农业政策制定者提供了量化证据，表明保护生态系统对于维持和提高农业生产力具有重要的经济意义。

title: The Distributional Invariance of Steady-State Capital

detail.title: The Distributional Invariance of Steady-State Capital
detail.abstract: This paper studies the determination of steady-state capital in a broad class of intertemporal general equilibrium models with heterogeneous agents. We show that when investment is governed by a no-arbitrage condition equating expected returns to time preference and marginal productivity, the stationary capital stock is uniquely pinned down by primitives and is invariant to redistributions that preserve aggregate resources. The result holds independently of liquidity constraints, heterogeneous marginal propensities to consume, or incomplete markets, provided that distributional composition does not enter equilibrium return determination directly. The paper formalizes this distributional invariance property and characterizes the minimal structural conditions under which it fails. Distribution affects long-run capital only when it alters the equilibrium return condition, the investment mapping, equilibrium risk premia, or the feasible production frontier. In contrast, distribution may substantially influence transitional dynamics without affecting stationary capacity. The analysis provides a general structural criterion for distinguishing environments in which redistribution changes intertemporal adjustment paths from those in which it changes equilibrium capital itself.

AI.tldr: 本文研究异质性代理人跨期一般均衡模型中稳态资本的决定。当投资由无套利条件决定时，稳态资本存量由基础参数唯一确定，且对保持总资源的再分配不变。论文刻画了这一"分配不变性"性质及其失效条件。
AI.research_question: 在异质性代理人跨期一般均衡模型中，稳态资本存量是否受收入分配（再分配）的影响？其决定机制和边界条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 文献中关于分配是否影响长期资本存量的结论存在分歧，本文试图提供一个统一的理论框架，阐明分配影响稳态资本存量的充分必要条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨期一般均衡模型、无套利条件（预期回报率等于时间偏好和边际生产率）、分配不变性（Distributional Invariance）。
AI.method: 理论建模与结构分析。在一类广义的异质性代理人跨期一般均衡模型中，通过数学推导证明稳态资本存量的唯一性，并刻画分配不变性成立与失效的条件。
AI.findings: (1) 当投资由无套利条件决定时，稳态资本由基础参数唯一确定，对保持总资源的再分配不变；(2) 该结果独立于流动性约束、异质性边际消费倾向或不完全市场；(3) 分配只有在改变均衡回报条件、投资映射、均衡风险溢价或可行生产前沿时才会影响长期资本；(4) 分配显著影响转移动态但不影响稳态产能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了分配不变性的严格形式化证明；系统刻画了分配影响长期资本存量的结构条件；为区分"分配改变调整路径"与"分配改变均衡资本本身"提供了普遍的结构性判据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者判断再分配政策是否影响长期经济增长提供理论依据；帮助区分分配政策对短期调整路径和长期稳态产能的不同影响。

title: Businesses' Contributions to Achievement of the SDGs for People with Disabilities
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Businesses' Contributions to Achievement of the SDGs for People with Disabilities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: Everyone, including people with disabilities, has the right to a basic standard of living adequate for their own health and well-being and for their families including access to employment and decent work, financial services and economic resources, adequate food (freedom from hunger and access to nutritious food), clothing, clean water and sanitation (essential for health and hygiene), secure housing (safe, habitable shelter with access to services like water, sanitation and electricity and protection from displacement), health services (physical and mental well-being, particularly for vulnerable groups like children, mothers, and persons with disabilities), necessary social security (protection against economic shocks due to unemployment, disability, or old age) and services and education.
