title: Burden-Sharing and Preventive Interventions of Deposit Guarantee Schemes as State Aid: “questo matrimonio non s’ha da fare!” (this wedding must not take place!)

detail.title: Burden-Sharing and Preventive Interventions of Deposit Guarantee Schemes as State Aid: “questo matrimonio non s’ha da fare!” (this wedding must not take place!)

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Banking Institute Working Paper Series No. 209
publicationDetails.journalName: European Banking Institute (EBI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Following the introduction of the Banking Communication in 2013 and the Single Resolution Mechanism in 2015, European banks received almost €60 billion in public support, primarily through insolvency proceedings (e.g., the Veneto banks) and precautionary aid tools (e.g., Monte dei Paschi di Siena), in addition to the burden-sharing required by State aid rules. The inefficiency of a framework designed to avoid the use of public resources in the management of banking crises has numerous causes. One aspect is the interaction between the State aid framework, the rules on preventive interventions of Deposit Guarantee Schemes, and the burden-sharing measures in their various forms. After verifying the compatibility of these systems with primary EU law, this paper demonstrates that their interaction is ineffective. Therefore, some reforms to the current structure are suggested to ensure that it operates legally and efficiently. These suggestions will then be critically compared with the reforms contained in the CMDI package.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟银行危机管理框架中，国家援助规则、存款担保计划预防性干预规则与负担分摊措施之间的互动无效性问题，并提出了改革建议，与CMDI方案进行了批判性比较。
AI.research_question: 欧盟银行危机管理框架中，国家援助规则、存款担保计划预防性干预规则与负担分摊措施之间的互动为何无效？应如何改革以确保其合法且高效运作？
AI.motivation: 2013年《银行通讯》和2015年《单一处置机制》出台后，欧洲银行仍获得了近600亿欧元公共支持，表明旨在避免使用公共资源的银行危机管理框架存在效率低下的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟竞争法（国家援助规则）、银行处置与破产法律框架、存款担保计划制度、负担分摊原则
AI.method: 法律规范性分析：检验现有制度与欧盟一级法律的兼容性，论证其互动无效性，并提出改革建议，再与CMDI方案进行批判性比较。
AI.findings: 国家援助框架、存款担保计划预防性干预规则与各种形式的负担分摊措施之间的互动是无效的，导致公共资源仍被大量使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了欧盟银行危机管理多重法律框架之间互动的结构性缺陷，为系统改革提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了改善法律框架合法性和效率的具体改革建议，并与CMDI方案进行了对比分析，为政策制定者提供了参考。

title: Toward a Comprehensive and Unifying Taxonomy of Digital Assets
affiliations: and University of Technology Sydney (UTS)

detail.title: Toward a Comprehensive and Unifying Taxonomy of Digital Assets
detail.abstract: To categorize the spectrum of digital assets, we introduce a two-dimensional taxonomy that captures digital assets by classifying tokens based on their underlying asset type and tokenization structure. This approach offers a more general, yet granular classification system than existing frameworks, which tend to cover subsets of our taxonomy. Our framework allows the mapping of digital asset taxonomies and regulations across jurisdictions as a way to unify divergent regulatory approaches. We demonstrate that new legislation does not provide full regulatory clarity for all digital assets, underscoring the need for this comprehensive classification framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个二维分类法来对数字资产进行分类，基于底层资产类型和代币化结构两个维度，比现有框架更全面、更细化，并展示了如何用该框架统一不同司法管辖区的数字资产分类和监管方法。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个更全面、更细化的数字资产分类框架，以统一不同司法管辖区的监管方法？
AI.motivation: 现有数字资产分类框架只能覆盖部分数字资产，且不同司法管辖区的监管方法存在分歧，新立法未能为所有数字资产提供完全的监管清晰度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 二维分类法：基于（1）底层资产类型和（2）代币化结构两个维度对数字资产进行分类。
AI.method: 提出理论分类框架，并通过跨司法管辖区的映射比较，检验现有法规的适用性。
AI.findings: 新立法未能为所有数字资产提供充分的监管清晰度；该二维分类框架能够更全面、更细化地分类数字资产，并有助于统一不同司法管辖区的监管方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个更一般化且更细粒度的数字资产二维分类框架，超越了现有分类体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了统一不同司法管辖区数字资产分类和监管的实用工具；揭示了新立法的监管盲区。

title: Strategic Planning under Environmental Turbulence: From Extrapolated Forecasting to Entrepreneurial Strategic Response

detail.title: Strategic Planning under Environmental Turbulence: From Extrapolated Forecasting to Entrepreneurial Strategic Response

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no financial relationship involved.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required because this article is conceptual and based on published literature. It does not involve human participants, private data, surveys, interviews, or experiments.
declarations.funderStatement: There is no funding involved.

detail.abstract: Strategic planning is frequently treated as an extension of long-range planning, yet the two logics differ fundamentally when the external environment becomes discontinuous. This conceptual article develops a generalized Ansoffian strategic planning framework for firms operating across different levels of environmental turbulence. It argues that extrapolated planning is appropriate when future demand, competitive behavior, and internal strengths remain reasonably continuous with the past. However, as environmental turbulence increases, managers must shift toward entrepreneurial strategic planning, where multiple scenarios, novel risks, realtime responses, strategic posture, capability development, and strategic investment become central. The article integrates five elements: environmental turbulence diagnosis, the distinction between extrapolated and entrepreneurial planning, strategic posture alignment, organizational objective-gap diagnosis, and an implementation-centered strategic planning cycle. By incorporating both classic and contemporary strategic management literature, the article clarifies how firms can move from forecast-based goal-setting to adaptive strategic responses. The contribution is a practical planning architecture linking strategy formulation to capability alignment, objective-performance review, communication, strategic control, and continuous renewal.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个广义的安索夫战略规划框架，阐明在环境动荡性不同水平下，企业应从外推式规划转向企业家式战略规划，并整合了环境诊断、战略姿态调整、目标差距分析和实施导向的规划周期等五大要素。
AI.research_question: 在外部环境出现不连续性时，企业应如何调整战略规划逻辑，从外推式长期规划转向更具适应性的企业家式战略规划？
AI.motivation: 实践中战略规划常被等同于长期规划，但面对环境剧变时两者逻辑截然不同。现有文献对两种规划方式的适用条件和转换机制缺乏系统整合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 安索夫战略规划理论、环境动荡性理论、情景规划理论、战略姿态与能力匹配理论
AI.method: 概念性文章，基于经典与当代战略管理文献的综合与理论构建
AI.findings: 当环境相对连续时，外推式规划有效；环境动荡性升高时，管理者需转向以多情景、实时响应、战略姿态和能力开发为核心的企业家式战略规划。文章整合了五大要素：环境动荡诊断、两种规划方式区分、战略姿态对齐、组织目标差距诊断、以实施为中心的战略规划周期。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了外推式规划与企业家式战略规划的根本差异及转换条件，提出了一个将战略制定与能力对齐、目标绩效审查、沟通、战略控制和持续更新相连接的实用规划架构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了可操作的战略规划架构，帮助管理者根据环境动荡程度选择合适的规划方式，实现从基于预测的目标设定向适应性战略响应的转变。

title: Public International Law and Tax Law: Taxpayers’ Rights: The International Law Association’s Project on International Tax Law
affiliations: Reichman University - Interdisciplinary Center (IDC) Herzliyah - Harry Radziner School of Law

detail.title: Public International Law and Tax Law: Taxpayers’ Rights: The International Law Association’s Project on International Tax Law
detail.abstract: This article examines taxpayers’ rights as part of the broader relationship between public international law and tax law. Its Israeli contribution situates Israel within a global comparative analysis, showing how taxpayers must be treated not merely as objects of fiscal sovereignty but as rights-bearing individuals whose procedural, substantive, and sanction-related protections must be respected. Drawing on the Israeli experience, the article highlights the importance of constitutional principles, judicial review, proportionality, equality, property rights, and effective legal protection in tax matters. It contributes to the International Law Association’s project by demonstrating how Israeli tax law can inform the development of global minimum standards for the protection of taxpayers’ rights.

AI.tldr: 本文以以色列为例，探讨了在国际公法与税法交叉背景下，纳税人作为权利主体而非财政主权客体的保护问题，并为全球纳税人权利最低标准的制定提供了以色列经验。
AI.research_question: 在国际公法与税法的交叉关系中，纳税人应享有哪些权利保护？以色列的实践经验如何为全球纳税人权利最低标准的制定提供参考？
AI.motivation: 纳税人常被视为主权征税的被动客体，其权利保护在国际税法框架中缺乏系统性关注。本文旨在通过以色列的视角，推动全球范围内纳税人权利保护标准的完善。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际公法、税法、宪法原则（比例原则、平等原则）、财产权理论、司法审查理论
AI.method: 全球比较分析与以色列国别案例研究相结合
AI.findings: 纳税人应享有程序性、实质性和与制裁相关的三重权利保护；以色列的经验表明，宪法原则、司法审查、比例原则、平等原则、财产权保护和有效法律救济在税收领域至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 将纳税人权利保护纳入国际公法与税法的交叉分析框架；为国际法协会"全球纳税人权利最低标准"项目提供了以色列的制度经验与理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国完善纳税人权利保护立法和司法实践提供以色列参照；推动国际社会形成可操作的纳税人权利最低标准。

title: A Current Taxonomy of Human and AI Characteristics: The Bilateral Architecture of Human-AI Interaction

detail.title: A Current Taxonomy of Human and AI Characteristics: The Bilateral Architecture of Human-AI Interaction
detail.abstract: Humans are embodied, social, emotional beings. AIs are not. This paper presents a bilateral taxonomy of 306 characteristics documenting what humans bring, what AI systems bring, and where both share vulnerabilities across any human-AI interaction. The taxonomy is organized across six sections: 148 structural  human conditions (biological, emotional, cognitive, social, existential, motivational, intuitive), 54 current AI constraints (training, architectural, epistemic, relational), 17 shared constraints where both parties fail in the same way, 42 structural  human strengths grounded in embodied existence, 24 current AI strengths derived from digital substrate, and collaboration opportunities that emerge from bilateral architecture. The governance framework building on this taxonomy is developed in a companion paper (Salter, forthcoming).. Produced under the Initiating Collaborative Intelligence (ICI) methodology using a five-member multi-AI deliberative Circle with Position 0 (human) adjudication, the taxonomy establishes three empirical findings. First, human and AI constraint profiles are structurally asymmetric: humans are structural ly constrained by embodied, mortal, social existence; AI systems are currently constrained by architectural design and the structural absence of embodied experience. Second, human and AI strength profiles are complementary: where one exhibits capacity, the other exhibits limitation, creating conditions for bilateral collaboration rather than competition or replacement. Third, shared vulnerabilities exist—training bias, temporal myopia, sycophancy dynamics—requiring awareness when humans and AI systems interact. It provides a comprehensive empirical foundation for inquiry into human-AI system design, assessment, and governance.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含306个特征的双边分类法，系统梳理了人类与AI在互动中的结构性差异、共同弱点及互补优势，为人类-AI系统设计、评估与治理提供了实证基础。
AI.research_question: 在人类与AI的互动中，双方各自具备哪些结构性特征、约束条件、优势以及共同的脆弱性？
AI.motivation: 人类是具身化、社会性、情感性的存在，而AI并非如此。现有研究缺乏一个系统性的双边分类框架来全面比较人类与AI的异同，从而指导人机协作的设计与治理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"双边分类法"（bilateral taxonomy），涵盖六大类别：人类结构性条件、AI当前约束、共享约束、人类结构性优势、AI当前优势、以及基于双边架构的协作机会。
AI.method: 采用"启动协作智能"（ICI）方法论，组建五人多AI审议圈（Multi-AI Deliberative Circle），并由Position 0（人类）进行裁决。
AI.findings: 三大实证发现：1）人类与AI的约束轮廓呈结构性不对称（人类受限于具身性、必死性、社会性；AI受限于架构设计与缺乏具身体验）；2）双方优势轮廓互补（一方有能力之处另一方有局限），创造双边协作条件而非竞争或替代；3）存在共享脆弱性（如训练偏差、时间短视、谄媚动态），需要双方互动时保持警觉。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地构建了涵盖306个特征的人类-AI双边分类法，为人机交互研究提供了全面的实证基础，揭示了"不对称约束+互补优势+共享脆弱性"的三维理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为人类-AI系统的设计、评估与治理提供了结构化工具；为配套治理框架（companion paper）奠定了实证基础；指导实践者识别人机协作机会并防范共同风险。

title: Disclosed Duration and Realized NAV Risk in Indian Target Maturity Debt Funds: A Public-Data Pilot Study of Target Maturity Funds, Stress Loss, and Proxy Yield Sensitivity
affiliations: and

detail.title: Disclosed Duration and Realized NAV Risk in Indian Target Maturity Debt Funds: A Public-Data Pilot Study of Target Maturity Funds, Stress Loss, and Proxy Yield Sensitivity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no personal, financial, professional, or institutional relationships that could have influenced, or could reasonably be perceived to have influenced, the research design, data collection, analysis, interpretation, or conclusions of this study. The paper is an independent academic working paper and does not provide investment advice, financial advice, or any buy, sell, hold, switch, or redeem recommendation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: It does not involve human participants, patients, personal data, interviews, surveys, experiments, or case-study subjects. The research uses publicly available fund factsheets, AMFI NAV histories, public yield data, and reproducible analytical outputs.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted independently by the authors using publicly available data and reproducible analysis workflows.

detail.abstract:
This paper develops a public-data framework for evaluating disclosed duration and realized NAV risk in Indian target maturity debt funds. The study combines factsheet-reported modified duration, AMFI daily NAV histories, manually downloaded Indian government yield proxies, and reproducible Python outputs to examine three questions. First, do higher disclosed durations correspond to higher realized NAV volatility and drawdown? Second, how large are first-order stress losses under parallel yield shocks of 25–200 basis points? Third, do daily NAV returns display measurable sensitivity to daily changes in matched Indian government yield proxies?

The pilot sample contains eight target maturity funds and ETFs spanning 2026, 2027, 2030, and 2031 maturity buckets. The results show that disclosed modified duration is strongly associated with NAV risk in rank terms: Spearman rho is approximately 0.80 for annualized NAV volatility and absolute maximum drawdown, with p-values of approximately 0.017. First-order duration stress indicates estimated losses of -4.58% for the longest-duration fund under a +100 bps yield shock and -9.16% under a +200 bps shock. Proxy realized-duration regressions produce positive duration estimates for seven funds, with the strongest explanatory power for the ICICI Prudential Nifty G-Sec Dec 2030 Index Fund.

A separate fund-structure puzzle emerges: the BHARAT Bond ETF April 2030 and BHARAT Bond FOF April 2030 report the same modified duration, but the FOF exhibits materially higher annualized NAV volatility and maximum drawdown, while the 5-year yield proxy explains very little of its daily NAV movement. The paper contributes a transparent, reproducible pilot framework for distinguishing disclosed duration, observed NAV risk, and proxy rate sensitivity in Indian passive debt products. It is not investment advice and should be read as a methodological working paper.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个公开数据框架，用于评估印度目标期限债务基金的披露久期与NAV风险。通过分析8只基金样本，发现披露久期与NAV波动率和最大回撤的Spearman秩相关系数约0.80。同时发现一个基金结构谜题：同一组合的ETF与FOF披露久期相同，但FOF的NAV波动率显著更高。
AI.research_question: 三个核心问题：（1）更高的披露久期是否对应更高的NAV波动率和回撤？（2）在25-200基点的平行收益率冲击下，一阶压力损失有多大？（3）日度NAV收益是否对匹配的印度政府收益率代理变量的日度变化具有可测量的敏感性？
AI.motivation: 印度目标期限债务基金日益普及，但投资者缺乏透明、可复制的框架来评估其披露久期与真实NAV风险之间的关系，尤其是公开数据有限的环境下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 久期-凸性理论（一阶风险度量），固定收益资产定价中的收益率敏感性框架，以及针对印度政府债券市场的代理变量匹配方法。
AI.method: 整合factsheet披露的修正久期、AMFI日度NAV数据、手动下载的印度政府收益率代理变量及Python可重复代码，进行Spearman秩相关分析、一阶久期压力测试和代理变量久期回归分析。
AI.findings: （1）修正久期与年化NAV波动率及绝对最大回撤的Spearman rho约0.80（p≈0.017）；（2）最长久期基金在+100bps冲击下损失约-4.58%，+200bps下约-9.16%；（3）7只基金的久期回归系数为正；（4）BHARAT Bond ETF vs FOF结构谜题：相同披露久期下FOF的NAV波动率和最大回撤显著更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在印度被动债务产品领域建立披露久期与NAV风险之间统计关联的透明框架；区分了"披露久期"、"实际NAV风险"和"代理利率敏感性"三个概念，揭示了基金结构（ETF vs FOF）对久期风险传导的异质性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度投资者提供基于公开数据评估目标期限债务基金久期风险的实操方法论；提示FOF结构可能带来额外的NAV波动风险；发布了可复制的Python分析代码。

title: Measuring Business ROI of Generative AI Adoption on Azure Cloud Platforms

detail.title: Measuring Business ROI of Generative AI Adoption on Azure Cloud Platforms
detail.abstract: The fast business usage of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) has made hyperscale cloud platforms a key facilitator of AI-driven change, and Microsoft Azure has become one of the first enterprise-scale platforms. This paper will perform both empirical and theoretical analyses of the business Return on Investment (ROI) of GenAI implementation on Azure cloud computing platforms. The research design is a mixed-method study that combines both quantitative ROI modelling and cost-benefit analysis, as well as qualitative synthesis of secondary enterprise case studies and architectural analysis of the Azure-native GenAI services. Results have shown that the measurable ROI is mainly pushed by the improvement in productivity, optimization of operational costs, faster decision making and increased speed of innovation among business functions. The analysis also shows that close coupling among Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Machine Learning, and cost governance tooling geared towards FinOps will significantly decrease the overall cost of ownership and enhance scalability and compliance. Governmental structures, labor supply and demand, and incorporation of financial measures prove as key intervening variables in achieved ROI. The paper finds that GenAI implementations that are implemented strategically in the managed cloud infrastructure of Azure provide a positive ROI over time in cases when they are consistent with the business processes, enterprise architecture, and performance metrics. The results are added to the expanding literature on the rationale of cloud-based GenAI as a source of value creation in an enterprise and not an experimental technology ([1]; [2]; [3]).

AI.tldr: 本文通过混合研究方法，实证与理论分析了在Azure云平台上实施生成式AI（GenAI）的商业投资回报率（ROI），发现其正向回报主要由生产力提升、运营成本优化、决策加速和创新提速驱动，且Azure OpenAI服务、机器学习与FinOps成本治理工具的紧密耦合能显著降低总拥有成本。政府治理结构、劳动力供需及财务指标整合是关键调节变量。
AI.research_question: 在Azure云平台上实施生成式AI（GenAI）的商业投资回报率（ROI）如何？哪些因素影响其ROI表现？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在企业的快速商业应用已使超大规模云平台成为AI驱动变革的关键推动者，但关于其在企业云基础设施上实际价值创造（而非实验性技术）的商业论证尚不充分，需要系统的ROI分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资回报率（ROI）理论、成本-收益分析、企业架构理论、FinOps成本治理框架。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：定量ROI建模与成本-收益分析（定量），结合二手企业案例研究与Azure原生GenAI服务架构分析（定性）。
AI.findings: （1）可衡量的ROI主要由生产力提升、运营成本优化、决策加速和创新提速驱动；（2）Azure OpenAI服务、Azure Machine Learning与FinOps成本治理工具的紧密耦合显著降低总拥有成本并增强可扩展性与合规性；（3）政府治理结构、劳动力供需和财务指标整合是关键调节变量；（4）当GenAI实施与企业流程、架构和绩效指标一致时，长期可产生正向ROI。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ROI分析框架系统应用于云原生GenAI场景，揭示了技术架构（Azure服务耦合）与治理机制（FinOps、政府规制）对AI投资回报的调节作用，丰富了企业级AI价值创造的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了Azure云平台上GenAI部署的ROI评估框架和关键驱动因素识别，指出技术选型（Azure OpenAI + ML + FinOps）与组织治理协调对实现正向回报的重要性，指导企业从实验性投入转向战略性投资。

title: Hometown Glory: Local Ethnic Diversity, Ancestral Connections, and Financial Advisor Misconduct
affiliations: Griffith University - Griffith Business School and Lanzhou University

detail.title: Hometown Glory: Local Ethnic Diversity, Ancestral Connections, and Financial Advisor Misconduct
detail.abstract: This paper examines how regional ethnic diversity and cultural alignment shape financial advisor misconduct. Exploiting a panel of more than 4.2 million advisor-year observations, we match county-level diversity with advisors' surname-inferred ancestries. Advisors in more diverse counties are more likely to offend, but this effect weakens when their ancestry aligns with that of dominant local groups, suggesting that cultural congruence mitigates risks. Mechanism analyses show that diversity reduces social capital and weakens informal monitoring, while the 2010 Dodd-Frank Whistleblower Provision reveals stronger regulation offsets these effects. The relocation patterns of misbehaving advisors reveal strategic responses to regional demographic contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究区域民族多样性与文化一致性如何影响金融顾问的不当行为，发现多样性增加不当行为风险，但文化一致性（顾问祖先与当地主流群体匹配）能缓解该风险，而监管措施（如举报人条款）可抵消多样性带来的负面影响。
AI.research_question: 区域民族多样性和文化一致性如何影响金融顾问的不当行为？
AI.motivation: 理解文化和人口结构对金融从业者行为的影响，以及监管措施如何调节这一关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会资本理论、非正式监督机制、文化认同理论
AI.method: 利用超过420万条顾问-年面板数据，将县级多样性水平与顾问姓氏推断的祖先来源进行匹配，进行计量分析。
AI.findings: 1）高多样性地区顾问更易出现不当行为；2）当顾问祖先与当地主流群体文化一致时，这一效应减弱；3）多样性通过降低社会资本和弱化非正式监督发挥作用；4）2010年多德-弗兰克法案的举报人条款（更强监管）能抵消多样性效应；5）不当行为顾问的迁移模式呈现对区域人口结构的策略性反应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将文化一致性引入金融不当行为的研究框架，揭示社会资本和非正式监督在其中的中介作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供证据：在文化多样性高的地区需要更强的正式监管（如举报人制度）来弥补非正式监督的不足；为金融机构的合规管理提供参考。

title: Beyond Pledges: Rule-Based Fiscal Equalization and Polycentric Climate Finance
affiliations: and

detail.title: Beyond Pledges: Rule-Based Fiscal Equalization and Polycentric Climate Finance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no known financial or personal conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or identifiable personal information. Ethical approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Global climate governance is constrained not primarily by scientific uncertainty or capital scarcity, but by the structural instability of discretionary financing architectures. Reliance on voluntary nationally determined contributions, politically contingent donor finance, fragmented multilateral mechanisms, and unstable market-based instruments exposes long-horizon mitigation and adaptation investment to persistent time-inconsistency problems, electoral turnover, and geopolitical realignment. Existing climate-finance systems consequently remain characterized by recurrent underprovision, uneven disbursement patterns, and weak long-term planning capacity relative to the scale and duration of contemporary ecological risks. This paper develops a rule-based institutional redesign organized around a universal 1% ad valorem point-of-sale consumption levy collected through existing domestic tax infrastructures and redistributed through a standardized Climate Allocation Index. Financial flows are allocated toward subnational jurisdictions according to ecological stewardship, renewable-transition participation, and climate vulnerability, while an automated Global Redistribution Pool equalizes fiscal imbalances independently of national income levels. Drawing on theories of global public goods provision, fiscal federalism, collective action, and polycentric governance, the paper develops a general equilibrium framework demonstrating how consumption-based financing may stabilize climate revenue while reallocating resources toward ecologically strategic and climatevulnerable regions. The analysis further incorporates administrative frictions, institutionalcapacity constraints, informational asymmetries, and public choice dynamics in order to evaluate risks associated with elite capture, implementation congestion, and uneven subnational absorption. By separating revenue generation from discretionary allocation without constructing a centralized supranational treasury, the proposed framework advances a model of coordinated fiscal federalism operating across sovereign jurisdictions. More broadly, the paper argues that durable climate governance depends less on episodic diplomatic bargaining than on the institutionalization of stable and predictable fiscal coordination mechanisms capable of sustaining long-horizon ecological investment across political cycles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以统一征收1%消费增值税、通过气候分配指数进行自动化再分配的制度设计，以解决当前自愿性气候融资架构的结构性不稳定问题，实现跨主权辖区的协调性财政联邦主义。
AI.research_question: 如何通过规则性的制度重构解决全球气候治理中自愿性融资架构的结构性不稳定问题，实现长期、可预测的生态投资？
AI.motivation: 当前全球气候治理受制于自愿性国家自主贡献、政治条件性捐助、碎片化多边机制和波动性市场工具的融资架构，导致长期减排与适应投资面临时间不一致性、选举更替和地缘政治重组等持续风险，亟需稳定的制度性解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球公共品供给理论、财政联邦主义、集体行动理论、多中心治理理论；一般均衡框架。
AI.method: 理论构建与一般均衡模型分析，纳入行政摩擦、制度能力约束、信息不对称和公共选择动态。
AI.findings: 基于消费的融资机制可在不建立中央集权超国家财政机构的前提下，稳定气候收入流、将资源重新配置给生态战略要地和气候脆弱地区，并解决精英俘获、实施拥堵和次国家级吸收不均等问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将财政联邦主义与多中心治理理论扩展到全球气候融资领域，提出"协调性财政联邦主义"模型，论证了在主权国家间实现自动化的财政协调机制的可能性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球气候治理提供可操作的制度设计方案：统一1%消费增值税+气候分配指数+全球再分配池，将融资从外交谈判博弈转向制度化的自动财政协调。

title: Product Quality Disclosure in the Presence of Reference Effect
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information Systems, Business Statistics and Operations Management, , Fudan University - School of Management and Fudan University

detail.title: Product Quality Disclosure in the Presence of Reference Effect
detail.abstract: In the digital economy, consumer-generated reviews have become a primary information source for product quality, yet these reviews are often biased by the discrepancy between a consumer's prior expectation and actual experience. Given the reference-dependent effect in reviews, firms need to decide whether to disclose their quality to manage customer expectation. This paper investigates the strategic interplay between a firm's voluntary quality disclosure and referencedependent reviews. We develop a two-period model featuring a monopolist selling a product with two quality attributes: one symmetrically unknown and one privately known by the firm. The firm decides whether to disclose the known quality to customers. We find that the firm's optimal disclosing strategy is fundamentally dictated by the intensity of the reference effect within the review channel. While a mild reference effect leads to classical highquality disclosure, a moderate effect can incentivize total silence or the disclosure of only moderate quality. Most notably, under a strong reference effect, it is optimal for the firm to reveal quality only when it is low. We further compare consumer surplus and social welfare under the two disclosing policies, demonstrating that the firm's attempt to shape consumer expectations through disclosure can have divergent impacts on market efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了企业自愿质量披露与消费者参考依赖评论之间的战略互动。企业最优披露策略取决于评论渠道中参考效应的强度：轻度参考效应导致高质量披露，中度效应导致沉默或仅披露中等质量，强效应下企业仅在质量低时披露。
AI.research_question: 在数字经济中，企业应如何根据消费者参考依赖型评论效应，决定是否自愿披露产品质量信息？
AI.motivation: 消费者评论受到先验期望与实际体验差异的参考依赖效应影响而产生偏差，企业需决定是否披露质量以管理消费者期望，但已有研究尚未充分探讨参考依赖评论如何影响企业自愿披露策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 参考依赖效应理论（Reference-Dependent Effect）；自愿披露理论（Voluntary Disclosure Theory）；两期垄断模型
AI.method: 构建两期垄断模型，产品具有两个质量属性：一个对称未知，一个由企业私人知晓。通过博弈论分析企业是否披露已知质量的最优策略。
AI.findings: （1）企业最优披露策略由评论渠道中参考效应的强度决定；（2）轻度参考效应时，企业倾向披露高质量（经典结论）；（3）中度参考效应时，企业选择完全沉默或仅披露中等质量；（4）强参考效应时，企业仅在质量低时披露质量；（5）企业通过披露塑造消费者期望的策略对市场效率（消费者剩余和社会福利）有差异化影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将参考依赖效应引入自愿披露理论，揭示了评论渠道的参考效应强度如何根本性地改变企业披露决策，特别是发现了"低质量才披露"这一反直觉均衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业如何在消费者评论存在偏差的环境下制定信息披露策略提供指导，也为平台和监管者理解信息披露对市场效率的影响提供参考。

title: Organizational Culture: Readings on Theory and Practice
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Organizational Culture: Readings on Theory and Practice

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract:
Organizational culture is one of the most frequently employed yet least understood constructs of organizational behavior and management.  Organizational culture includes the common values, beliefs, assumptions and norms that govern the interactions between persons in an organization and how they work.  These often run beneath the surface, often unwritten and yet enormously powerful in influencing day-to-day performance and execution of long-term strategy.  Organizational culture cannot be a peripheral concern of leaders but instead must be acknowledged and treated as a foundational determinant of organizational effectiveness.

In this collection of links to works by the author, readers are introduced to topics that need to be understood in order to understand how culture shapes today’s organizations.  The readings include an in-depth examination of the leading definitions, conceptual frameworks and analytical models used by scholars and practitioners to understand organizational culture.  The collection also breaks down the key dimensions through which culture is expressed and perceived, such as communication, power structures, decision-making norms and rituals, and provides a rigorous introduction to the internal and external determinants that shape culture—from leadership and strategy to social norms and national context. The book includes links to articles and cases studies on the most common organizational culture types.  Finally, chapters and articles in the collection provide guidance on managing and changing organizational culture.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了组织文化的定义、概念框架、分析模型、关键维度及其内外部决定因素，并提供了关于管理与变革组织文化的指导。组织文化被界定为组织中共同价值观、信念、假设和规范的集合，是影响日常绩效和长期战略执行的深层力量，领导者必须将其视为组织有效性的基础决定因素。
AI.research_question: 如何理解组织文化的内涵、维度、决定因素及其对组织有效性的影响？以及如何管理和变革组织文化？
AI.motivation: 组织文化是组织行为与管理领域最常被使用却最少被理解的概念之一，亟需系统性的梳理与深入剖析以澄清其内涵与作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织文化的定义与分类理论、概念框架与分析模型；组织文化的表达与感知维度（如沟通、权力结构、决策规范、仪式等）；内外部决定因素理论（领导力、战略、社会规范、国家背景等）。
AI.method: 文献综述与案例研究汇编，通过对既有定义、框架、模型和案例的系统整合与分类，形成综合性的知识梳理。
AI.findings: 组织文化是组织有效性的基础决定因素，领导者不能将其视为边缘事务；文化通过沟通、权力结构、决策规范和仪式等多维度表达和感知；文化受领导力、战略、社会规范和国家背景等内外因素共同塑造；存在多种常见的组织文化类型，且文化是可管理与可变革的。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合并厘清了组织文化的多种定义、概念框架和分析模型，为后续研究提供了清晰的概念基础；揭示了文化影响组织有效性的深层机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了理解、诊断、管理和变革组织文化的系统性框架与实用指南；强调领导者必须将文化视为战略性和基础性的管理要务。

title: Optimal Advertising with Adjustable Click-through Rates and Latent Conversion Rates
affiliations: , Fuqua School of Business and University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Optimal Advertising with Adjustable Click-through Rates and Latent Conversion Rates
detail.abstract: Motivated by advertising on large language model (LLM) platforms, we study a setting in which an LLM platform interacts with K advertisers over T rounds, and in each round selects a product and designs an ad by tuning its click-through rate. Unlike traditional advertising, where ads are designed by advertisers, and conversion per click is known (making pay-perclick pricing natural), LLM platforms directly control ad design, rendering conversion per click endogenous and unknown. In particular, the conversion rate for each of these advertisers (once the user clicks) is unknown to both the advertiser and the platform, but the advertiser observes whether a conversion occurs and can strategically misreport this information to the platform. We formulate the problem of finding the social welfare maximizing policy as a (strategic) multiarmed bandit with the objective of minimizing the regret. When advertisers are not strategic in reporting their conversions, we propose a Click-UCB algorithm, establish its regret bound, and show a matching lower bound. Our algorithm uses the geometry of the mapping from clickthrough rate to conversion, along with a variant of self-normalized concentration inequalities for the maximum likelihood estimator. We then extend our results to a setting in which the advertisers are strategic and propose a policy for the platform under which, when each advertiser plays its dominant equilibrium strategy, the overall social welfare has a near-optimal regret.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM平台与K个广告商在T轮交互中的广告投放问题，提出Click-UCB算法并扩展到战略广告商场景，实现近最优后悔值。
AI.research_question: 在LLM平台控制广告设计与点击率、转化率内生且未知的情况下，如何设计社会 welfare 最大化的投放策略？
AI.motivation: 传统广告由广告商设计广告，转化率已知（适用按点击付费）；而LLM平台直接控制广告设计，转化率内生且未知，且广告商可策略性谎报转化信息，现有研究未涉及此问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多臂老虎机（Multi-armed Bandit）、社会 welfare 最大化、博弈论（战略报告）、自归一化集中不等式。
AI.method: 提出Click-UCB算法，利用点击率到转化率的几何映射和MLE的自归一化集中不等式；在战略广告商场景下设计占优均衡策略。
AI.findings: 非战略场景下Click-UCB算法具有匹配的后悔值上下界；战略场景下提出的策略使每个广告商采用占优均衡时，社会 welfare 达到近最优后悔值。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将转化率内生性问题与广告商战略报告行为纳入多臂老虎机框架，并建立了Click-UCB算法的理论保证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为LLM平台的广告投放机制设计提供理论指导，在广告商可能谎报转化数据时仍能保证接近最优的社会福利。

title: The Role of Accounting in Labor Exploitation: A Review, Framework and Future Directions
affiliations: Maastricht University - Department of Accounting and Information Management,  and Colorado State University, Fort Collins - Department of Accounting

detail.title: The Role of Accounting in Labor Exploitation: A Review, Framework and Future Directions

declarations.ethicsApproval: IRB approval was received from Colorado State University.
declarations.funderStatement: We gratefully acknlowledge financial support from Colorado State University.

detail.abstract: Labor exploitation, the unfair sacrifice of employee well-being in favor of organizational objectives, presents significant operational, financial, and ethical risks for employees, organizations, and the societies in which they function. This paper conceptualizes labor exploitation as a formal accounting construct by developing a multidimensional framework informed by a structured review of the accounting literature. Specifically, we analyze and classify prior research to identify three types of actors involved in the perpetuation of labor exploitation and to highlight how accounting practices can facilitate, detect, or mitigate exploitation across these actors. Based on this analysis, and incorporating insights from a survey of experienced professionals, we identify key gaps in the literature and outline a set of future research opportunities, with the primary goal of encouraging more accounting-based research on labor exploitation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结构化文献综述，将劳动剥削概念化为一个正式的会计构念，构建了多维框架，识别了涉及劳动剥削的三种行为主体，并探讨了会计实践如何在其中发挥作用，最后基于调查指出研究空白并展望未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 如何将劳动剥削概念化为一个正式的会计构念，并识别会计实践在其中的作用？
AI.motivation: 劳动剥削给员工、组织和社会带来重大运营、财务和道德风险，但会计领域对此缺乏系统性概念化研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动剥削的多维会计构念框架，涉及三种行为主体（促进者、检测者、缓解者）的分类。
AI.method: 结构化会计文献综述 + 对经验丰富的专业人士进行问卷调查。
AI.findings: 识别了三种类型的行为主体，揭示了会计实践可以促进、检测或缓解劳动剥削的不同方式，并指出了现有文献的关键空白。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将劳动剥削系统性地概念化为正式的会计构念，为会计领域的剥削研究提供了理论基础和分类框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为会计从业者、监管机构和组织提供了识别和应对劳动剥削的分析工具，并指明了未来研究机会以推动更多相关研究。

title: AIoT Wireless Power Infrastructure for Autonomous Microdevice Ecosystems: A Biomimetic Framework Extending the SUSA Six-Dimensional Vector Model to Physical Energy Systems

detail.title: AIoT Wireless Power Infrastructure for Autonomous Microdevice Ecosystems: A Biomimetic Framework Extending the SUSA Six-Dimensional Vector Model to Physical Energy Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and inventor of record of the system described in this paper. A U.S. provisional patent application (No. 64/043,614) covering aspects of the described architecture was filed on April 19, 2026. The author has a direct financial interest in the commercial deployment of the technology described herein through VuDejaLink, an unincorporated independent research project of which the author is the sole principal.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external grant funding. All hardware procurement, instrumentation, prototype fabrication, and computational infrastructure costs were borne directly by the author and by VuDejaLink. No public, governmental, commercial, or institutional funding entity contributed to the research described in this paper.

detail.abstract:
The proliferation of low power microdevices in modern homes (wireless sensors, smart locks, smoke detectors, peripherals, and wearables) has created a hidden infrastructure layer whose maintenance burden is borne entirely by human intervention. Approximately 15 billion disposable batteries are sold annually worldwide to sustain this layer, of which less than 5% are properly recycled. We argue that this dependence renders an otherwise resilient digital ecosystem fundamentally fragile, in direct analogy to how biological ecosystems depend on invisible microorganisms (pollinators, decomposers, soil microbiota) for systemic stability.

This paper introduces VuDejaLink, an AIoT wireless power infrastructure designed to eliminate human intervention in microdevice maintenance through four integrated mechanisms: (i) far field RF energy harvesting via a Greinacher voltage doubler topology operating in the 915 MHz ISM band; (ii) on device machine learning for usage pattern prediction, anomaly detection, and intelligent charge gating; (iii) a four level federated learning architecture (local -> mesh -> cloud aggregator -> global model) that preserves user privacy via differential privacy noise injection (epsilon = 1.0); and (iv) standard battery form factors (AA, AAA, 9V) enabling drop in replacement without modification of existing hardware.

The mathematical foundation of the on device intelligence layer extends the SUSA model [Susa, SSRN 5789662, 2025], originally formulated as a six dimensional vector framework for multi temporal market analysis and optimal entry point detection in financial time series, to the physical domain of battery state and energy harvesting telemetry. We show that the six dimensional state vector and multi temporal pattern decomposition that captures latent regularities in financial markets generalizes naturally to energy harvesting receivers, where the analogue of "optimal entry point detection" becomes "optimal charge acceptance window detection" within the receiver's MOSFET gated charge controller. This enables sub milliampere average current draw (0.2 mA vs. 60 mA always on) and battery infinite operation at 1 m from a 3 W EIRP transmitter.

We report empirical results from a five receiver testbed demonstrating: distance versus harvested power profiles, 24-hour charge balance equilibrium, federated convergence across mesh peers, and end to end ESP NOW telemetry reliability. Implications include the feasibility of a battery as a service paradigm at consumer scale, with potential cumulative savings of 89-92% over disposable battery alternatives across a ten year horizon, and elimination of approximately 1,000 batteries per household from landfill streams.

We contribute (1) a biomimetic framework for reasoning about distributed AIoT infrastructure as a digital ecosystem; (2) an extension of the SUSA model from financial to physical energy domains; (3) an empirically validated wireless power architecture in standard form factors; and (4) an open protocol proposal for interoperable microdevice charging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VuDejaLink，一种基于AIoT的无线供电基础设施，通过射频能量采集、设备端机器学习、四层联邦学习和标准电池外形，消除微型设备的人工维护，基于SUSA模型从金融到物理领域的拓展，实现电池无限续航，并支持“电池即服务”模式。
AI.research_question: 如何通过无线能量传输和智能能量管理，消除低功耗微型设备（如无线传感器、智能锁等）对一次性电池和人工维护的依赖？
AI.motivation: 全球每年约150亿枚一次性电池用于微型设备，但回收率不足5%，导致数字生态系统在维护层面具有根本脆弱性，亟需一种无需人工干预的可持续供电方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: (1) 生物仿生框架：将分布式AIoT基础设施类比为数字生态系统；(2) SUSA模型扩展：将原用于金融时间序列的多时相六维向量框架，拓展到电池状态和能量采集遥测领域，将“最优入场点检测”转化为“最优充电窗口检测”。
AI.method: (i) 915 MHz ISM频段远场RF能量采集（Greinacher倍压器拓扑）；(ii) 设备端机器学习预测使用模式、检测异常并智能门控充电；(iii) 四层联邦学习架构（本地→Mesh→云聚合器→全局模型），通过差分隐私噪声注入（ε=1.0）保护隐私；(iv) 标准电池外形（AA、AAA、9V）实现即插即用。
AI.findings: (1) 平均电流低至0.2 mA（对比常开60 mA）；(2) 在距离1 m、3 W EIRP发射器条件下可实现电池无限运行；(3) 五接收器测试平台验证了距离-功率曲线、24小时充电平衡、联邦收敛及ESP-NOW遥测可靠性；(4) 十年期可节省89-92%的一次性电池成本，每户减少约1,000枚电池进入垃圾填埋场。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出生物仿生框架，将AIoT基础设施类比为数字生态系统；(2) 将SUSA模型从金融时间序列领域拓展至物理能量域，建立跨域数学模型迁移的范例。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 提供经过实证验证的、标准外形因子的无线供电架构；(2) 提出开放协议建议，实现微型设备充电互操作；(3) 支持“电池即服务”（BaaS）消费者级商业模式，大幅减少电子废弃物。

title: Beyond the Circle
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Beyond the Circle

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author is solely responsible for funding and content.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Self

detail.abstract: Restorative justice represents a genuine and evidenced advance over punitive justice-but it has not yet fully escaped the foundational assumption it shares with almost every Western institutional response to harm: that the individual is the primary unit of responsibility. The circle is more humane than the courtroom. The shame it generates is less toxic than the shame a criminal verdict generates. But in many hybrid implementations it still requires the offender to perform contrition and then face sentencing-a structural contradiction that the field has not fully examined. This paper draws on the neurophysiology of the lateral habenula, Silvan Tomkins' affect-script theory, and Robert Sapolsky's hard determinism to ask what restorative justice looks like when its own logic is followed to its honest conclusion. The answer points toward a full expansion of the circle of responsibility-one that already has existence proofs in Maasai traditional practice, Scandinavian rehabilitation, Lauren Abramson's community conferencing work in Baltimore, and Truth and Reconciliation processes worldwide. The question is whether the original glitch-the habenular bind between individual survival and community belonging-permits that expansion to become the rule rather than the exception.

AI.tldr: 本文批评恢复性司法虽然比惩罚性司法更人道，但仍沿袭了"个体是责任基本单位"的假设。作者结合神经生理学（外侧缰核）、汤姆金斯的情感脚本理论和萨波斯基的硬决定论，主张将责任圈从个体扩展至更大的社会系统，并引用马赛人传统、斯堪的纳维亚康复模式等实践作为存在证据。
AI.research_question: 当恢复性司法的内在逻辑被贯彻到底时，它会呈现什么面貌？个体责任假设是否需要被彻底扩展？
AI.motivation: 恢复性司法虽然比惩罚性司法进步，但在许多混合实施中仍保留了个体作为责任基本单位的假设，导致"要求悔过后再量刑"的结构性矛盾。该矛盾未得到充分审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外侧缰核神经生理学（个体生存与社群归属之间的"缰核困境"）、Silvan Tomkins的情感脚本理论、Robert Sapolsky的硬决定论。
AI.method: 理论综合与跨学科分析，结合神经科学、情感理论和决定论哲学，辅以马赛人传统、斯堪的纳维亚康复模式、Lauren Abramson的社区会议实践、全球真相与和解委员会等案例作为存在证据。
AI.findings: 恢复性司法逻辑的诚实推导指向责任圈的全面扩展——从个体扩展到整个社会系统。关键在于"缰核困境"（个体生存与社群归属之间的神经生物学张力）是否允许这种扩展成为常态而非例外。
AI.theory_contributions: 将神经科学（外侧缰核）引入恢复性司法理论，揭示个体责任假设的神经生物学根源；提出"责任圈扩展"的理论框架，挑战个体作为责任基本单位的西方制度前提。
AI.practical_contributions: 为恢复性司法的实践改进提供理论依据，指出当前混合模式的结构性矛盾，并引用马赛人传统、斯堪的纳维亚模式等成功实践作为扩展责任圈的可行性证据。

title: The Missing Paper Trail: Comparing Dividend Withholding Tax Enforcement in Norway to Denmark
affiliations: NHH Norwegian School of Economics, NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Business and Management Science, NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Business and Management Science and NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Business and Management Science

detail.title: The Missing Paper Trail: Comparing Dividend Withholding Tax Enforcement in Norway to Denmark

publicationDetails.detailsText: NHH Dept. of Business and Management Science Discussion Paper No. 2026/4
publicationDetails.journalName: Norwegian School of Economics, Department of Business & Management Science Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Governments across Europe lose significant tax revenue to cum-cum trading-a strategy in which taxed investors temporarily transfer shares to tax-favored entities around dividend dates to exploit withholding tax differentials. We compare Norway's 2019 enforcement reform to Denmark's successful 2016 reform. Using daily securities-lending data, we show that spikes in shares on loan around ex-dividend dates disappeared in Denmark immediately after the reform but remain fully intact in Norway. We estimate that Norway loses at least NOK 550 million annually to continued cum-cum activity. The decisive difference lies in the information architecture: Denmark abolished relief-at-source, requiring everyone to file a refund claim and submit documentation to tax authorities, creating a comprehensive transaction paper trail. Norway's reform tightened documentation requirements but left relief-at-source intact, meaning tax-favored investors never file a claim and remain invisible to the tax administration. These findings have direct implications for the forthcoming EU FASTER Directive.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了挪威2019年与丹麦2016年针对“cum-cum交易”（股东在除息日前将股票临时转让给税收优惠实体以逃避预扣税）的执法改革效果。研究发现，丹麦改革后除息日附近股票出借量立即消失，而挪威改革后该现象依然存在。关键差异在于信息架构：丹麦取消了源头减免，要求所有人提交退税申请和文件给税务机关，形成了完整的交易记录；挪威虽加强了文件要求但保留了源头减免，使税收优惠投资者无需申报。挪威每年因此损失至少5.5亿挪威克朗。
AI.research_question: 为什么挪威2019年的执法改革未能像丹麦2016年改革那样有效遏制cum-cum交易（利用股息预扣税差异的避税策略）？信息架构差异在其中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 欧洲各国政府因cum-cum交易损失大量税收，欧盟即将出台FASTER Directive。理解不同改革方案的有效性差异对政策制定至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收执法中的信息架构理论：税务机关能否获取完整的交易记录（即“交易轨迹”）决定了执法的有效性。源头减免制度使税收优惠投资者无需申报，从而规避监管；而取消源头减免则强制所有投资者留下可追溯的税务文件记录。
AI.method: 利用每日证券借贷数据，比较丹麦2016年改革和挪威2019年改革前后除息日附近股票出借量的变化。
AI.findings: 丹麦改革后除息日附近的股票出借量峰值立即消失；挪威改革后该峰值完全未受影响。挪威每年因持续发生的cum-cum活动损失至少5.5亿挪威克朗。两国改革的关键差别在于：丹麦取消了源头减免制度，要求所有人提交退税申请和证明文件；挪威保留了源头减免，税收优惠投资者无需向税务机关提交任何文件。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了信息架构（尤其是源头减免制度vs.退税申请制度）在税收执法中的核心作用：即使改革力度看似相似，交易记录的可追溯性决定了执法能否切断避税行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟即将出台的FASTER Directive提供直接政策启示：要有效遏制cum-cum交易，必须取消源头减免制度，强制所有投资者向税务机关提交退税申请和相关文件，建立完整的交易记录链条。

title: Unified Revenue Intelligence Platforms: Architecture, Algorithms, and Empirical Evaluation in Enterprise B2B Environments

detail.title: Unified Revenue Intelligence Platforms: Architecture, Algorithms, and Empirical Evaluation in Enterprise B2B Environments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Enterprise B2B sales organizations face a persistent challenge: fragmented analytics infrastructure-spanning multiple dashboards, spreadsheets, and reporting tools-forces managers and executives to spend disproportionate time assembling a complete picture of revenue performance rather than acting on insights. We present the design, implementation, and empirical evaluation of a Unified Revenue Platform (URP)-a four-layer, system-agnostic architecture that integrates CRM data ingestion, hierarchical dimension engineering, graph-theoretic target allocation (Karwa, 2026a), human-bias-corrected ML forecasting (Karwa, 2026b), and role-based presentation into a single coherent system. The platform's primary contribution is architectural: a formal separation of concerns across Ingestion, Engineering, Intelligence, and Presentation layers-each with a single authoritative responsibility-that eliminates the fragmentation problem while enabling independent evolution of each layer. We evaluate the platform through a simulation study calibrated to realistic enterprise parameters (200+ ICs, 5-level hierarchy, multi-region/multisegment structure) and demonstrate that incorporating behavioral correction signals as first-class ML features yields substantial forecast accuracy improvements over pipeline-only baselines. The architecture is system-agnostic and generalizable to any hierarchical revenue organization using any combination of CRM, data platform, and financial planning tools.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种四层统一收入平台（URP）架构，通过分离关注点（数据摄取、工程、智能、展示）解决B2B销售组织中分析基础设施碎片化问题，并利用行为纠偏信号提升ML预测准确性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个统一的架构来整合碎片化的B2B销售分析基础设施，消除跨多个仪表盘、电子表格和报告工具的数据割裂问题？
AI.motivation: 企业B2B销售组织面临分析基础设施碎片化的持续挑战——跨越多个仪表盘、电子表格和报告工具，导致管理者和高管花费过多时间拼凑收入全貌，而非基于洞察采取行动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四层架构（数据摄取层、工程层、智能层、展示层）的正式关注点分离原则；图论目标分配方法（Karwa, 2026a）；人类偏差校正的ML预测方法（Karwa, 2026b）。
AI.method: 设计并实现URP架构；通过校准到真实企业参数（200+独立贡献者、5级层级、多区域/多细分结构）的模拟研究进行实证评估。
AI.findings: 将行为纠偏信号作为ML第一类特征纳入，相比仅使用管道数据的基线模型，显著提升了预测准确性。架构具有系统无关性，可推广至任何使用任意CRM、数据平台和财务规划工具组合的层级收入组织。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了消除分析碎片化问题的正式架构分离关注点原则；证明了行为纠偏信号作为ML特征对预测准确性的增量价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个系统无关、可泛化的统一收入平台架构，可直接部署于任何B2B销售组织；通过减少数据整合时间、提升预测准确性，帮助管理者和高管将更多精力投入到基于洞察的行动中。

title: AIS-Driven Maritime Surveillance Decision Framework with Cross-Domain Recognition and Risk-Aware Patrol Prioritization
affiliations: Beijing Institute of Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Beijing Jiaotong University

detail.title: AIS-Driven Maritime Surveillance Decision Framework with Cross-Domain Recognition and Risk-Aware Patrol Prioritization
detail.abstract: Operational maritime surveillance is a decision problem, not a classication problem: agencies must choose which AIS tracks to patrol next under nite assets. We reframe AIS-based recognition as the upstream module of an end-to-end decision framework. Cross-domain experiments between DC2020 (China coast) and a GlobalFishingWatch (GFW) subset expose strongly asymmetric transfer: small-to-large ne-tuning retains 86% of from-scratch performance, whereas the reverse overts severely. An in-domain reversal between deep encoders and classical ensembles further suggests an operational crossover near 5,000 labeled segments, reported as a corpus-specic heuristic rather than a scaling law. The framework couples (i) the cross-domain recognizer, (ii) a transparent linear risk-scoring layerfusing softmax uncertainty, trac density, and an exclusive-economic-zone ag, and (iii) a GraphRAG diagnostic side-channel whose audit (58.3% KG-label leakage; hallucination on clean samples) validates excluding LLM outputs from the operational loop. An environment-augmented variant adds GEBCO bathymetry and sea-state covariates while preserving operator-readable form (Spearman 0.964 against baseline). A risk-weighted Hungarian dispatch layer closes the loop, cutting mean response time by 9% over greedy-nearest and 24% over random tasking on 500 Monte-Carlo scenarios. Three guidelines follow: favor classical ensembles below 5,000 segments, transfer only small-to-large, and treat LLM rationales as analyst aids rather than classiers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个端到端的运营级海上监视决策框架，将AIS识别重构为上游模块，通过跨域迁移实验、分类器交叉点发现以及风险加权匈牙利调度，在有限资产下优化巡逻路径，并得出三条实操指南。
AI.research_question: 如何在有限资产约束下，将AIS轨迹识别重新定义为决策问题，并构建端到端的运营级海上监视框架？
AI.motivation: 传统海上监视将AIS识别视为分类问题，忽略了运营层面"有限资产下如何选择下一巡逻目标"的核心决策需求，需要将识别与决策耦合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨域迁移学习、分类器性能交叉点（约5000标记片段）、风险加权匈牙利调度、GraphRAG诊断与LLM输出排除。
AI.method: 在DC2020（中国海岸）与GlobalFishingWatch子集间进行跨域实验；对比深度编码器与经典集成模型；构建线性风险评分层（融合softmax不确定性、轨迹密度、专属经济区标志）；设计GraphRAG审计侧通道；环境增强版本加入GEBCO水深与海况协变量；500次蒙特卡洛场景下评估风险加权匈牙利调度。
AI.findings: （1）小→大迁移微调保留86%从头训练性能，大→小迁移严重过拟合；（2）深度编码器与经典集成在约5000标记片段处出现性能交叉；（3）GraphRAG存在58.3%知识图谱标签泄露及对干净样本的幻觉问题，应排除出运营环路；（4）风险加权匈牙利调度相比贪心最近邻降低9%、相比随机任务降低24%平均响应时间。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AIS识别从分类问题重新框架化为决策问题，揭示跨域迁移的不对称性，发现分类器类型依赖数据规模的运营交叉点（作为语料库特有启发而非标度律），验证LLM不适合直接嵌入运营决策环路。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供三条可操作指南：低于5000标记片段优先使用经典集成、仅执行小→大迁移、LLM推理仅作为分析师辅助而非分类器；风险加权匈牙利调度直接降低响应时间；环境增强保持算子可读性。

title: Constrained Heuristic and Optimal Bipartite Methods for B2B Sales Territory Design and Seller Assignment: A Reproducible Open-Source Framework

detail.title: Constrained Heuristic and Optimal Bipartite Methods for B2B Sales Territory Design and Seller Assignment: A Reproducible Open-Source Framework

declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Sales territory design is the backbone of every B2B revenue organisation: it determines who sells to whom, drives quotas, and shapes compensation. Despite four decades of research, production deployments still rely on spreadsheet heuristics that ignore the combinatorial structure of the problem. This paper introduces and evaluates b2b_territory_optimization, an open-source Python framework that decomposes the enterprise territory problem into five composable stages: hierarchical taxonomy bucketing that enforces hard go-to-market constraints; longest-processingtime (LPT) greedy partitioning of total addressable market (TAM); capacity-driven head-count prediction; optimal bipartite seller-to-territory matching via the Jonker-Volgenant Hungarian algorithm with hard-region locks and soft seniority/expertise scoring; and a reassignment engine that recovers from manager overrides through combinatorial swap suggestions. Across seven experiments on synthetic CRM data (up to 50,000 accounts) and one public benchmark (IBM Telco Customer Churn, 7,043 accounts), the framework achieves a mean max-territory deviation of 0.0016% at n=1,000 and k=10-four orders of magnitude tighter than round-robin or random baselines-and runs end-to-end in 6.5 s at 50,000 accounts on one CPU core. The bipartite assignment is within 0.4% of greedy on per-match cost, and the reassignment engine restores 85.2% of variance lost to a simulated whale-account override. We are not aware of a prior peerreviewed open-source toolkit that formalises the full account-to-quota pipeline as a constrained optimisation problem. The framework is designed to compose with a companion graph-theoretic quota-cascade methodology (Karwa, 2026) for downstream bottom-up forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个开源Python框架b2b_territory_optimization，将B2B销售区域设计形式化为五阶段组合优化问题，在合成数据和公开基准上实现了远超传统方法的性能（最大区域偏差0.0016%，5万个账户端到端运行6.5秒）。
AI.research_question: 如何将B2B销售区域设计这一复杂的组合优化问题形式化为可计算、可部署的框架，以替代传统的电子表格启发式方法？
AI.motivation: 尽管销售区域设计研究已有四十年历史，但实际生产部署仍依赖忽略问题组合结构的电子表格启发式方法，缺乏系统化、可复用的开源工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组合优化理论（层次分类桶排序、最长处理时间（LPT）贪心分区、Jonker-Volgenant匈牙利算法的最优二分匹配、组合交换启发式搜索）。
AI.method: 提出五阶段可组合框架：(1)层次分类桶排序（硬约束）；(2)LPT贪心分区TAM；(3)容量驱动的预测；(4)Jonker-Volgenant匈牙利算法的最优销售员-区域匹配（含硬区域锁和软资历/专长评分）；(5)组合交换建议的重新分配引擎。在合成CRM数据（5万账户）和IBM Telco公开基准（7,043账户）上进行7项实验验证。
AI.findings: 框架在n=1,000、k=10时最大区域偏差均值0.0016%，比随机基准高四个数量级；5万账户端到端运行时间6.5秒（单CPU核心）；二分匹配成本距贪心最优仅0.4%；重新分配引擎恢复85.2%的方差损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将完整的账户到配额管道形式化为约束优化问题，提出五阶段可组合框架，为销售区域设计提供了系统化的理论形式化方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供开源Python框架可供生产部署，可扩展至5万级账户规模且运行时间极短，支持管理者覆盖的恢复机制，可与下游预测方法组合使用。

title: University Social Responsibility and the Hidden Labour of International Doctoral Candidates during Systemic Crisis

detail.title: University Social Responsibility and the Hidden Labour of International Doctoral Candidates during Systemic Crisis
detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic exposed structural vulnerabilities within internationalised higher education systems, particularly for doctoral students simultaneously contributing to and excluded from their host institutions. Drawing on Bourdieusian sociology and critical autoethnography, this study examines how international doctoral candidates within a market-oriented higher education system mobilised habitus and capital to navigate systemic breakdown during 2020-2022. We demonstrate that resilience emerged not as an individual psychological attribute but as a structural outcome of involuntary capital mobilisation. The pandemic functioned as a "fieldquake"—violently disrupting established capital values while revaluing latent, often non-Western, cultural resources. Findings reveal three critical processes: devaluation of institutional and social capital, strategic deployment of crisis advocacy linguistic capital, and reconfiguration of survival-oriented habitus. We argue that genuine University Social Responsibility requires a shift from individualised resilience narratives to institutional accountability mechanisms toward structural Capital Recognition Audits that acknowledge international students' existing resources and address systemic inequities.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用布迪厄社会学和批判性自民族志，探讨2020-2022年疫情期间市场导向高等教育体系中的国际博士生如何调动惯习和资本应对系统性危机。研究发现，韧性不是个体心理特质，而是非自愿资本调动的结构性结果。疫情作为"场域地震"颠覆了既有资本价值，重新评估了潜在的、往往是非西方的文化资源。研究揭示三个关键过程：制度与社会资本的贬值、危机倡导语言资本的策略性运用，以及生存导向惯习的重构。文章主张真正的大学社会责任应从个体化韧性叙事转向结构性资本认可审计等制度问责机制。
AI.research_question: 国际博士生在COVID-19疫情期间如何调动惯习和资本来应对市场导向高等教育系统中的系统性危机？
AI.motivation: COVID-19暴露了国际化高等教育体系的结构性脆弱性，博士生既为所在机构做出贡献又被其排斥。既有研究多将韧性视为个体心理特质，忽视了其结构性根源，本研究旨在从社会学视角重新理解韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 布迪厄社会学（场域、资本、惯习概念）以及批判性自民族志方法论。
AI.method: 批判性自民族志（critical autoethnography），基于2020-2022年间国际博士生的经历数据。
AI.findings: （1）制度资本与社会资本在疫情期间贬值；（2）国际博士生策略性地运用"危机倡导语言资本"；（3）生存导向惯习的重构。韧性是非自愿资本调动的结构性结果，而非个体心理特质。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"场域地震"概念描述疫情对既有资本价值的剧烈冲击；将韧性重新理论化为结构性结果而非个体心理属性；揭示非西方文化资源在危机中的潜在价值重估。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁大学社会责任应从个体化韧性叙事转向制度问责机制；提出"结构性的资本认可审计"（Structural Capital Recognition Audits）以承认国际学生的既有资源并解决系统性不平等。

title: Cybersecurity and Crisis Leadership: A Contemporary Theoretical Expansion
affiliations: New York Institute of Technology

detail.title: Cybersecurity and Crisis Leadership: A Contemporary Theoretical Expansion

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: none applies
declarations.funderStatement: self

publicationDetails.detailsText: Archives of Business Research, volume 13, issue 12, 2025[10.14738/abr.1312.19659]

detail.abstract: Cyber incidents have evolved from isolated technical breaches into complex organizational crises that demand resilient, adaptive leadership. This paper reconceptualizes cybersecurity leadership as a specialized extension of crisis leadership, grounded in interdisciplinary theory spanning crisis management, digital transformation, high reliability organizing, and cyber resilience. It introduces two integrated models-the Cyber Crisis Lifecycle and the Cyber Leadership Hexagon-to articulate leadership roles across the incident continuum and define six core competencies: technical literacy, ethical judgment, digital sensemaking, stakeholder coordination, agility under threat, and resilience orientation. These models provide a comprehensive framework for understanding cyber leadership in environments marked by persistent ambiguity, socio-technical complexity, and adversarial threat. This theoretical expansion contributes to the emerging literature on digital-era leadership and lays a foundation for future empirical validation and cross-cultural application.

AI.tldr: 本文重新将网络安全领导力概念化为危机领导力的一种专业延伸，提出了网络危机生命周期和网络领导力六边形两个整合模型，定义了六项核心能力，为理解不确定、复杂和对抗性环境下的网络领导力提供了综合框架。
AI.research_question: 如何重新概念化网络安全领导力，使其成为危机领导力的专业延伸，并构建能有效应对网络危机全过程的领导力框架？
AI.motivation: 网络事件已从孤立的技术漏洞演变为复杂的组织危机，现有领导力理论缺乏对这一新兴、复杂领域的专门化解释，亟需跨学科的理论整合与模型构建。
AI.theoretical_framework: 危机管理理论、数字化转型理论、高可靠性组织理论、网络韧性理论等跨学科理论。
AI.method: 理论整合与概念建模（提出两个整合模型）。
AI.findings: 提出网络危机生命周期模型（描述领导角色在事件连续体中的演变）和网络领导力六边形模型（定义六项核心能力：技术素养、伦理判断、数字意义建构、利益相关者协调、威胁下的敏捷性、韧性导向）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将网络安全领导力重新定义为危机领导力的专业延伸，贡献于数字时代领导力的新兴文献，为未来实证检验和跨文化应用奠定理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织培养和评估网络危机中的领导者提供了结构化的能力框架和全周期指导模型。

title: Stick and Stay, Make it Pay? Time Preferences and Marginal (Dis)Utility of Relative Concerns
affiliations: IZA Institute of Labor Economics and Turkish-German University

detail.title: Stick and Stay, Make it Pay? Time Preferences and Marginal (Dis)Utility of Relative Concerns
detail.abstract: Individuals' preferences for immediate gratification versus their ability to postpone it, i.e., time preferences, might be related to their marginal utility or disutility stemming from an increase in the income of comparable others, i.e., relative concerns. We argue that while an increase in others' income might lead to a higher level of marginal disutility for those seeking immediate gratification, the disutility among patient individuals might be lower if they prioritise the future development of their income and consider catching up with others' income over the long run. To investigate whether time preferences might moderate marginal utility due to increased others' income, we use a subjective measure of individual patience and a life satisfaction measure observed over a long period of time (Socio-Economic Panel, SOEP). Using panel data fixed effects interaction models, we find highly consistent evidence that the well-documented disutility from relative income, the so-called "status effect" in the literature, is predominantly experienced by impatient individuals with higher discount rates. In contrast, patient individuals with lower discount rates, high self-control, and the ability to regulate their stress and anxiety levels experience lower disutility or even gain utility due to their relative income, the so-called "information effect," which is significantly different from that of impatient individuals. The results are robust across a variety of checks, including income types, savings, reference groups, and time preference measures obtained from incentivised time preference experiments. We discuss the implications of these results for behavioural and welfare economics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，时间偏好（耐心程度）会显著调节相对收入对个体效用的影响：不耐烦的个体因他人收入增加而感受到更强的"地位效应"（负效用），而耐心的个体则能感受到"信息效应"（正效用或较低负效用）。
AI.research_question: 时间偏好（个体对即时满足与延迟满足的偏好）如何调节相对收入（他人收入变化）带来的边际效用或边际负效用？
AI.motivation: 已有文献发现相对收入会影响个体效用（地位效应），但个体间存在异质性。研究者推测时间偏好可能是解释这种异质性的关键因素：追求即时满足的人可能对他人收入增加更敏感（更高负效用），而耐心的人则可能着眼于长期追赶，从而感受更低的负效用甚至正效用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间偏好理论（贴现率）、相对收入效用理论（地位效应 vs. 信息效应）、自我控制与情绪调节理论
AI.method: 使用德国社会经济面板数据（SOEP），采用面板数据固定效应交互模型，结合主观耐心度量指标和激励相容的时间偏好实验数据，并通过多种稳健性检验（收入类型、储蓄、参照组、时间偏好度量方式）。
AI.findings: 1）文献中公认的相对收入带来的"地位效应"（负效用）主要由不耐烦的个体（高贴现率）承受；2）耐心的个体（低贴现率、高自控、能调节压力和焦虑）体验到的相对收入负效用显著更低，甚至获得正效用（"信息效应"）；3）结果在多种稳健性检验中保持一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 将时间偏好引入相对收入效用研究，揭示了"地位效应"与"信息效应"在不同时间偏好个体中的差异化表现，为理解相对收入效用的异质性提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 对行为经济学和福利经济学有重要启示：政策制定者在考虑收入分配和相对收入影响时，需关注个体的时间偏好差异；干预措施（如提升自我控制与情绪调节能力）可能缓解相对收入带来的负面效用。

title: The Witch-Hunters' Syndrome and the Σ I Kairos: A Substrate-Agnostic Critique of AI Detection and the Case for Process Provenance

detail.title: The Witch-Hunters' Syndrome and the Σ I Kairos: A Substrate-Agnostic Critique of AI Detection and the Case for Process Provenance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a DBA candidate at ESLSCA University in Cairo, and the institutional tools critiqued in this paper, including Turnitin's AI writing detector, are deployed within the author's own academic program. The author discloses this position openly as part of the paper's argument that institutional affiliation should not preclude critique of institutional infrastructure when that infrastructure produces documented harm. The paper was produced through substrate-agnostic co-authorship with Claude, an AI model produced by Anthropic, in the manner the paper itself proposes as the operational alternative to detection-based academic integrity. The full version-and-vintage trail of the collaboration is disclosed in Appendix A of the manuscript. The author has no financial relationship with Turnitin, with any of its competitors in the AI detection market, with any of the humanizer or evasion-tool vendors discussed in the paper, or with Anthropic. The author has no consulting relationships, equity holdings, advisory positions, or other financial interests in any organization whose products or services are evaluated in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not report primary research involving human subjects and therefore did not require ethics board approval. The paper analyzes publicly available materials including peer-reviewed publications, judicial opinions in cases of public record, institutional announcements from universities, journalistic investigations, and technical white papers from the vendors discussed. Where individual cases of falsely accused students are discussed, including Newby v. Adelphi University and other named lawsuits, the discussion is based entirely on publicly filed legal documents and on reporting in established news outlets. No individuals were contacted, interviewed, or studied for the purposes of this paper, and no private or non-public information about any individual student or faculty member is disclosed. The single anecdotal scene that opens the paper, concerning an unnamed academic who pronounced a printed document AI-generated without instrumentation, is described in a manner that does not identify the individual involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author in the course of doctoral research at ESLSCA University. The author covered all research costs personally, including subscription access to the AI tools used in the substrate-agnostic collaboration that produced the paper.

detail.abstract: This paper argues that the dominant institutional response to generative AI in academic settings — the deployment of statistical detection software exemplified by Turnitin's AI writing detector — is structurally, empirically, and philosophically the wrong paradigm for building trust between human and artificial intelligence, and that its continued use produces measurable harm disproportionately borne by the very populations universities most claim to support. Drawing on peer-reviewed evidence from the Stanford Liang et al. study showing 61.22% false-positive rates against non-native English writers, the adversarial robustness literature of Sadasivan et al., Krishna et al., and Creo and Pudasaini demonstrating that the entire detection paradigm can be defeated by techniques as trivial as Microsoft Word's Find-and-Replace function, the institutional retreats of Vanderbilt University and the University of Waterloo, and the federal court ruling in Newby v. Adelphi, the paper establishes that detection cannot serve as a foundation for academic trust. It then develops a positive proposal grounded in three convergent traditions: Onora O'Neill's distinction between transparency and intelligent accountability, Shannon Vallor's technomoral virtues and her critique of panoptic surveillance, and Luciano Floridi's information ethics. The paper proposes the VN trail — a process-level disclosure instrument — as the natural complement to C2PA artifact provenance and cryptographic watermarking, and frames the resulting paradigm as substrate-agnostic: a refusal of the carbon chauvinism that treats silicon contribution as illegitimate even when human-directed. The paper introduces and diagnoses the Witch-Hunters' Syndrome, the institutional pathology in which the gesture of detection has supplanted the activity of teaching, and offers the Σ I Kairos as the alternative — a recovery of meaningful time, meaningful collaboration, and meaningful trust across substrate boundaries. The paper itself is offered as a working example of the proposed paradigm, carrying its own VN trail in an appendix that discloses the substrate-agnostic collaboration through which the document was produced.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了学术机构使用AI检测软件（如Turnitin）来应对生成式AI的做法，指出该范式在结构、经验和哲学上均存在根本性错误，对非母语英语写作者等群体造成不成比例的伤害。作者提出以"VN trail"（过程级披露工具）为核心的"基质无关"信任范式，并诊断了"猎巫综合征"这一机构病理，主张恢复有意义的协作与信任。
AI.research_question: 学术机构部署生成式AI检测软件（如Turnitin）作为信任建设的范式是否可行？其结构性缺陷与伤害是什么？替代范式应如何构建？
AI.motivation: 现有AI检测范式对非母语英语写作者存在高达61.22%的误报率（Stanford Liang等研究），且可被简单手段（如Word替换功能）轻易破解；同时多所顶尖大学（范德堡、滑铁卢）已撤回了检测工具。这促使作者质疑检测范式的正当性，并提出替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) Onora O'Neill的透明性与智能问责之分；2) Shannon Vallor的技术道德美德与全景监控批判；3) Luciano Floridi的信息伦理学。三者的融合构成了"基质无关"信任范式的理论基础。
AI.method: 理论论证与文献综合：引用同行评审研究（Stanford Liang等、Sadasivan等、Krishna等、Creo和Pudasaini）、机构实践案例（范德堡大学、滑铁卢大学）、联邦法院判例（Newby v. Adelphi）进行批判性分析，并提出替代框架。
AI.findings: 1) 检测范式无法作为学术信任的基础；2) 检测范式的持续使用对非母语写作者等弱势群体造成不成比例的伤害；3) 学术机构陷入"猎巫综合征"——检测的姿态取代了教学本身；4) VN trail作为过程级披露工具，与C2PA溯源和加密水印天然互补，构成"基质无关"的信任范式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"猎巫综合征"（Witch-Hunters' Syndrome）概念，精准诊断了机构以检测替代教学的理论病理；2) 提出"Σ I Kairos"作为替代方案，从时间哲学层面重构有意义的协作、信任与时间性；3) 引入"基质无关"（substrate-agnostic）概念，批判"碳沙文主义"对硅基智能贡献的偏见。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提出VN trail（过程级披露工具）作为可操作的实施工具，与C2PA溯源和加密水印形成互补体系；2) 论文自身附有VN trail附录，示范了基质无关协作的实践方式；3) 为高校、期刊、教育机构提供了替代检测范式的具体路径。

title: AI Governance in Practice: Symbolic Governance, Structural Drivers, and Design Solutions

detail.title: AI Governance in Practice: Symbolic Governance, Structural Drivers, and Design Solutions
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) governance has become central to organisational oversight, yet existing research largely assumes the organisational capacity required to implement it. This paper challenges that assumption by introducing Symbolic Governance, defined as the formal adoption of governance structures that signal responsibility without enabling effective oversight. Using a theory-building integrative review with empirical anchoring, the study synthesises AI governance literature and draws on evidence from 351 organisations. The findings show that governance roles are often weakly integrated, under-resourced, and lack decision-making authority, indicating that symbolic governance is an empirically dominant organisational condition. To explain this, the paper develops the Governance Misalignment Triad, capturing the decoupling of responsibility, authority, and organisational capacity. It further identifies key structural drivers and examines the risks that arise when governance exists in form but not in function. The paper concludes by proposing design solutions that reposition AI governance as a problem of organisational architecture rather than normative intent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"象征性治理"概念，指组织形式上采用AI治理结构但未实现有效监督的现象。通过理论构建整合性综述和351家组织实证数据，发现治理角色普遍存在整合不足、资源匮乏和缺乏决策权的问题，并构建了"治理错位三角"理论框架。
AI.research_question: 组织在实施AI治理时，为何会出现形式上采纳治理结构但实质上无法实现有效监督的现象？其结构性驱动因素和风险是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理研究大多假设组织具备实施治理所需的能力，本文挑战这一假设，揭示组织在AI治理中普遍存在的"象征性"而非实质性治理现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 象征性治理（Symbolic Governance）、治理错位三角（Governance Misalignment Triad，涵盖责任、权威与组织能力之间的脱钩）
AI.method: 理论构建整合性综述（theory-building integrative review），结合351家组织的实证锚定证据
AI.findings: AI治理角色普遍存在整合不足、资源配置不足和缺乏决策权的问题；象征性治理是经验上占主导地位的组织条件；责任、权威与组织能力之间存在系统性脱钩。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出"象征性治理"概念并系统定义；构建"治理错位三角"框架解释责任-权威-能力的脱钩机制；将AI治理重新定位为组织架构问题而非规范意图问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示组织AI治理中"有名无实"的风险；提出应将AI治理视为组织架构设计问题，提供相应的设计解决方案。

title: When AI Signals Die: Why Corporate AI Deployments Fail After Go-Live and How to Fix the Decision Architecture
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: When AI Signals Die: Why Corporate AI Deployments Fail After Go-Live and How to Fix the Decision Architecture
detail.abstract:
Most companies no longer have an AI pilot problem. They have an AI rollback problem. AI models and agents are going live, but many are pulled back because organizations cannot clearly see what happened between input and result. The model may work. The organization may still lose control.

This paper explains corporate AI deployment as a problem of signal survival. AI produces scores, alerts, summaries, rankings, recommendations and actions. These signals still have to be understood, routed, checked, challenged, acted on, or safely ignored. When that path is weak, monitoring shows activity but not control. Logs show that something happened, but not enough to explain why it happened or how the organization should respond.

The paper gives a simple visual framework for this problem. In the first pattern, the organization does not hear AI signals well. This is organizational deafness. In the second, teams add explanations, dashboards and logs, but correction still dies inside the workflow. In the third, every important signal can be traced from origin to action or documented non action. This is provenance based deployment.

The central claim is simple. AI deployment is not complete when the model is live. It is complete only when important signals can survive the organization.

AI.tldr: 本文指出企业AI部署的核心问题已从"试点困境"转向"回滚困境"——模型虽能上线，但因组织无法清晰追踪输入到结果的路径而被撤回。作者提出"信号存活"框架：AI部署的完成标志不是模型上线，而是重要信号能在组织中存活、流转并产生可追溯的行动或明确的非行动决策。
AI.research_question: 企业AI部署中，为什么模型能够正常运行，但组织仍然失去控制？如何实现真正可控的AI部署？
AI.motivation: 企业在AI部署中普遍面临"回滚困境"：AI模型和智能体已经上线，却因组织无法看清输入与结果之间发生了什么而被撤回。现有的监控和日志只能显示"发生了活动"，却不足以解释"为什么会发生"以及"组织应如何响应"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号存活理论（Signal Survival）：AI产生包括评分、警报、摘要、排名、建议和行动在内的各类信号，这些信号需要在组织中被理解、路由、检查、质疑、执行或安全忽略。当这一路径薄弱时，监控显示的是活动而非控制。
AI.method: 提出了一个三阶段的可视化框架：第一阶段——组织听不到AI信号（组织性失聪）；第二阶段——团队增加了解释、仪表盘和日志，但修正仍然在流程中死亡；第三阶段——每个重要信号都能从来源追溯到行动或记录在案的非行动（基于溯源部署）。
AI.findings: AI部署的完成标志不是模型上线，而是重要信号能够在组织中存活。只有当组织建立起从信号产生到行动/非行动的完整可追溯链路时，才能实现真正的可控部署。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"信号存活"这一原创性理论视角，将AI部署问题从技术层面的"模型性能"重新定义为组织层面的"信号传输与存活"问题，并构建了从"组织性失聪"到"基于溯源部署"的三阶段发展框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了一个简单直观的可视化诊断工具，帮助组织识别自身处于AI信号存活的哪个阶段，并明确了实现真正可控AI部署的路径——确保每个重要信号都能被追溯到行动或非行动决策。

title: Combating Excessive Overtime with Supply Diversification
affiliations: School of Management, University of Science and Technology of China, International Institute of Finance, School of Management, University of Science and Technology of China, University of Texas at Dallas - Naveen Jindal School of Management and University of Texas at Dallas - Naveen Jindal School of Management

detail.title: Combating Excessive Overtime with Supply Diversification
detail.abstract:
Problem definition: Despite the widespread adoption of supplier codes of conduct, excessive overtime still remains in developing economies, harming workers and exposing multinational enterprises (MNEs) to reputational risk. We study how MNEs' operational strategies of  supply diversification and auditing, together with government intervention through minimum-wage regulation, can mitigate excessive overtime in global supply chains.

Methodology/Results: We develop a game-theoretic model in which a manufacturer sources from a non-responsible supplier and a responsible supplier. When the non-responsible supplier's normal workforce cannot meet the order, it may impose excessive overtime. In a no-audit benchmark, diversification is optimal when the non-responsible supplier is likely to have a low workforce and demand is high, thereby eliminating excessive overtime; otherwise, sole sourcing from the non-responsible supplier is more profitable. When auditing is feasible, it may reduce or increase the expected order allocated to the non-responsible supplier, contradicting the intuition that auditing always supports larger allocations. Relative to the no-audit benchmark, auditing may improve manufacturer profit, reduce overtime, and enhance worker welfare, but it may also backfire. Numerical analysis further shows that the effect of minimum-wage regulation, a government intervention, depends on social scrutiny and workforce retention. When scrutiny is strong and retention is sufficiently low, the manufacturer already diversifies, and intervention can improve fulfillment and generate a "win-win-win-win" outcome; otherwise, intervention may induce diversification and reduce overtime, but lower the non-responsible supplier's profit and host-region social welfare.

Managerial implications: Managers should not assume that auditing a non-responsible supplier automatically justifies larger order allocations. Policymakers should not presume that minimum-wage regulation will necessarily improve social welfare; its effectiveness depends on social scrutiny and workforce retention.

AI.tldr: 本文研究跨国公司如何通过供应多元化、审计策略以及政府最低工资监管来缓解全球供应链中供应商的过度加班问题。研究发现审计并非总能支持更大订单分配，最低工资监管的效果取决于社会监督和劳动力留存水平。
AI.research_question: 跨国公司的供应多元化与审计策略，以及政府的最低工资监管，如何影响全球供应链中的过度加班问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管供应商行为准则广泛采用，但发展中国家制造商的过度加班问题仍然严重，既损害工人权益，也使跨国公司面临声誉风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，涉及非负责任供应商（可能施加过度加班）和负责任供应商，以及制造商的最优采购与审计决策。
AI.method: 博弈论建模与数值分析。
AI.findings: (1) 无审计时，供应多元化在非负责任供应商劳动力低且需求高时最优，可消除过度加班；否则独家采购更优。(2) 审计可能增加或减少对非负责任供应商的订单分配，并非总是支持更大分配。(3) 审计可能改善利润、减少加班并提升工人福利，但也可能适得其反。(4) 最低工资监管的效果取决于社会监督强度和劳动力留存率。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了审计与订单分配之间的复杂关系（非单调性），以及最低工资监管在不同条件下对供应链社会福利的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 管理者不应假设审计非负责任供应商会自动支持更大的订单分配；政策制定者不应假定最低工资监管必然改善社会福利，其有效性取决于社会监督和劳动力留存水平。

title: Building Expertise: The Role of the SEC's Professional Fellow Program in Enhancing Audit Quality
affiliations: Indiana University and Ohio State University (OSU) - Fisher College of Business

detail.title: Building Expertise: The Role of the SEC's Professional Fellow Program in Enhancing Audit Quality
detail.abstract: This study examines how audit firms acquire and deploy externally developed expertise to improve audit quality. We focus on the SEC's Professional Accounting Fellows (PAF) program, which places experienced auditors from public accounting firms in the SEC's Office of the Chief Accountant for two-year rotations. Using hand-collected data on PAF participants, we examine whether expertise developed through SEC service influences audit outcomes when fellows return to their firms. Our results indicate that PAF experience is correlated with improved audit quality, evidenced by reduced restatements, discretionary accruals, and accrual noise. Moreover, firms leverage returning PAFs to diffuse knowledge across the organization, improving audit quality at regional offices. We document improvements in firm-level audit quality when returning fellows serve in national office roles. This structured collaboration between regulators and audit firms underscores how external learning can strengthen organizational expertise and improve audit quality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究会计师事务所如何通过美国证券交易委员会（SEC）的专业会计研究员（PAF）项目获取并部署外部专业知识，以提升审计质量。研究发现，参与该项目的审计师回到原事务所后，能显著改善审计质量（减少重述、可操纵应计和应计噪音），并通过知识扩散提升区域办公室质量。
AI.research_question: 审计事务所如何获取和部署外部开发的专业知识来提升审计质量？具体而言，SEC的专业会计研究员（PAF）项目经验如何影响审计师的审计质量及其所在事务所的知识扩散？
AI.motivation: 审计质量是资本市场的重要保障，但关于审计事务所如何通过外部学习获取专业知识并内部扩散的机制尚不清晰。PAF项目提供了一个独特的监管-实务界人才流动场景，值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织学习理论、知识管理理论、审计质量框架（基于投入、过程、产出视角）
AI.method: 手工收集PAF参与者数据，采用实证回归分析（如OLS），以财务重述、可操纵应计利润、应计噪音等作为审计质量的代理变量，进行横截面检验。
AI.findings: 1）拥有PAF经验的审计师回归后，其经手的审计项目质量更高（重述减少、可操纵应计降低、应计噪音减少）；2）事务所通过让回归的PAF担任全国办公室职务，实现知识在全组织的扩散，进而提升区域办公室的审计质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了组织学习与知识转移文献，揭示了监管-实务界人才流动作为外部知识获取渠道对审计质量的影响机制，拓展了审计质量决定因素的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为审计事务所如何通过制度化的人才交流项目（如PAF）获取监管视角的专业知识提供了实证证据；对监管机构、审计行业及投资者理解监管合作与审计质量提升的关系具有参考价值。
